Another Piranha Game which I really enjoy. After Gothic 2+NotR this is their best game as far I am concerned. The blend of Fantasy and Sci-Fi is well done and as oldschool Gothic fan I got exactly what I wanted. 

+ The Details of the world are well done and makes exploring the world really enjoyable.

+ The Jetpack is a pretty bold feature which works great in this game. Usually openworld games fear to have a flyingability because it is hard to balance, but in Elex they implemented it perfect.

- The only big thing I am not so happy about is the fightingsystem.
I like that they used a darksouls inspired closecombat-fightingsystem, but the contolls are too sluggish and imprecise to be great.
Also the hitboxes are not very precise. Sometimes you dodge an attack an still get hit or stand just slightly over or under an enemy and already can't hit him even though your weapon cuts right through him.

The graphics and animations could be better for a game of 2017 but the Piranha games were never known to be the graphical most advanced and it is good enough to have fun and still look pretty at times.

The game scores with the usual strenghts of Piranha Bytes games:
+ Little to no handholding
+ exploration is great and rewarding
+ detailed, diverse and breathing world
+ memorable characters
+ challenging and hostile world, where you have to learn what YOUR place in the food chain is.
+ options to cheese the game a little bit, if you are creative.
+ looting feels awesome in PB games.

+ I didn't experience any bugs, which in fact surprised me. 
The game ran super stable and smoothe. No crashes at all in over 100 hours, no framerate drops and the loadingtimes are pretty fast. 
Since some of the older reviews here state that they got many bugs I suppose most of them got fixed by now.


Over all a good and solid game, but casual gamers might find it too hard and unforgiving.

Like everyone that complained, I also tried really hard to like the game, but in the end it's just not good.

First, you start the game as useless as a bag of potato. You can't kill anything and every enemy will one-hit kill you.
You level up 10x and anything that moves can still one-hit kill you with you barely doing any damage.

There are companions that help you on your adventure, but guess what? They are also useless.
To begin, they will not auto-fight an enemy. You have to shoot or punch it first before they react and even then, you have to run away as the enemy will not shift focus to your companion and it will one-hit kill you.

Your weapons are garbage and anything that deals more damage will require a lot of attributes, which will required lots and lots of levels. Speaking of attributes, you start with every attribute costing you 1 point, but it will increase up to 10 points per attribute. And yes, you only get 10 points per level, so guess how much you have to grind to use a sword that requires 55 STR and 40 DEX? Yep, a lot and the sword will not deal any useful damage.
Another issue is the amor set, it is just impossible to get any decent gear before you join a faction and it is a hell to finish the initial faction quests.

I played the game the way it should be played for about 25 hours, then I got tired and used a save modifier to increase all attributes. Guess what? even at the level cap (100 for each attribute) enemies could still three-hit kill me and I could not one hit kill anyone.

TL:DR: The game is so fricking unbalanced and slow. The idea is really good and I tried hard to like the game, but man, that's too much.
I cannot afford 150hrs on a game that has no satisfactory rewards.
I really want to love this game. I've tried for 9 hours but there are to many reasons not to play this game.

I loved Gothic 1-3. I finished this game, yes, but honestly I would not recommend it. First half of the game I was waiting for it to get really good. Second half I just wanted to finish it. In hindsight it was barely worth it.

The only thing, in my opinion, that it has going for it, is the open world. That is much better than in Witcher 2-3 or most other games. Other than that, there is nothing good except the graphics. The open world is nowhere near as interesting and immersive as Fallout 3-4, its much more blander and empty.Quests are often simplistic, characters are boring. Almost no  interesting NPCs to discover.

The graphics are still good in 2020. There are a few moments where you can see Elex's potential, like one particular spot in a mysterious forest with beautiful lights and birds chirping. This was reminiscent of the immersive world of Gothic but there are probably not more than 3 of those moments in the entire game.

The fighting system is bad. It took me 20 h to not have to run away from weak starting enemies. You basically have to become overpowered so that the clunky fighting bothers you less because you kill enemies fast enough. A lie that is being told on the Internet is that this is just how Gothic was. This is not true. Yes, in Gothic 1-3 you could not just fight any mob from the start, but the early mobs were easily killable with your starting weapons.  This is not possible in Elex. Simple rats teleport in front of you, stun you with their fast attacks and you might land some hits before you die. It's not only hard, its outrageously hard and unfair. I genuinely can't remember a worse fighting system than in this game. Dark Souls is hard and fair, this game is harder and unfair.

There are a lot of other issues, like straight out misleading or wrong skill descriptions, something that could have been fixed hours before the release. The dumb cold/emotional "karma system" never really tells you where you stand and its rarely clear from a dialogue option which direction you will go. This system also forces you into an ending without you being able to choose dialogue options. Just because you don't care about every little problem of the NPCs and want to progress faster you are forced into the "evil" ending. And it makes no sense story-wise because your previous actions are mostly neutral and more like "whatever / don't bother me, I'll do my own thing". But the game makes you the worst person on the planet.

Yes, I played it, yes I finished it. It's not a horrible game, but it's nowhere near as good as Gothic 1-3, Risen or Fallout 1-4. And don't believe that it just has rough edges because it's not a AAA game. No, they messed up several core mechanics. It's not about budget, Gothic 1-3 was not that bad. Gothic 3 had bugs but not such a ridiculous unfair fighting system or boring world.

If you decide to play it nonetheless, be sure to install the Elex Overhaul Mod on Nexusmods. It fixes many (but not all) skill descriptions and balances the game better but it does not make the game really good, but just playable. I installed it after I realized that the vanilla game has wrong skill descriptions.

P.S. I "only" spend 62 h on this game, the rest it was in the background while I was sleeping or doing something else, so the Steam statistic is wrong.
The execution on this game is just HORRIBLE. Do yourself a favor and just skip this one.

一款被贫穷所限制的美式RPG佳作，虽然是由死板的《哥特王朝》系列和《崛起》系列的德国开发商Piranha Bytes所打造，我能想象这款游戏在成品前任务设计师的绝望，这导致了游戏内难度曲线等于没有，以及因为管理不存在而导致地图四面八方塞满了制作组的脑洞。习惯了传统RPG任务模式的玩家可能会不习惯其中各种反套路反常规的设计，这些难得的体验在一般游戏中是无法得到的。所以这款游戏仅推荐阅RPG众多的old ass游玩，只要能忍受粪到极致的手感以及那近乎绝望的难度曲线，最后回报的则是一段难以遗忘的旅程（什么意思玩了就明白了）。
Awsome Game

Минусы:
- Деревянная боёвка,
- Деревянное управление персонажем,
Где в обоих моментах тормознутая реакция персонажа на нажатия мыши и клавиатуры.
- При мощных ударах NPC буквально портируется на короткие дистанции.
- Черепа у "сложных врагов" портящие всё впечатление от ведения боя с этими NPC.
- Несправедливый баланс во многих-многих аспектах игры, из-за чего приходилось ставить модификации.
- Неправильно распределены приоритеты в плане повышения уровня сложности (в плане вашего урона по NPC) ... как и в скурим (но там хоть моды есть)
- Проблемы со звуком: голос гг в бою выше нормы, как и шаги окружающих NPC. Звук дождя порой исчезает.
...
В целом, этой игре крайне не хватает динамики.
А в остальном всё хорошо, из-за чего и положительная оценка.
P. S. Решил вернуться в ELEX спустя года, чтобы вспомнить атмосферу и побегать без jetpack'а и телепортов, уже решил спор в Абессе и взял первого клирика, но потом терпелки не хватило из-за боёвки и решил покинуть игру.

Positiv
+ schöne Grafik
+ flüssige Animationen
+ interessante Charaktere
+ nette Kommentare, die zu den Charakteren und Situationen passen


Negativ
- keine numerische Anzeige, wie viele XP man noch bis zum nächsten Level braucht
- keine Info, wie viel XP man durch Kills oder andere Interaktionen erhält
- es ist nicht möglich den Charakter vor Spielbeginn selbstdefiniert zu starten (Skills/Aussehen)
- es werden bereits zu Spielstart Dialogpfade angeboten, die man gar nicht nutzen kann, weil man sie noch nicht hat (nicht haben kann!)
=> Die Dialogoptionen kann man einfach nicht haben, weil einem die Skillpunkte dazu fehlen. Und die Fähigkeiten. Wobei man die Fähigkeiten aber erst im späteren Spielverlauf erlernen kann, weil man dazu Lehrer braucht. Und diese bringen einem nur was bei, wenn man Skillpunkte hat. Wir drehen uns also im Kreis.
=> Dialogskills gibt es nicht. Die Dialogoptionen ergeben sich aus den Fertigkeiten wie etwa Handwerk (1, 2, usw) und so. Aber die Fertigkeiten hat man am Anfang nicht und kann sie auch nicht so schnell erlernen, weil man dafür bestimmte Skills (Stärke, Intelligenz, usw) braucht. Und die bekommt man nur, wenn man genügend Erfahrung gesammelt hat ...
- Gegner haben keine Levelanzeige
- Gegner werden nicht auf die Stärke des Spielers skaliert (selbst Anfängerquests sind quasi unmöglich)
=> Das gleiche mit den Gegnern. Um stärker zu werden braucht man Skillpunkte. Die bekommt man nur durchs Aufleveln, dass man nur durch Quests und Kills erreicht - wobei Quests größtenteils übermächtige Gegner enthalten, die man nicht besiegen kann. Teufelskreis.
- Erschwerend kommt hinzu, dass man gutes Equip erst bekommt, wenn man ein bestimmtes Ansehen bei einer Fraktion hat. Und Ansehen bekommt man nur, wenn man Quests erledigt. Die man aber größtenteils kaum bewältigen kann, weil das Equip zu schwach ist oder komplett fehlt. Ebenso undurchdacht.


Ich hab jetzt den Anfangs NPC als Begleiter. Aber ich lauf trotzdem von 99% der Gegner weg, weil die zu stark sind.

Another decent RPG from one of my favourite RPG developers.

PB used the same formula which just worked for them for the last 2 decades, but in this title they based the game on a sci-fi setting. As a sci-fi sucker, I am not unfamiliar with this kind of setting however I think they did set up a quite good foundation in this; probably making this the first game for a forthcoming series. 

As in their old titles, you can choose from three factions to start your journey and it is still quite difficult in the beginning if you do not know what you are doing. I always loved the decreasing difficulty in Risen series as you get stronger however Elex is somewhat easier than those games. 

I think the only real thing I did not like in this game is the basic conversations with NPCs. They can improve on that for the upcoming sequels. 

Sound and music goes well with the setting, sure, I can't say "No" for more; more diversity can be added.

Gameplay like in the old titles feels clunky but you will get used to it, so don't give up. As replayability for an RPG, I can say you can exhaust nearly everything with 2 playthroughs; builds end up with similar playstyles in the end. 

All in all, I had really enjoyable time with it and can easily recommend to everyone.

Ein "typisches" Piranha Bytes-Spiel. Kurz gesagt: fehlt an "Polishing", das Spiel hat Ecken und Kanten, aber es glänzt mit einer dichten Atmosphäre sowie einer detailreichen und clever ausgearbeiteten tollen Spielwelt. Story spannend und wendungsreich.  Raue Welt und Umgangston, Schwierigkeitsgrad der Kämpfe zumindest am Anfang des Spiels eher hoch und herausfordernd (lässt sich aber bei Bedarf einstellen). 
Wer eine spannende Geschichte und tolle Spielwelt sucht und sich dabei von diversen kleineren "Macken" nicht abschrecken lässt ist hier gut bedient.
Damit ihr in etwa wisst was ich mit "Macken" meine: kleinere Bugs, Grafik nicht immer auf der Höhe der Zeit, manchmal "hakelige" Steuerung und Kampf, umständliches Inventar, mangelnde Informationen zu Werten des eigenen Chars betreffend.
Ich ärgerte mich manchmal über diese negativ-Punkte, alles in allem aber dennoch in meinen Augen ein wirklich tolles Spiel welches einem in eine interessante Welt und ungewöhnliche Geschichte eintauchen lässt.

Megalan, ami a valóság egy afféle alternatív univerzuma, egykor egy virágzó civilizációnak adott otthont, míg egy jókora üstökös a bolygóba nem csapódott. Az emberek nagy része eltűnt, úgy ahogy az állatok is, helyüket mutáns szörnyek színes - szagos hordái vették át, az egykori emberek életére már csak megmaradt kietlen ipartelepei, apartmanjai és romok között fellelt hangfelvételek és írásos dokumentumok utalnak. A maradék túlélők közösségekbe tömörültek és területeket uralnak.

Dacára az armageddonnak, Megalan egy színes, sokarcú világ. Abessza a Vagdalkozók hazája, a normann kultúrára hajazó nép vezére és egyben törvényhozója Ragnar, aki nem tűri a technológiát birodalmában, drákói a szigor, harcosaik mágiát és középkori eszközöket használnak, amiket akár varázserővel is ellátnak, így azok megfelelnek az új kor elvárásainak. Földjeik, hegyeik zöldellnek, a 100%-ig természetességre törekvő bio-vikingek a Földanya harcosai.
Ignadon vulkanikus vidékei barátságtalanabb hangulatúak, lakói a kis létszámú, de számát harci robotokkal és csúcstechnológiával kompenzáló Klérus, akik az ún. Öreg Világ technológiáját továbbgondoló tudósok. Istenük Calaan, kinek odaajánlják mindenük, specialitásuk a tudatmódosító Psi-erő.
Tavar sivatagos tájain a Törvényen Kívüliek az urak, istenük csak a pénz, fővárosuk az Erőd, mely egyben hadműveleteik központja is. Bevételük nagy részét a roncsvadászat és fosztogatás teszi ki. Fegyvereik a jelen kor sörétes puskái, rakétavetői, halálos gránátvetők gazdag repertoárja.
Az Albok a legészakibb havas területeket tartják ellenőrzésük alatt, egy agresszív frakció, akiknek terve a világuralom, ennek érdekében képesek bárkit eltiporni, nem elégszenek meg azzal ami épp van, az első ránézésre puszta önzésnek tűnő célok mögött olyan indokok és magyarázatok rejteznek, amikre a történet fő szála épül. Az Albok Vezére a titokzatos lény, a Hibrid, a fejlesztéseket és a hadsereget is ő irányítja. Főhősünk is közülük kerül ki, egy egykori Alb parancsnok, Jax egy küldetés során gépével lezuhan, ám hamarosan rájön hogy elárulták, a világ amely körülveszi teljesen ellene van. Tudja, egyedül a halál fia, szövetségesekre lesz szüksége... 
Mikor a halált hozó égi istencsapása a földre hullott, magával hozott mást is, egy idegen anyagot, mely egyben áldás is és átok. Az Elex-et mindenki másra használja. A Vagdalkozók átalakítják azt, hogy varázserejüket erősítse, a Törvényen Kívüliek kereskednek vele, az Albok nyersen fogyasztják, racionális gyilkológéppé alakítva személyiségüket. Máris látszik, az Elex olyan anyag ami meghatározza Megalan jelenét és jövőjét, de még mennyire...

A játék grafikája csodásan néz ki, zenére sem lehet panasz, hatalmas sandbox vár a játékosra, limit nélkül begyűjthető tárgyak tömegei, sokágú fejlődésrendszer, ugyancsak korlátozás nélküli mentés. Mint a régi szép időkben! Minimális bugok, pl néhány tárgy olyan helyen van ahova nem vezet út. Pl föld alá, romok között, stb, de igazából ennyi. Begyűjthető ékkövek is vannak, fotók a fejlesztőkről, amiket megszerezhetünk innen-onnan. Nem olcsó program, de remek kaland, melynek többféle befejezése is lehetséges, viszont mindegyik variációban közös, hogy Megalan története még koránt sem ért véget...

This game has a huge Gothic vibe with post apocalyptic and sci-fi elements. If You are a fan of the 3 things I mentioned before, this game is a MUST BUY! 90% Gothic rule system added extras that places this game in a perfect new environment... What can I say, Piranha bytes made something really unique again. Combat is more modern but serves punishment in an exact way as Gothic did... I see people whining about it because EVERY action you make has influence on the outcome of the combat, just like in Gothic. What they didn't lack also, is creativity. Creating a huge map with such diversity and also the cities... City construction is genius, I don't think I saw this anywhere else... Nice new feature is an autosave system. As I saw in every 5 or 10 minutes the game saves itself to ANOTHER SLOT. That applies also for quicksave, thankfully it's saved to different slots every time. For all RPG lovers who like to have worlds where all your actions have consequences, this is at least a must try game.

I played the Gothic and Risen series growing up and really enjoyed those games. Elex captures a lot of the classic PB features such as distinct factions, player freedom, and difficult power curve. However, Elex fails horribly in combat design for 3 main reasons:

1. There is an unnecessarily long input delay that forces you to have to predict what action you want to do next which ruins melee combat. 
2. The hit boxes and environment make for an extremely frustrating experience.
3. The character power curve is horribly designed. You struggle for far too long early game and become unstoppable for a large portion of the end game. I killed the final boss by shooting a few times before the boss could respond.

Although I wish PB success, I cannot recommend this game because Elex literally has the worst combat system of any game I have ever played. It's unfortunate because you can easily see what they were going for, but the execution was beyond horrible.

Игра идёт за пафосного и туповатого викинга с джетпаком. В добавок к пафосу прилагается абсолютное бессилие. Почти всю игру не будет возможности дать опор никому кроме ослабленной, больной курицы.
В игре убит баланс. Враги непобедимы, убивают с одного двух ударов, сами требуют для убийства ударов около сотни. Если вообще могут быть ранены. Сюжет? Ну может он есть, но смотреть как викинг ходит по развалинам современных городов - противоречиво, а в основном даже смешно. И по этому особо до сюжета идти не было желания.
Играть можно только если вы фанат студии как и я, но крайне не рекомендую этого делать.

I'm redoing this review after having gotten past the start of the game. If you buy this game be sure to read what I've written here as it will help you immensely. 

I previously said that the game's main issue is balance. That's not necessarily true. Instead I now think the game's main issue is poor communication. There are many ways the game seems to suggest for players to play a specific way or do a specific thing but in reality that thing is impossible and playing that way will make it much harder. 

What do I mean by this? Well, here's an example of a way in which poor level design can misdirect players: You've been following a quest. It tells you to get some treasure from an island in a lake. You swim to the island, from the direction of the quest origin there's a clear path leading toward the centre, so you go toward the centre. In the centre you can see a huge monster in a clearing. Behind it you see the quest item. What do you do? 

Most players would assume that the path leading you to the monster in a clearing and the item being behind the monster means that this monster is a boss and you should fight it in order to earn the quest objective. The presentation of these different environmental aspects is telling the player that that's what they should do. 

In Elex, that is not what you should do. 
Instead of being a tough but manageable boss in the centre, you just have a hyper leveled monster that you have no chance against. This is how the game communicates poorly with the players. 

You might also see things like perks that give you long term bonuses the sooner you take them. Don't take them. You'll end up sinking your stat points into useless stats and will be unable to fight any enemies because you won't have the stats to equip any better gear. 

Dialogue options are another area in which the game misguides a bit. 
The skill based dialogue options never affect the quests. Unlike games like Fallout or Skyrim passing a skill check only gives you some exp and maybe some items, then you continue the conversation as normal. So you don't have to do what I did and wait until you have the stats before continuing your quests. I'm pretty sure all the items you get are just bonus normal items, rather than weapons, armour, or anything else that would be useful. 

There is no inventory limit, so fill your pockets with everything you can find. You can steal pretty easily too and there are no consequences, other than for specific quest items that you're stealing for a quest. I'd also suggest you keep most things until you have an idea of what they're used for, and then sell what you don't want. The only categories that are never used for crafting, quests or as a consumable are 'junk' and 'valuables'. Feel free to sell all of those. 

When exploring, think vertically too. There are a lot of items hidden on roofs. If you see a particularly high place then you can usually bet on there being some items at the top. For example, after getting the jet pack you can return to the top of the lift and get on top of the building it's in. There are a number of goodies up there that you wouldn't get otherwise. 

The combat is clunky and annoying. Most of the enemies will kill you easily. My best advice for the start of the game is DON'T SWITCH TO THE RUSTY AXE. It's awful. The pipe you start with has a special that hits 3 times. Since damage is based on your combo bar, take a few swings to get used to spacing your clicks to build the maximum amount. You only really do worthwhile damage toward the end of the combo. This is why the 3 hit special is way better, because it can only be performed once you have at least half a combo meter and is usually used at the end of a combo, therefore having a lot of damage. 

Aim to upgrade to a better weapon as soon as possible. I used a broadsword for most of my early game and it was so much better. It only needs 7 extra points placed in strength and dex to wield. 
I would also suggest you complete Duras' (the first guy you meet, you can't miss him) quest line as soon as possible. It's a lot of travelling and you'll have to avoid monsters when heading north but having a companion makes fighting much much easier. 

The start of the game can be difficult but hopefully if you follow my tips here then you'll have a relatively painless start, unlike mine. Before my second new game I was recommending people avoid this game even if it were free, haha. 

Now I would recommend that people pick this game up when it's on sale. I wouldn't say it's worth £40. Getting it at 75%, or more, off would be a good price but it's probably still worth it at 50% off.

ELEX es un RPG al que yo personalmente le encuentro luces y sombras casi a partes iguales, y es que la premisa del juego es muy interesante, un mundo postapocaliptico en el que han surgido distintas facciones que han desarrollado sus potenciales de magia, tecnología, etc. según sus distintos ideales gracias al recurso que llegó con el cometa que impactó contra el planeta, el elex. Por desgracia esta premisa, que repito, es muy interesante, se ve ensombrecida de manera inmediata por una mecánica de combate bastante frustrante, poco pulida, que recuerda a juegos de generaciones pasadas...

Añádele a esto la problemática de que, al comienzo del juego, casi cualquier enemigo te va a partir la cara con mucha facilidad y tienes el cóctel de frustración e ira perfecto. El sistema de habilidades parece no tener apenas efecto hasta que no has avanzado mucho, las armas, están ligadas a tus habilidades, es decir, de nada sirve que encuentres al principio un arma muy chetada, porque no vas a tener las habilidades adecuadas para poder usarla, esto, en principio me parecería correcto, si los enemigos comunes del juego fueran fáciles de eliminar, el problema es que en seguida te entra la sensación de que estuvieras jugando una especie de intento de Dark Souls (por lo facil que te revienta cualquier cosa) pero con mecánicas de la PS1, en serio, muy frustrante. 

Al final, en cuanto avanzas un poco te das cuenta de que la mejor solución ante la ausencia de poder usar armas lo suficientemente potentes con las que eliminar enemigos radica en comprar granadas, ya que si no, cuando te encuentres con alguno duro de roer, no le vas a hacer ni cosquillas. Solo hacia el final del juego, a partir de las 28-30 horas ha sido cuando he empezado a disponer y poder utilizar un equipamiento fuerte con el que poder reventar a casi todo con lo que me iba cruzando.

Por no hablar del sistema de "Frialdad" una característica de tu personaje que cambiará dependiendo de las opciones de diálogo que elijas, así como de la cantidad de bebidas de elex que consumas, el cual aporta enormes beneficios sobre todo al principio. Esta "Frialdad", dependiendo de si está alta o baja, te impedirá directamente tomar ciertas opciones de diálogo en ciertos puntos, cambiando totalmente la historia por completo. Por lo que la liberta de decisión se ve semi-coartada desde un principio en base a las respuestas que vayas dando en ciertos puntos, limitando el final o finales que podrás elegir. No es como en otros juegos, que una decisión tiene una consecuencia y luego tienes que decidir en base a esa consecuencia, no, aquí está mucho más "dirigido" por decirlo de alguna manera.

Y no me malinterpretes, me lo he pasado bien jugando a Elex, lo he disfrutado, pero me ha costado y mucho disfrutarlo debido a todo lo malo que tiene. No obstante, esto no quita que me sienta decepcionado con los desarrolladores, teniendo en cuenta que son los que han parido Gothic y Risen, me esperaba un juego mucho mejor.

Así que si en algún momento te has planteado jugarlo, adelante, pero yo te recomendaría esperar a una rebaja.

[spoiler]这个游戏的制作组丝毫不考虑玩家的游戏体验，虽然可能他后期剧情能拿得出手，但是前期高强度劝退能撑到后期的真的是会受到精神和耐心的双重考验。
1.狂战士村落作为新手村，有很多任务非常令人迷惑，比如 第一个队友入队任务要跑到离村落很远的五个方向分别调查五个嫌疑人，路边怪不说几乎，是全都打不过（普通难度）。虽然有喷气背包脱战很容易，但让我强烈感觉是因为这个背包太灵活所以才放置这么多打不过的怪的。
2.为什么打不过呢？近战手感极其僵硬，翻滚和格挡先不说消耗耐力巨大，格挡挡住了也掉好多血，我是图什么？？？而且即使你快速理解了无法形容的睿智技能点＆技能系统，准确地直接点到了能拿小斧子的技能条件，也是开局升很多级之后了，在这之前你就拿个扳手砸吧。
3.除了战斗系统问题，地图上敌人的等级设置也非常迷惑，我升了几级之后在新手村附近溜达有勉强能打过的也有骷髅头血条的，走到地图另一边仍然是有勉强能打过的也有骷髅头血条的，请问这个等级分布是怎么安排的？就我观察，怕不是摇骰子分布的？因为哪里都是很均匀的巨大方差分布，不管你走到哪里都是满地怪追着我跑，时不时窜出俩骷髅头怪怪把我秒了，开荒开图跑路的时候体验巨尼玛差，多次差点把电脑砸了。我再也不喷育碧等级墙弱智了。
4.非常不自由且令人迷惑的任务设计。怎么不自由呢？第一条里写的要跑好远调查五个人，就没有撒谎选项直接结案（即使你要求的口才在初期根本达不到我也认了）；又比如牧师势力让我去抓买毒品的内鬼，我应付内鬼的时候就只能选隐瞒或者举报，选了隐瞒的话回去汇报任务就是默认隐瞒没有选项，这种任务难道不是默认选收益最大的口头答应隐瞒+举报吗？我觉得这个游戏很多地方都是默认某些信息所有人共享，所以有些明显应该有骗人的选项的地方都没有，但游戏的世界观里并没有体现这一点。怎么迷惑呢？这个游戏升级给属性点，技能要去找不同特长的商人花钱+满足属性点要求的情况才能学。先不说新手要怎么在无引导的情况下合理加点，新手村的任务好多要2~4级某项特长专精点数是不是太过分了？这是要怎么满足？还有的任务表面上有多重解决方案，然而刚进新手村战斗力负数，于是战斗方案排除；技能点不够，说服方案排除；竟然只剩下花钱消灾方案，我能不能强行空过这个任务啊我求你了，前期没几百全砸任务上了呜呜呜呜呜、最后找领主汇报，领主告诉我那个人把我菊爆了，当场翻脸。
我 T M 花 钱 消 灾 的 钱 就 这 么  喂 狗 了？？？？？？？？？
原来这是一个开局新手村任务里给你设计需要你倒贴钱还扣势力声望的游戏。
结论：无法顺利游玩。玩了各种老游戏烂游戏之后才发觉能正常玩这点是多么难能可贵啊。我再也不黑育碧流水线游戏了。[/spoiler]

然而我拿到牧师的黑洞枪之后！！体验直接翻100倍，在野外横着走！！没错就是warframe里那个黑洞枪，相似率90%，集输出，控场，AOE，dot于一身的神器！！
刚通关了，想说如果忽略战斗，这个游戏整体真的蛮不错的。给之后想玩的人写一些建议吧。
1.战斗难度：牧师黑洞枪very easy 手雷流easy 远程流normal 近战流very very very very very hard（请勿初期尝试）初期战斗力负数请灵活运用喷气背包和存档回避战斗
2.第一个到的狂战士村落不是新手村！！不是新手村！！不是新手村！！重要的事情说三遍
整体来看地图右侧的盗贼城任务算最简单的 东北角的牧师中等（主要是晋升容易） 最开始到的狂战士村算很难的 有各种反人类任务 所以最开始遇到棘手的任务一定不要头铁强行做 而是优先挑开图的任务解锁传送点（传送点非常难找而且没说哪里有，实在郁闷可以查攻略，地图显示传送点的技能要求技能点过多前期很难点上）
3.如果主黑洞枪，只需要点化学家然后留意收集一下那些零件就行了，很常见（捡垃圾实在是太爽了，负重无上限）；主手雷的话盗贼村卖的多；主远程的话弓在狂战士村，枪械主要还是牧师那边；近战自求多福吧。
4.任务选中后按Z在地图上标记。说实话99%任务不标我根本不知道在哪。
5.注意回收奖励。比如A请求你把他从监狱里救出去，为此需要找他的队友B想办法，B告诉你方法之后回去救人，A给你奖励，请注意任务到这里就结束了，但很多时候回去找B也有奖励。总之多留意对话。
6.加入牧师不一定要跑到地图右上角，我是在野外开图的时候遇到了传教三人组，直接传送过去了

总之还是很推荐喜欢剧情向RPG的玩家试一下的

Elex is a good game. Very much in the vein of the risen games and gothic. The story in this game is superior to risen and the combat is similar (janky but good). The only problem with Elex is that the progression is not smooth. Levels are very slow to achieve early on and very fast to achieve later in the game. Typically you would want faster leveling earlier and slower leveling later for a balanced game. Also, the equipment does not gain damage gradually but in large chunks. This means that one minute you are very underpowered and then the next level of equipment is almost overpowered. The game gets better in the second half after most of this unbalanced leveling has been pretty much completed.  Additionally damage is driven by equipment and to a smaller degree with skills but player attributes do not add to damage at all - they are just necessary for new equipment. The game would work better if increasing attributes had a direct effect of player abilities. Having said that, the game is definitely worth getting if you are used to janky style combat.

There are a lot of single character action RPGs, so if you're going to grab me you've got to offer me something interesting or I'm just going to go back and play Oblivion or Skyrim or Witcher 3 or Mass Effect or one of the other many good ones again.  If you can hook me in within the first 15 minutes (which Elex did) I'll give you an hour or two to really convince me that your story is going to be worth investing 50 hours of my life and the short version here is that Elex didn't.

The graphics are nice, but not enough to say "Oh my gosh, I HAVE to see more of this world."  The combat and exploration is pretty standard fare for this type of thing except you have a jet pack which just didn't come off as cool as it ought to be.

As for the story, at first it seemed unique but quickly fell into the usual stuff.  Even though there are laser guns and fighter planes a lot of us still use swords (of course.)  My character speaks with a very deep, gravelly, "Christian Bale doing Batman" type voice which just comes off as trying too hard.  Apparently the world has four factions and I used to be one of the Bad Guys but now they're against me because my ship was shot down doing some mission that wasn't really explained so now I'm getting recruited to join the Berserker faction who's king is Ragnar because, of course, if you're going to be King of the Vikings you better damned well be named Ragnar, and I'm getting the hard sell on it even though I haven't even met the other factions yet...

 "Tell me, gravelly voice guy, what can I do to put you behind the wheel of this 1997 Dodge Neon today?"... 

and they want me to do a bunch of missions to prove my worth to them and they're things they can't do themselves because even though I have crappy equipment and am wandering around their town like a lost kitten my being New Around Here gives me a fresh perspective on things that will clearly help me succeed where they can't.  

But to be honest I think I probably ought to be trying to figure out why my old buddies suddenly hate me, and now there's a guy from the Clerics who's trying to buy my stuff and sounds kind of shady, and it's been like 2 hours and I've just been talking to people about all their various problems and haven't got to kill anything which might be my fault because instead of talking to people maybe I ought to be out exploring on my own but that doesn't feel right to me either because all these poor people seem to have things they want to tell me...

It's all just kind of a big mess.  Games with good stories dump you into the action immediately and ease you into the story bit by bit otherwise you lose interest.  I lost interest.  Maybe there's a good game in here and if I had spent my last $20 on Elex and didn't have any other games to play I might be motivated to dig it out.  But playing this just makes me want to play the games that I already know do the action RPG thing really well, even if I *have* already seen their stories, because they tell those stories so much better.

Great game. Interesting take on good vs evil and instead being emotional vs logical and Jax's struggle to use emotion. Even though the logical choice is meant to be the "bad" ending. There are 3 endings and by playing through you will understand which decisions will lead to you to what.
Decisions are meaningful but not to the point where you should be reloading. eg. a dead trader will be replaced if killed. Combat is quite challenging at the beginning, I strongly recommend having a follower and speccing into combat skills first, and playing on normal. I don't like that all "builds" have to have both melee and ranged weapons. Melee weapons are easy to understand and should be used every time. Some enemy animations are very quick and are a bit unfair but overall they have telegraphed attacks. Stat system is the same as the Gothic games where points into attributes only unlock skills, spells, weapons etc and don't actually alter your character. eg. Using a rusty axe while having 100 strength or 10 strength will net you the same damage but having 100 strength will allow you to use top tier weapons where as 10 strength won't.

Visuals are nice but you should get the darkness mod because the nights are ridiculously bright that if I hadn't seen the moon I wouldn't have known about the day/night cycle. Art style is kind of generic for the most part except the high tech areas. Desert felt like New Vegas and not Gothic 3.
Music and sound effects are good but not as good as the old Gothic games and the atmosphere falls a little flat.

Overall a game I would definitely recommend to ARPG, Gothic, and Risen fans. I look forward to the next installment.

73 hours of playtime to complete! If you like the other Piranha Bytes game then youll love this one. The story/plot is very good but the voice acting isnt stellar. It is truly an open world game with lots of main quests and subquests you find all over the place. Im not sure that I even got to all of them. In fact, there are a bunch you cant play because you end up chosing a faction and then cant play the main quests for the others. 

The graphics are good IMO and the sound is good too. Gameplay is fairly good too. You can climb mountains and use a jet pack to get just about anywhere! Reminds me of playing MMOs and wondering what was up on the high mountain. In this game you can often go up there! Many times youll find some kind of reward.

Combat is just OK. My big complaint is the targeting system. When you have your weapon out and are close to a mob then that mobs is automatically targeted. You can switch targets left and right by hitting buttons but it is cumbersome while you are trying to fight. So fighting groups of mobs is a bitch. Sometimes I would end up attacking a friendly.

You also meet companions, which is great. They group with you and help fight. THe very beginning of the game will have you dying over and over, it is difficult. Once you level up some and get the hang of things it gets a lot easier. By the end game it was easy for me. It much like MMOs with skills, potions, armor,weapons, etc;. There is crafting where you can make new things or upgrade existing. You can put magic on them too! Lots to do.

Don’t get me wrong THQ Nordic is the company of some of my favorite games like Red Faction, Darksiders, Destroy All Humans, and Metro just to name a few but this game is not one of them.

Pros:
	-Vast open world
	-Interesting story, and quests
	-variety of characters to interact with
	-Fusion between post-apocalyptic sci-fi and fantasy
	-many things to see and do
Cons:
	-The game emphasizes player choice but for the most part don’t give you many options, for example there are 3 major factions, if you joined one to see what they’re like and don’t enjoy it then too bad, you are locked in that faction for that playthrough, oh and you must join a faction the game doesn't allow you to really advance the plot otherwise.
	-I mentioned the variety of characters, yes but most of these people are majority just a$$holes, in one way or another and the ones that aren't are few and far from each other, I get that it is a post-apocalyptic setting but hell dark souls had Solaire, Vamos, and a handful of others and they were stuck in a sort of hell
	-bugs, some of them are minor issues like the player character is clipping into a wall a bit or the companion AI would run to hit the monster way over level than you can handle, but a major bug I found was if you are using a ranged weapon like a bow, and you get knocked down while aiming then you can no longer fire that weapon, there is an easy fix of just unequipping and re-equipping it but in a middle of a fight that can be bothersome
	-misleading or deceptive description, so you level up and you want to increase your health, you see Constitution - “Toughness describes physical conditioning. It permanently increases the energy and unlocks Items and Abilities.” so you take it and your health doesn't really increase, why? Well that is simple it follows the elder scrolls oblivion approach of increasing the max health gained upon reaching a new level just not this one because it already happened but for the next one, but it never mentions levels at all
	-slower action RPG, in this game they took the hey heard that dark souls was successful because it was a hard game approach, if hard translate to most mob enemies is able to kill you in 1 to 3 hits all the way to the late game where you actually get some armour that lets you take a soft tap on the shoulder without immediately falling over and bleeding out and most creatures shrug off most of your attacks

After everything said and done it is a better game than others that tries to be something like this but it did not live up to its full potential. So in my opinion it is about 6/10, it has some things going for it but the faults really dragged it down.

Some people will look at the number of hours I have on record for this game and scratch their heads. I wrote a walkthrough for the game, that is why I have so much time logged. I wrote a really big review where I broke everything down... but the site kept on rejecting it for some reason. So here is the short short short version:

The Good:

- Open-world and beautiful. This is probably the games strongest point. 
- Companions are better than Bethesda games, not as good as good as Bioware games. 

On the Fence:

- Nothing in Elex is randomized except enemy spawns. Some will love this, others wont.
- The faction choices are not evenly balanced.  Clerics have the most powerful perks.
- The weapons are not evenly balanced. Arrows do more damage than plasma or grenades.
- The Story is a rather basic revenge plot. 
- The game is frustratingly difficult. Rats can kill you with 2 bites up to about level 15.

The Bad:

- You cant play as female or customize the protagonists appearance. 
- The protagonist talks like a robot.  
- The Music sounds like the background of a cheap porno flick.
- You cant customize companion gear or weapons.
- The game forces you to play as someone you probably can't relate too. (So much for RPG)

The Ugly:

- The crafting system is useless. Ingredients are priced higher than the items you create are worth. (Like ammo). Why spend 17 shards to craft 1 shotgun shell, when you can buy a pre-made shotgun shell for 2? 
- The german to english translation failed horribly. Expect confusion.This one was so bad, I almost didn't recommend the game. 

Summary:

The world of Elex is unique enough for me to recommend it despite some of its bigger  flaws. But dont pay full price for this game. Wait until you can get it on sale for 30 or less. Check out Greedfall for a similar and much more polished game.

The setting is quite a good one, with its own lore and logic creating a pretty interesting concept. wat is quite terrible, is the execution. The combat is bogged with consolitis, relying on your seemingly asthmatic main character who handles like a semi-truck to fight one of, like, three sets of reused attack patterns for the mutants. The game comes with a leveling and skill system, which will be your only hope to get anything. Even though you gain skill points every level, you require money to actually use them.
Maybe at this point you are thinking that you should then avoid melee and go for ranged. Again, ammunition is limited to vendors and you need moolah. on top of this, every weapon of note requires multiple levels just to use them, and the weapons themselves are, again, vendor exclusive. That Alb that just was killed painstakingly? no weapon from him. all weapons poof out of existence on death so you have to contribute to the local market.

In very short, it's a clunky grindfest. and with even the low level enemies being too strong for your arthritic main character to fight more than one at any time, you have to sink in hours to level up, and PERHAPS, you can finally do stuff.

This games dope! Its like a AAA game that's a little rough around "some" edges. Nothing serious though, from what I've played thus far. I've barely even scratched the surface at this point though. I am about what? 20 hours or so in now, and I'm getting more hooked as I go. Combat can be a little funky with its stupid auto, auto lock that gets annoying sometimes. Probably because I forgot how to un stick the auto lock on enemy. Either way its a fun game, good story, interesting world to explore. Plenty of side missions (which I love). It's like a game that was created by fallout, elder scroll(ish), and some cyber punk espue love triangle. Lately I have been having a problem with finding games to actually get sunk into....well this game is one that is relieving that issue.

Bias disclosure: I'm a fan of Pyranha Byte games and I played this games 3 times, trying each faction and multiple playstyles in the process. Also some spoilers ahead, mostly for Sidequests tho.

Elex is unlike previous Pyranha Byte games (Gothic 1&2, Risen 1~3). The world is completely open to explore from the moment you leave the tutorial area and no sidequest is locked behind story progression. This is reminiscecnt of Gothic 3 Quest design and considering that 3 out of the 4 Biomes elex has to offer (Forest, Snow tundra & Desert) are exactly the same as the ones you find in Gotchic 3 leads me to believe Elex is a more realized version of what PB was going for back in 2006. 

The world is very big, beautifully crafted and fun to explore but it feels more empty when it comes to findable quests. Most of quest givers are located in towns and there are very few of them in the wilderness. This feels like a missed opportunity and something I hope Elex 2 will improve on. Similarly the lack of new Side-quests being unlocked as you progress through the story felt unsatisfying. The findable gems require too many copies to upgrade into the highest tier sockets. You basically need to find all of them to get the highest tier which kills the usefullness of Gems like "Quest EXP+" since you're more likely to find the last one after completing most quests. I also have mixed feelings about the "Radioactive/cold/warm/poisoned" areas. They feel like an artificial way to halt your exploration and i could honestly do without them. If there is one thing I found very disappointing it has to be the Thieves Guild. Finding it is nearly impossible since the enterence isn't as intuitively hidden as in Gothic 2. Despite finding the members of the Thieves guild in the 3 major cities there was no NPC that gave you hints at where the guild is located. Depending on your choices the Guild can Die or leave to the (i assume) part of the world where Elex 2 takes place in so if the canon says that they survived I really hope that their hideout will be more easy to find.

The combat is serviceable. Melee combat feels almost good but the Stamina drains way too fast during the beginning of the game and regenerates way too slowly when being attacked by enemies. I feel like Stamina should be something that increases with your level ups instead of needing a Perk. Infact Melee combat needs too many Perks to become viable, You have your standard 3 level Damage up perk, 2 level Stamina Up perk, 2 level Attack Power Perk, 2 level Parry Power perk, 2 level of Finisher Power perk, 1 level Jet Pack attack. Meanwhile Magic has 2 Perks, one for Damage and one for Mana/Energy and Ranged Combat only has 2 Damage up Perks, split between Light and Heavy weapons. Because of this, Melee combat feels absolutely garbage in the first half of the playthrough and ultimately the reason why so many people get a Plasma/Energy rifle or Flamethrower asap instead. This system really needs an overhaul for Elex 2 otherwise we will have exactly the same problem. 

The story felt okay but not incredibly interesting. As soon as I heard the name "Zardom" I knew "Oh that's gonna be the backstabbing Xardas/Inquisitor insert". Companion questlines similarly feel too short. Duras for example can be easily finished in chapter 1 and then he has nothing to do for chapter 2, 3 and 4. Ray's story however see's new things added throughout the story and I really liked the moment in chapter 4 where he sacrafices himself for you to pay off his debt. However him surviving that stunt felt unneccesary... 
Arx is probably the most underdeveloped companion and its way too easy to piss him off since he's religiously agreeing with his faction, despite being banished. Falk, Nasty and Caja honestly feel like the most well developed companions however I find it really sad that killing Konrad has no consequences for Falk's story. Speaking of Consequences i also find it sad that you can simply buy your way out of trouble after messing up too many quests for the Berserks. It cheapens the choices you made previously which is a shame because in every other instance this isn't the case. If you tell nasty you dont care about her sickness she leaves you, if you expose the truth about Duras he's gonna try to kill you and will die for ever if you survive the fight. Similarly depending on your choices in Abessa the City either kills all of the Outlaws and Separatists or is swarmed by Albs because you helped them sabotage the clerics. 

The three factions all have unique perks to offer which allows new playstyles  to unfold however i found the Outlaws to be the most lacking faction. They have no Mage option, which is fine, but their unique gimmick is to make Stims without needing recipes. Which means that their unique aspect isn't even that unique since you can make and use stims as the other factions as well... Similarly their perk to dismantle weapons feels weak since enemies haven't dropped their weapons since Risen 2 and finding weapons out in the open is very rare. Additionaly there is no way to disnamtle Legendary equipment which is a missed opportunity since these weapons could provide exclusive materials (once dismantled) that are needed to craft a super powerful weapon. This would give Outlaws more uniqueness and they could more easily compete with the other factions because as it is currently the Clerics can do everything better and more.

To compare systems with previous PB games I must applaud on the leveling system. Previously the leveling systems were designed in such a way that drinking permanent stat potions early on would waste resources and this has been plauging PB games as late as Risen 3. Elex finally has a system where is doesn't matter at which point in the game you drink permanent stat potions which i really enjoyed. I also welcome that drinking potions mid combat finally leaves you vurnerable again and that the menu no longer pauses the game like in Risen 2 and 3. I also liked that the Skillchecks during dialogue dont need a specific stat but instead need a stat that increases each time you learn a perk that belongs to that category. I also like the World of Elex a lot. At first i thought having Medieval berserks next to High tech clerics next to Fallout-like Outlaws would break my suspension of disbelief but it didn't feel that way once i spent more hours with the game. 

Overall I really enjoyed my time with the game. It's definitely not for everybody but I think this game is good enough to be called a rough hidden gem which is something i really can't say about Risen 2 and 3 since these two games were such a downgrade from Risen 1 both in the story and Gameplay.

С продукцией от "Пираний..." у меня сложные отношения. Я фанат двух "Готик", но вот все последующий творения вызывали у меня лишь скуку или открытую ненависть. До сего момента. Это первая игра, которая оставила у меня в душе положительный след. Не столь сильный, конечно, как именитая дилогия, но всё же. 
Геймплейно это все те же "Пираньи..." - обязательные фракции с обязательным выбором между ними; герой-одиночка, которого в начале угнетает каждая мокрица, а в конце не может остановить армия боевых роботов-убийц; квесты из разряда "пойди туда, не знаю куда; принеси то, не знаю что; и быстро!". Меня подобное скорее привлекает, чем отталкивает; однако следует иметь в виду и быть готовым.
А вот в плане пресловутой "атмосферы" наследовать "Готику" наконец-то не пытались. И слава Ктулху! А то вышел бы очередной "Райзен". Мир "Элекса" ближе, как бы странно это не звучало, серии "Сталкер". Ну, или "Фоллаут", если вы труЪ олдскулл и всё такое :). Эклектичная пост-апокалиптическая смесь из былого мира и новой, неизведанной жизни, которая нашла себе место на его развалинах. Вот тут всё как полагается - пустоши, мутанты, развалины старых зданий и сооружений, бандиты, торговцы, лут, куча всяких ЛОР-ных записок, дневников и сообщений. Куча непонятных событий и предметов. Этот мир, наконец-то, интересно просто исследовать. Особенно во второй половине игры, когда персонажу уже не нужно с воплями убегать от любой курицы-переростка. :)
Игре однозначно следует дать шанс. Из всего, что вышло после "Ночи Ворона" - это лучшее у "Пираний...".

[b]我先把关于战斗恼人的解决方案提出来：[/b]
1.  一进游戏先去更改难度，可以自定义！
2. 开局就躲在杜拉斯（队友）后面猥琐就对了！
3. 不要到处旅行，先到狂战士村和npc都对话把支线都接了，大部分支线都是可以避免战斗的！升级先升力量再升敏捷（开局没有好的远程武器，先去换上摄政王剑。之后可以换电浆步枪升级可用到通关。）
4. 赚钱！偷窃来钱相当快，再不行百度怎么用[b]【四房间内容2】[/b]刷钱。
5. 买一两百个[b]【手雷】[/b]，扔就vans了。
6. 用钱购买大量的[b]【烈酒】[/b]和[b]【天然奥能】[/b]，穹顶城里的独立分子会卖[b]【奥能药剂】[/b]制作书，疯狂合成奥能药剂喝喝喝，天下无敌！
[spoiler]7 . 宁要是实在嫌麻烦，那直接开修改器得了，体验剧情！体验生活！[/spoiler]

[b]下面是我在ELEX的世界中畅游了60个小时的原因：[/b]
1. 故事背景简单，但是却足够吸引人。我在狂战士村落能体验到上古卷轴般的风情，在土匪窝能有置身于辐射4的错觉，在牧师大本营里又是质量效应的既视感。每到一个新的主城，我室友都会问我，诶你怎么又换游戏了哈哈。
2.场景相当有特色。森林、荒漠、火山以及冰天雪地，整体上这些不同的地形地貌都会令人影响深刻。细看那些坐落在各个角落的建筑废墟，说不定房顶上又藏着一把传奇武器，而藏在床头的戒指和项链又可以帮你省去5个属性点的麻烦。
3. 收集党的福利。无限容量的背包，种类繁多的武器，拉风又帅气的护甲，各种密码解密，什么锅碗瓢盆能拿的全都拿！
4. 有生命的世界。每一次选择都会对未来造成影响，你常常会被迫处于道德的抉择，后果都由自己承担，因此，我能感受到这是属于我自己的故事。（每次对话前存档都没用，有些影响可能过很久才会有效果）
5. 每一个阵营都有让你提升军衔的任务，从最低层次的官一步步爬到最顶层是一件很有趣的事，不同的等级还有不同的护甲可以买。不仅如此，狂战士部落真的相当有归属感！[spoiler]（sorry，我还是选了亲儿子牧师）[/spoiler]
6. 和队友之间有相当多的互动，每一个队友也都性格分明。同样的选择，有的队友好感度upup，有些就down。把好感度从【没有特别的喜好】->【尊重】->【喜欢】->【欣赏】->【视你为偶像】->【真正的朋友】->【爱人】就像玩galgame一样。[spoiler]当卡雅终于说她爱我的时候真的很幸福555[/spoiler]
7. 没有人不喜欢雷伊，他一个人能说一路单口相声，队友里的快乐源泉哈哈哈。
8. 音乐相当有存在感，村落中宁静悠扬，牧师城辉宏激昂，土匪窝凌冽萧瑟，战斗时又会让人一听就紧张起来。不过有时候BGM太大了，听不清人物对话了都。
9. 每一个支线任务的精彩程度都不输 “巫师3” ，每一个任务都有它存在的意义，或让人不禁莞尔一笑，或让人感慨万分，比某些公式化的游戏不知道high到哪里去了！[spoiler]（没错我捧一踩一了）[/spoiler]
10. 玩ELEX时间总是过得很快，不知不觉间我就已经走过了那么远的路（没车没马我有什么办法），已经做了那么多任务，好多头上顶着名字的NPC我都和他们对过话，一开始的阴谋也在游戏的最后一刻被揭露，到那时我才意识到，游戏已经玩到了尾声，属于我的故事已经结束了。

[b]这真的是一段值得去回味的游戏历程，麻雀虽小却五脏俱全，不论是战斗和选择都紧张刺激又处处暗藏惊喜。[/b]

Те кто пишут, что прошёл игру за 30 часов, что вы вообще в игре делали то? Я с города берсерков выбирался за 12 часов игры от силы раз 15-20, и только потому как пришлось из-за хардкорности сражений с мобами выбрать прокачку квестами и это заставило идти исследовать мир. Игра даёт понять, что ты попал в мир пираний байтс и палок в колёса кидает просто невероятное количество, за что им отдельное спасибо, т.к. после Risen 2 (3ю не играл ещё) здесь чувствуется, что без досконального исследования мира и хоть как-то бедно не обувшись (это не спасёт) в дикой природе делать нечего.

Понравилось новое поведение врагов, некоторые из них готовы преследовать тебя очень долго, что побуждает гаситься вообще от всех, кроме самых мелких, но и дальше они так же становятся сильнее, потому и этих обойдём стороной.

Что касается квестов, пираньи наконец-то сделали огромное количество вариативности прохождения квестов, которые влияют и на другие так же. Чего стоит только моя отвисшая челюсть при получении благосклонности у Рагнара, ведь я делал как лучше, а в итоге он обвинил меня, что я приношу только один вред городу, просто вин и нужно теперь заплатить 2к, ну и пошёл он)

Диалоги так же радуют, если сравнивать всё с тем же Risen 2, то на голову выше прыгнули, намного меньше стало этой пафосности, которая очень начинала раздражать уже в той игре.

Боёвка конечно не самая лучшая, но она придаёт сложности в игре, что опять же заставляет погружаться в процесс, и подумать, прежде чем отхватить очередных п...й, а их будет нескончаемое кол-во.

Графику в минус совершенно не ставлю, глазу приятно, но не современный уровень конечно. Помня о том, что игру делают 25 человек, то за работу с картинкой я бы даже похвалил. Единственная неприятная вещь это переходы из помещений на улицу и наоборот, тут они перестарались на славу. Одно понятно, что так в жизни и происходит с глазами, но не так часто, войдя - выйдя 10 раз туда сюда так не должно происходить, в итоге выходить из помещения не хочется, когда знаешь, что нужно будет зайти через сек обратно и наоборот. Хотя я конечно привык и уже не замечаю, но отпугнуть многих может. Анимация тоже так себе, забив болт, не обращаю внимание, хотя хочется.

Саундтрек на уровне, тут в общем говорить нечего.

Про напиханность в мире кучи разных сеттингов не прокомментирую, но пока забавно встречать машины и бетонные дома рядом с частоколом и избами. Поиграем - увидим, думаю будет интересно.

Немножко допишу "обзор" после ещё пары десятков часов в игре, играть много не получается к сожалению, но думаю я в этой игре надолго, т.к. оказалось, что разработчики сумели сделать интересный мир, который действительно хочется исследовать. Это после после всех моих фейлов и убеганий в ужасе от врагов я наконец-то смог разобраться в механике игры и находить подход к врагам, т.к. на мечах и топорах эта игра не заканчивается. К слову о врагах, я играю на средней сложности, дабы совсем мазохзимом не заниматься, но это всё-равно мазохизм, разрабам респект, они заставляют либо изворачиваться и искать выходы, либо возвращаться туда, где ты не смог ничего совершенно, заново. И вот тут они прямо бальзам на душу накапали, я прямо вообще не ожидал, что в их играх увижу подобное, а именно: выполнял я значит квест когда-то в дремучем прошлом и у меня стоял выбор, либо я отговариваю чувака от затеи с братом-мутантом, либо помогаю ему. В общем я вернулся в то место случайно, т.к. нашёл очки на поиск лута и решил проверить где я что мог пропустить и каково было моё удивление, что братец то всё же укокошил своего братца, ну тот, что мутант. А заодно я нахожу дневник, где всё подробно описано и где моя рука сыграла важнейшую роль в этом мракобесии, ну что ж.

Хочется добавить, что в квестах я нашёл подобного очень много и с интересом смотрю на происходящее, то сказал не то и персонажа тупо прирезали (не моего, хотя и так бывало не раз), то ещё что-нибудь подобное.

Пираньи в общем прыгнули на голову выше и сумели сделать ту игру, какую хотели сделать и она у них получилась, хоть и с минусами, но на них спокойно закрываешь глаза, когда видишь, с какой душой сделана игра. Уверен в будущем они ещё удивят

P.S. В самом начале писал про время игры игроками и до сих пор удивлён что они в ней делали, т.к. я до сих пор ещё не побывал в Калаане и с альбами встречался всего пару раз, а это уже те самые 30 часов игры. Наслаждайтесь игрой, а побыстрее пройти попробуйте уровень в баттлтодс с погоней за чуваком с бомбой по этажам, там это пригодится

Pros:

1. If you play a lot of RPGs you wont get any surprises out of the story, but i still think it's pretty solid
2. Same goes for the lore and history of the game world
3. Exploration really is the core of the game and it just never get's boring (when you finally are strong enough)
4. A great skill system keeps you highly motivated 
5. Three unique, but very generic, factions 
6. Npcs are ok, also very generic at times, but your companions have some great depth
7. Lot of viewable builds (depends on the faction you choose), but very combat oriented
8. A lot of weapons and spells to choose from
9. I recommend to use some mods (rebalance, weapon behavior and such)
10. Encountered no major bugs, or gliches

Neutral:

1. You have to choose a faction to progress at some point
2. Could be a bit more armor variants
3. While there are a few different damage types, they aren't explained at all and most of them are very useless (a lot of potential lost)
4. Would have been great if damage, armor, stamina and overall combat system would be a bit more complex (can't think of a system more basic than Elex actually)
5. Attribute points are just for weapon/armor requirement and for skill requirement
6. When you finally get to know what to do and what skills/weapons are good, you will get overpowered halfway through the game

Cons:

1. One of the worst combat mechanics i have seen in recent years (imagine dodging in Max Payne Bullet Time while your enemies are as fast as ever and with massive hitboxes on top)
2. Camera movement in combat
3. Controls (be prepared to spend at least an hour to get into it)
4. The difficulty at the start of the game (literally everything will kill you with one, or two, hits at the start; don't even bother to get outside of the first city under a certain level; that's just a very, very stupid game design)
5. The enemy placement (might be one of the the worst in gaming history, super-strong monsters can apear everywhere on the map)
6. Why they put a stealth option into the game is beyond me (doesn't work on monsters and it's only a hindrance with NPCs, which brings us to the last point)
7. NPC AI (don't let me even start)


First things first. The game is far from perfect and i really can understand people complaining about it. But if you are able to look beyond the flaws, you actually get a very decent RPG. I played with ranged weapons and so i was able to avoid most of the annoying stuff, like the camera and the dodging. 

While i nearly uninstalled the game a few times in the first hours, i finally managed to come clean with. Just get into the first city, do some quests and take a step at the time. When you get into the core mechanics of the game and realize what is important and what is not it really start to make a lot of fun. And it just never stops until the end. Exploring every structure, killings monsters, doing quests, decide the fate of the world, uncover every secret. 

Elex is an above average RPG and if you like the genre it's well worth a try. If you can manage a few hours of frustration at the start, get the game on sale. Worth about 40-60 hours of gameplay.

Franchement, après toutes les conneries qu'ont racontées les petits marquis du jeu vidéo, comme si on avait besoin d'eux pour choisir un jeu, je recommande chaudement Elex qui est dans la continuité des Gothic, la difficulté en moins, car quoi qu'on en dise, passé les deux premiers niveaux il est sans intérêt de jouer en "facile" - rien à voir avec les mouches sanguinaires de Gothic 2 ou l'affrontement avec on premier loup. On progresse très rapidement et la difficulté n'est pas un problème, sauf si tu t'attaque à un troll, mais là tu peux facilement l'éviter. Un vrai open world où la carte fourmille de surprises. Je repproche l'inévitable marqueur de quêtes, mais l'interaction entre les différentes factions est bien pensée et tu prends plaisir à te lancer dans une aventure originale où le mélange berserkers nordiques dans leurs forêts, hors-la-loi à la Mad Max, et les Clercs férus de technologie, ne gênent pas, tout est parfaitement articulé, aucun anachronisme, vu qu'on débarque dans un monde post-apocalyptique. Sans rien spoiler, je trouve la fin intéressante - pour une fois qu'il ne suffit pas de flinguer le fameux boss de fin, et après le générique de fin la quête finale se poursuit, et il suffit de te rendre dans les villes des factions pour avoir quelques dernières surprises. Le final insiste sur le fait qu'il y aura une suite, puisque dans l'onglet des missions, ayant tout accompli, tu peux lire "en cours". J'ai passé pas mal d'heures sur ce jeu, en complète immersion, et avec un très grand plaisir.

This game is an absolutely amazing RPG.  It has a plenty of loot to be found around the game world, and in every imaginable spot you can think of reaching with your jet pack; this encourages thorough exploration.  It is definitely a choices-driven RPG, where you are faced with game & world changing choices to make regularly.  It also has three different factions you can join, and I honestly think they are all pretty cool and definitely unique from one another.  I am almost 30 hours in, and I still haven't even joined a faction, or even gotten through the first act of the main story (i presume).  I think things will really start to ramp up once I join a faction, though.  I look forward to seeing where this story goes, but I am also just enjoying exploring the world and taking on any quests I come across, which are plenty.  The only other game I have played by this company was Risen 2: Dark Waters, and though it is similar in many ways, it light years ahead in writing, combat system/upgrading possibilities, and fun factor.  I had to Risen 2 after about 20+ hours of gameplay because I just go bored of it and it's repetitive combat and boring story arch/enemies.  But I will definitely be finishing this game (ELEX) and I am looking forward to ELEX 2 very much.

Overall, I like it and am having fun.  The only drawback is loot.  When you kill someone, you do not get what's in their inventory.  You don't get their weapons and armor.  It's a mechanic designed to keep enemies hard and you weak, and force you to join a group in order to get any kind of good armor.  That's my one real complaint though, and does not detract from my overall liking of the game.  Plus, I'm sure there's a mod for that.

Alles etwas nervig und nicht schön, aber das bin ich ja von Piranha Bytes Spielen gewohnt. Ich bin großer Fan von Gothic und auch Risen, und Elex spielt sich genau so wie Gothic vor so vielen Jahren. Das Setting finde ich einfach richtig gelungen, es gibt drei wirklich unterschiedliche Fraktionen, die Monster verlangen gerade am Anfang einiges an Taktik (oder Flucht) und das Erkunden der Welt belohnt einen wirklich. Wenn man nach langem Suchen, Skillen, Stehlen (!) sich endlich die ersehnte Rüstung oder Waffe leisten kann, erzeugt das endlich mal wieder wirkliche Freude. Ich habe lange nicht solchen Spaß bei dieser Art von Spiel gehabt.

The possibilty of flying away and killing an enemy while camping from a roof of a building is made a bit harder because even the mutated animals can shoot some stuff at you, but not all of them can and it is not difficult to get away from them. So it´s kind of a constant cheat you can use to get out of danger. It would be cool to get a bit more challenge in this case, like some climb buildings animals, which should just take so long that you can take a healing potion or stuff like that. The story is just fine and has only little flaws, but this might just be my taste, i will not give spoilers. Try it out if you like to slay incredibly ugly mutated monsters with swords, bows and laser weapons as well as rocket launchers. Those monsters might be the ugliest beasts ever in a game, and it´s not the graphic of the game that makes them ugly, it is intentional and i like it that way. The graphic is decent, but i don´t like the looks of the water. Other than that it can keep up enough with nowadays standards of top game graphics to keep people satisfied. You can do nothing wrong if you like rpg´s in third person, it has been worth the full price.

Ech Elex, Elex, jak Cię ocenić... Rozbijmy może na części pierwsze.
Grafika - prezentuje bardzo nierówny poziom. Momentami wygląda pięknie, szczególnie wewnątrz budynków, jaskiń, z dobrym oświetleniem, cieniami i mgłą; innym razem wygląda tragicznie- np. podczas deszczu, który wygląda jak zaśnieżony obraz.
Mapa  - duża i zróżnicowana - oblodzone góry, gęste lasy, pustynia, rejon wulkaniczny. Lokacje naprawdę nieźle dopracowane.  Ogromny plus dla gry!
Muzyka - Gothic 3 co najwyżej po lekkim tuningu, monotonna, momentami  zmienia tempo bez wyraźnego powodu.
Gameplay - na początku bardzo ciężki, dużo błędów i bezsensownych i frustrujących mechanik których trzeba się nauczyć. Fatalne menu gry i zarządzania ekwipunkiem (znaleźć coś na szybko graniczy z cudem). 
Questy i fabuła - większość to tradycyjne przynieś, zanieś, skróć kogoś albo coś o głowę ;) Fabuła też mało porywająca, ale zdarzyło się kilka ciekawych i zaskakujących momentów . 
Walka - bardzo toporna, mało dynamiczna, jest to chyba najsłabsza część gry. Walka wręcz oparta jest na "target lock", który nie wyłącza się po "położeniu" jednego z przeciwników. często zdarzało się że tłukłem truchło zanim mogłem podświetlić kolejnego przeciwnika. Walka z dystansu jest też bardzo niedopracowana. Pociski z każdej broni lecą z tak wolną prędkością, że przeciwnicy są w stanie zejść z toru lotu (bez znaczenia czy jest to strzała, pocisk plazmowy czy strzał z broni palnej!!!) do tego często przelatują przez wrogów lub nie wywołują obrażeń. 
Na plus - mamy wszystkie znane potworki z serii Gothic (ścierwojady, zębacze, cieniostwory, pełzacze, trolle, kretoszczury) tylko w nowych futurystycznych teksturach. Niestety AI jest fatalne, każdy przeciwnik szarżuje na ślepo żeby tylko zadać 3 hit combo. Przeciwnicy często utykają na małych przeszkodach lub zabijają sami siebie strzałem w ścianę stojąc zaraz przy niej. Sojusznicy robią to samo - szarżują z mieczami na mechy  bojowe zamiast ostrzeliwać z dystansu.
Ekwipunek - bardzo skromny, mało unikalnych i potężnych broni. Najpotężniejszą bronią w grze jest.... nie laser, nie działo plazmowe,nie granatnik, rakietnica, nie wyrzutnia harpunów czy strzelba bojowa ale łuk :|  
Generalnie, przez liczne błędy, dziwaczne mechaniki, z gry która mogła być perełką wyszedł mega średniak. Daję kciuk w górę, ale tylko z sentymentu do Gothic i w sumie tylko dla fanów Gothic gra jest przeznaczona; raczej nie przypadnie do gustu każdemu fanu RPG.

Великолепная игра с полу-открытым миром, крутой сюжет, хардкорное прохождение. Почти как в дарксоулсе каждая крыса на твоем пути может тебя прикончить. Но, развиваясь, ты становишься все сильнее и сильнее, теперь крысы для тебя не страшны, а вот большие курицы - все еще проблема. Достигнув 25 уровня и получив почти самый высокий ранг в любой группировке, ты надеваешь лучшую доступную тебе броню и оружие, что бы 9 часов убивать тролля, тк ты все равно сносишь ему около 0,001 процента хп за тычку. Почти любой враг все еще может раздать тебе люлей и заставить выпить все зелья здоровья. Но в целом, это все еще не так жестко как дарксоулс, потому что тут есть куда убежать, враги тебя не преследуют долго, толпой нападают редко.
Лутаться тут тоже как-то странно, с врагов-людей не падает оружие, которым они дрались, не падает их шмот... максимум на что вы можете расчитывать - это пара осколков элексита и пачка денег старого мира... Основной лут идет за счет монстров, с которых падают кости, шкуры, крылья, зубы и тд... все это вы продаете и копите каждую копеечку, тк на то,Ю что бы убить 3 ящеров вам нужно сильно постараться не сдохнуть в процессе и сожрать кучу мяса.... Но вдруг, после 25 часов игры вы открываете для себя магазин с ручными гранатами контактного действия... теперь вы бог этого мира! ничто не устоит перед вашим могуществом, ведь стоит кому-то что-то вякнуть - вы заткнете его рот лимонкой! Гранаты бьют по радиусу, опрокидывают врага, наносят тонну урона!!!! но тролля или циклопа вы все равно будете валить 9 часов реального времени.... Тем не менее, вы теперь царь этих земель... Вы все еще не понимаете, почему простые гранаты с уроном 50 наносят больший дамаг, чем взрывные патроны с уроном 60 или гранатомет на 72 или ваш меч на 80... Но оно вам и не надо, после проб и ошибок с другими видами оружия вы теперь миллионами вливаете осколки элексита в тысячи гранат! без них вы труп....
Но не смотря на весь этот странный геймплей, где даже прокачать оружие или вставить в него пару гемов ты не можешь вез его потери (прокаченное тобой оружие внезапно требует от вас большей силы и ловкости чем раньше и ты такой Бл######!!!!) сюжет очень крутой и реально меня затянул, я очень хочу узнать чем все развяжется, тем бьолее что перед рожей всегда мелькает надпись "ваше действие отразится на сюжете" или "данный персонаж это запомнит" или "смерть этого усоска приведет к последствиям", я сам творю сюжет игры.
Картинка оставляет желать лучшего, постоянные недогрузы, лаги, гличи - но со временем ты привыкаешь и к ним, тк посточянно читаешь диалоги и сюжет захватывает твое внимание полностью.

Piranha Bytes darzę niemałym sentymentem. Seria gothic doczekała się w Polsce kultu i nie była to zasługa wyłącznie dubbingu, ponieważ gra dawała masę satysfakcji nie prowadząc nas za rękę minimapą i znacznikami, dzięki czemu eksploracja wypadała naturalnie.

ELEX to bardzo ambitny projekt. Co może się stać kiedy małe studio weźmie się za dużego RPG-a?

 Dokładnie to czego można się było spodziewać. Gra ma masę niedoróbek, nieprzemyślanych elementów, drobnych bugów itd. 
ale do tego już przyzwyczaił nas gothic.

Tytuł jest bardzo gothicowy i początkowo nawet nasunęła mi się myśl, że mam przed sobą duchowego spadkobiercę mojej gry dzieciństwa. Niestety ELEX często niedomaga w wielu aspektach, w których gothic był świetny:

-Dialogi, tłumaczenie, polski dubbing  ehhh wypadają bardzo kiepsko
   * ton wypowiedzi często nie pasuje to sytuacji
   * Błędy w tłumaczeniu zdarzają się tak nagminnie, że ma się wrażenie iż cały skrypt został przepuszczony przez google tłumacz 
   * Dialogom poza rzadkimi wyjątkami brakuje polotu, są pełne lania wody i sprawiają wrażenie, że twórcy mają swoich odbiorców za skończonych idiotów.

-Twórcy dodali do gry ogłupiającą minimapę ze wskaźnikami, czego przyczyną była prawdopodobnie spora powierzchnia świata. Ma to swoje odbicie w questach. "Zabawa" sprowadza się do bezmyślnego łażenia od znacznika do znacznika. Na dodatek minimapa przez swój paskudny projekt jest miejscami nieczytelna. 

-Przebudowano system walki w zwarciu, opierając się na rozwiązaniach z większości współczesnych rpg akcji, jednakże jego wykonanie woła o pomstę do nieba, jest wysoce niesatysfakcjonujące i zabugowane.

-Nie ma zbytnio o czym mówić w przypadku strzelania. Jest po prostu drewniane i ciężko szukać w nim satysfakcji.

-Wiele z umiejętności jest bezużyteczne lub. Profity często dają marne bonusy do statystyk. 

-System rozwoju jest w dużej mierze niezbalansowany, czyniąc początek gry frustrującym a koniec nudząco łatwym.

Pomimo tego natłoku wad gra broni się w wielu aspektach:

-Twórcy nie mogąc wybrać pomiędzy klimatami sci-fi, postapo i fantasy,  wybrali wszystkie naraz, a efekt jest interesujący.

-Gra nawet pomimo drewnianych animacji jest przyjemna dla oka.

-questy pomimo fatalnych dialogów rzadko są fedexami i często pozwalają na podejmowanie znaczących decyzji.

-Każda z trzech frakcji pomiędzy którymi wybieramy ma wiele wad i zalet, tym samym utrudniając podjęcie decyzji, do której z nich dołączymy. Ponadto każda z nich prezentuje inne klimaty (postapo, fantasy, sci-fi), więc każdy znajdzie coś dla siebie. 

-Towarzysze są idiotoodporni.

-Gra starczy na około 50h bez pośpiechu.

Podsumowując, ELEX nie jest wybitną grą, aczkolwiek przymykając oko na niedoróbki bawiłem się dobrze, mając poczucie obcowania z dużą grą RPG i w sumie trzymam kciuki za sequel nad którym prace nadal trwają

ELEX is an RPG of a different nature than most.  While I would never want to do an exact comparison between it and others, it's got that difficult, slow crescendo that turns many players off these days.  The story is really cool, and the voice acting for the quests is above average.  The environments are beautiful.  The locations are diverse, and definitely feed my endless hunger for post-apocalypse games.  I'd say really give this a hard look and consider it, especially on a sale, even if reviews have been unkind.  I will say the combat system takes some getting used to, and feels a bit clunky, however it's still engaging and I wouldn't let it keep you from trying this one out.

The open world rpg genre has such high standards at this point with entrys like the elder scrolls or the witcher series that its practically impossible for a studio like piranha bytes to make a serious contribution. They obviously lack manpower and finances and it shows big time ingame. 
Movement and combat feel wonky, the graphics are a joke for a game released in 2017 and it takes hours of exclusively walking around and talking/collecting quests until anything interesting starts to happen. I really enjoy extensive storylines but you have to find a balance between gameplay and story to get the players hooked.
Even if elex was released 5 years earlier, the quality would be acceptable at best - they have been using this game engine for more than 10 years now starting with gothic 3 in 2006, a new and significantly better engine is overdue.

Berserker  กลุ่มนักรบที่ปฏิเสธเครื่องจักรและพยายามฟื้นฟูธรรมชาติ, Outlaw กลุ่มคนไร้กฎหมายรักอิสระที่ทำทุกอย่างเพื่อผลประโยชน์และความอยู่รอดของตน, Cleric กล่มศาสนาบูชาเครื่องจักรซึ่งมุ่งหวังฟื้นฟูความศิวิไลต์ในอดีต และ Alb เผ่าพันธุ์มนุษย์ที่มีเทคโนโลยีล้ำหน้าที่สุดในยุคนี้ที่ทำทุกอย่างรวมทั้งทำสงครามกับทุกกลุ่มเพื่อค้นหาและยึดครองแร่ธาตุ Elex ที่หลงเหลืออยู่บนโลก นอกจากเทคโนโลยีแล้วร่างกายของ Alb ยังแข็งแรงกว่ากลุ่มอื่นด้วยเนื่องจากนำสาร Elex เข้าสู่่ร่างกายโดยตรง แต่ก็ทำให้ความนึกคิดและนิสัยเย็นชาเหมือนเครื่องจักร

คุณคือ Jack อดีตนักรบระดับสูงของเผ่าพันธุ์  Alb ที่รอดจากการทรยศของเพื่อนร่วมเผ่าพันธุ์ บาดเจ็บเจียนตาย อาวุธชุดเกราะแสนไฮเทคโดนแฮบ (ตอนสลบ) และเมื่อตื่นมาพบว่าสาร Elex ในร่างกายที่ทำให้แข็งแกร่งเกินคนธรรมดาหมดฤทธิ์ และนั่นคือการเริ่มต้นของการเดินทางในโลกที่โหดร้ายของนี้

เกมนี้คุณต้องเซฟบ่อยๆ เพราะโลกในเเกมจะโหดร้ายกับคุณมาก คุณไม่ใช่ ฮีโร่, Witcher หรือ Dovakin เป็นแค่มนุษย์กระจอกธรรมดาที่ไม่รู้เรื่องอะไรในโลกเลย (เข้ากับเนื้อเรื่องที่เป็น Alb มาก่อน) ศัตรูกระจอกๆ ตอนเริ่มต้นไม่ได้ตบตายง่ายๆ เหมือนเกมอื่น แต่เป็นเรานี่แหละที่โดนตบตายง่ายๆ (การบริหาร stamina สำคัญมาก) บางครั้งเราอาจจะมั่นใจว่าฆ่าศัตรูได้ง่ายๆ แต่ถ้าโดนตัวอ่อนๆ รุมเราก็ไม่รอด จึงต้องหาคู่หู (Companion) ร่วมเดินทางไปด้วย แต่ก็คอยระวังค่าความพอใจของคู่หูเราด้วย (ค่าเปลี่ยนตามการเลือกตอบคำถาม)

ช่วงต้นเกมแทบจะเหมือนเดินตัวเปล่าในทุ่งซาวันน่า คุณต้องหลบต้องหนีศัตรูแทบทุกตัว (หรือลากไปให้ npc ฆ่าแล้วรอเก็บของ) แล้วแผนที่ในเกมก็ไม่บอกอะไรเลย ตำแหน่งมาร์คอย่างจุดวาร์ปหรือร้านขายของ คุณต้องเดินไปพบก่อนถึงจะขึ้นบนแผนที่ โดยอุปกรณ์ที่ขายตามร้านจะแตกต่างไปตามฝักฝ่าย โดยมีค่า Status กำหนดว่าต้องการเท่าไหร่ในการใช้งาน โดยเราจะเลือกเข้าฝ่ายได้ 1 ฝาย (ยกเว้น Alb) ซึ่งนอกจากจะมีผลกับเนื้อเรื่องแล้วรวมปฏิสัมพันธ์กับ npc และผลกระทบลของบางเหตุการ์ในเกม

It's my edited review of this game, first time I didn't give it fair chance and stopped playing around 10 hour mark.
Now it was 21.1h when I had enough.
Story if mostly fine but that's all from good sides.

World is massive but not that fun to explore, there is some named weapons or cool loot in some locations but it's not what gothic series had, mostly you explore some out of the way buildings or enemy camps just for pure experience and basic resources.
Quests are just basic rpg quests with kill this or bring me that, almost every quest require you to mark it in quest log and run towards marker and it's not because I was lazy but it would really be impossible to find quest location because of lack of descriptions.
I feel like npc interactions have little to none consequences (i killed one guy in town and nobody even looked at me even when i was from enemy faction) and it should be standard by the time this game got released.
And the thing that finally made me drop attempt at finishing this game, combat.
Combat in this game is pure suffering, if you are interested how gamers are punished for their sins in hell you should just play elex. Attack movements are just actions that you queue (at least you can cancel with dodge roll) for you and your enemies so a lot of mobs are easy to fight just because you know their patterns.
But that's only half of what is trash about this combat, aggro range is abysmal, one of the worst i've seen in games in my life and devs for some stupid reason though that it will be good thing to give EVERY enemy range attacks.
But that's still not why i dropped it. I dropped it after multiple attempts at fighting group of albs and attacking anything in their vicinity aggro couple of drones and around 6 albs in open area. 
The fights were just infuriating, all of the albs started with range and half of them always had fire missiles that knockback and stun you if hit. One time i lost at last alb simply because he decided to go back to range while i ran a little to heal myself with potion and he just killed me from half health just stunlocking me with range weapon, literally the worst combat experience i had in gaming history.
And it's one of piranha bytes games that they did insanely bad power scaling, you either 2/3 shot enemies while they can't move or hit enemy for entire minute while just avoiding their attack pattern. 
To add salt to injury i was playing berserker and casting magic was simply not fun (although i played mostly melee).

To finish my review, i really wanted to like this game but combat system is too trash and story is not good enough to keep this suffering any longer.
