Ich bin wie viele treuer Fan von Piranha Bytes, habe alle Gothic-Teile und Risen 1+2 gespielt, wobei mir G3 und R1 insgesamt am meisten zugesagt haben. 

Elex' Welt ist eine Mischung aus Risen 1 und Fallout. Verschiedene Fraktionen kämpfen um die Herrschaft über ein großteils verwüstetes Land. Die Karte ist so groß und schön gestaltet wie nie zuvor und durch den Jetpackeinsatz lässt sich diese auf angenehme Weise erkunden (Klippen sind kein Problem mehr :). 

Bei vielen Aufgaben gibt es große Entscheidungsfreiheit, die das zukünftige Spiel beeinflussen. Zum Beispiel muss man für Jäger Nahrung besorgen, gleich 50 Einheiten, welche nicht leicht aufzutreiben sind. Stattdessen bietet einem eine Ladenbesitzerin das verschimmelte Brot kostenlos an. Bringt man den Jägern dieses, erhält man leicht die Belohnung; dafür leidet aber später der Ruf und ggf. muss man die Truppe auch wieder heilen. 
Diese Art von Entscheidungen ([schnelle] Belohnung vs. Ruf) sind relativ häufig anzutreffen und die Konsequenzen sind authentisch und gestalten die Welt lebendiger. Ebenso hat der Tod von Charakteren zum Teil bedeutenden Einfluss.

Der Misch-Masch an Fraktionen (Fantasy, SciFi, Outlaws) mag komisch erscheinen, ergibt aber im Laufe des Spiels halbwegs Sinn. Die Fülle an Möglichkeiten ermöglicht auch komplett verschiedene Spielstile und sorgt für Wiederspielbarkeit.
Die Charaktergestaltung ist gewohnt rau und humorvoll. Auch einfache Questgeber legen einen u.U. mal aufs Kreuz oder blöken einen für undurchdachte Entscheidungen an.

Der Kampfstil ist Risen sehr ähnlich, nicht so flüssig wie man es auch vielen AAA-Titeln kennt, aber sobald man das System etwas verinnerlicht hat, kommt man damit zurecht. Streaks/Combos sind wichtig und wenn man "aufs Maul" bekommt, sollte man sich kurz zurückziehen. 
Anfangs sollte man - wie von Gothic gewohnt - lieber die Beine in die Hand nehmen, wirklich einfacher wird es erst, nachdem man sich einer Gilde angeschlossen hat.


Insgesamt ist Elex sehr gelungen und eines der besten PB-Spiele. Die Welt ist sehr detailreich und stimmig gestaltet und reagiert durch die Vielzahl von Entscheidungen auf den Spieler. Das Skillsystem ist nicht sehr innovativ, aber solide und vielfältig. Das Kampfsystem hat Mäkel, würde es aber nicht als grauenhaft oder schlechter als in Vorgängern beschreiben. Spaß macht vor allem das Erkunden, die Fraktionen und Entscheidungsfreiheit sowie das Verbessern seinen Charakters. Durch und durch ein gutes, story-lastiges RPG in einem schrägen Setting mit viel Abwechslung.

它具备一款好的开放世界游戏应该有的一切特质：庞大而独特的世界观，优秀的剧情，丰富的支线，不同选择会给你带来不同结局，支线和主线剧情之间还相互连接，三大阵营带来的多样化武器、装备和技能，没有严重的恶性bug。
但它却不具备任何能吸引人的地方：优秀的画面，美型的人物造型，炫酷的技能特效，爽快的手感，这些能让一秒沉迷的东西它一个都没有。
elex本来有希望比肩上古卷轴和辐射，可惜制作组的贫穷限制了它的发展。
但是，不管怎么样，这是一款真正用心制作出来的良心游戏，当你接受了它的那些蹩脚的设计（主要是战斗方面），你会发现它是真的很有意思。

Elex is a pretty world to look at. But the actor models are terrible to look at. The ambient sounds and sound effects are nice. But the voice acting is absolutely terrible. I could get past that and say maybe the company is just  B level company and they can't afford a good modeler or voice acting. Terrain is cheap and easy these days after all. It's the story I'm after. But that turns out was written by a 16 year old. The story is about as complex as a stick. And I'd like to hit several time with said stick, The storytellers, the npcs, tell it by hitting you over the head with the stick. This is not Skyrim. This is not Code Red Witcher storytelling. This is a group of 16 years who got together to write a story. It's that bad. Really, you have three factions that rule the land and you name them that?

So what's left? Combat! RPG games usually don't do this very well. Skyim is so-so. Witcher... meh. Elex is god aweful. If you were to compare this game against the greats... Skyrim, Witcher 3, Fallout NV... and if you like those games, this game would probably not be for you unless you have a great patience for the less than mediocre.

This is a very good and interesting game. At the time I write this review I've got around 50 hours of gameplay, and explored every single corner of it's world and done very quest I could find.

It's scenario is very beautyful, and I've enjoyed exploring it entirely.  This game looks good.

While at the first levels the game feels over difficult, this inicial difficulty turns out to be very rewarding after your character becomes, stronger, which gives this game a great sense of character progression.
Also, the inicial high difficulty gives the game a sense of "the wilderness really is dangerous, I shouldnt go there", which is something that most rpgs I've played lack. 

Elex's combat is not very good, although it is not as buggy as the other reviews say it is. There are many details that might feel like bugs at first, but once you understand how combat works, you realize it is not a bug. (For example, it took me a while to realize that all enemies, including beasts, can parry blows)

It's main story is not bad, but it's far from good either. Many times I've seen myself compelled to do the sidequests, not because of rewards or experience, but because the main story just isnt that interesting. On the other hand, joining and understanding the factions is very entertaining, and so are your companions.

Overall, Elex is a fun game, beautyful, interesting and great character progression. It's combat system is a little tiring, and the game feels like it was released earlier than it should have been, lacking some fine tuning, but it's still worth your time.

29 hours in and I just can't recommend this game. It has a lot of potential, but the overall flow of the game and balance is completely off (e.g., to obtain advanced gear or skills you must join a faction, though to join a faction you must complete numerous quests against mobs that individually 2-shot you. You will often be fighting many such mobs at once, leading to frequent auto-save/auto-load spam).

这是一部非常优秀的RPG，有着非常非常丰富的剧情和世界观，评论里面居然有人把这个游戏当动作游戏来玩，可以感觉到作者其实并不希望玩家花太多时间战斗刷怪什么的，而是希望玩家去了解这个世界，我看评论里面很多人用就几个小时去 打野怪就为了一点点经验？其实你只要去和NPC说几句话，甚至看几本书的 经验和奖励都比你刷一天怪要多得多，而你需要做的仅仅是保持好奇心，而且游戏的任务系统非常非常丰富，甚至和巫师有得一拼，每个任务都有自己的故事，和打，完全没有单调的重复的刷刷刷过程，而且里面几乎所以战斗都可以避开，无论是野外还是任务里的，而少部分必须打的任务难度其实都适中，或者有其他办法取巧完成，几乎不存在卡关什么的，如果你发现遇见打不过的任务，请先看看周围是不是有什么可以帮助你的，然后和其他NPC对话试试，舍得花点钱什么的很有可能得到大幅度降低难度的提示，最后 还是不行就换个思路，潜行，卡BUG，飞高地什么的能过90%的关卡。这游戏的非战斗属性什么的也很有用，比如说学会制药以后能合成不用升级就直接给你属性点的药物，这样钱就变得非常有用了，你的钱将直接提高你的实力。这是一个非常非常优秀的RPG，但是战斗手感确实不太好，喜欢砍砍砍的玩家不推荐，但是如果你喜欢探索世界，看剧情的话这无疑是非常值得入手的游戏

BLUF:  Don't buy, not even for 1$.  I had this game refunded, it's that bad.  Other than graphics this game is an insult to quality craftsmanship at every possible touchpoint.


Story:
Possibly the worst start to a story I've ever experienced, I was literally yelling at my monitor how juvinile and sub-standard the intro seems.  This entry INTO the world of ELEX glosses over all and any interesting parts there could have been to draw our interest, instead, we're fed a basic monologue of "Here's some groups, they're all at war.  This group is more powerful, you're one of them.  You're so cool, you're an elite warrior caste who never fails.  Oh look, you failed.  Oh look, your plane is crashing.  Too bad this group treats failure as a death sentance."  And to keep in that line of quality story, the game presents you with zero reason to care about the main character we're meant to use as our avatar.  The premise of the character's entry into our use is grade-school level writing, and doesn't get better.

Gameplay:
The intro part of the game fully and totally insults your desire to explore.  Even in the very first "room" area, you're harshly punished for exploring.  Trying to check around the first area, you die.  There are beasts up the hill you cannot kill with the starting equipment.  Dying instantly ends the game, and you have to restart.  Also, fall from too high, you die.  No areas past the first zone are any better.  Explore?  Punished.
Movement and combat are both clunky and feel like the system was never tweaked well, or corrected to finish animations in a crisp-feeling way.  I cannot talk about much deeper into the combat, as I didn't experience enough of it to really review competantly.

Graphics:
Quite nice. The colors seem sharp, textures are well done.  Areas seemed very well done, and kept a good "zone" theme.  UI is decent, nothing amazing, but plenty usable.  Only good things to say about the graphics. 

Sound:
Environment sounds were nice  Pleasing, and they added to an already decent looking environment.  I didn't think much of them, as they seemed to mesh and "be there" naturally.  Voice acting on the otherhand, was poorly timed, poorly voiced, and only Keanu Reeves could have done a worse delivery with less care for being in character.

Extra: Wall of Shame:
GRYOnline, GameStar, MeriStation, Hooked Gamers, and others show greater than 7 points in their reviews.  They all must have been paid off, or their reviewers too lazy to even install and play the first hour. SHAME on you guys for such shoddy follow through.

1 - Terrible control system
2 - Poorly implemented combat system
3 - Terrible progression system that doesn't allow you to effectively fight or talk until you have been killed by everything around you and missed half of your dialogue options.  These problems in particular go against the entire backstory.
4 - A very linear progression at the beginning but no driver to follow the required path to start.
5 - Poor graphics and acting

Good

[b]Piranha Bytes[/b]. If you weren't born yesterday, you sure remember these guys. Back in early [b]2000s[/b] they used to shape the future. When the first [b]Gothic[/b] arrived, it was like a dream. A fully voiced [b]3D[/b] role-playing game that simulated life within a limited space called [b]Colony[/b]. Limited by magical [b]Barrier[/b], [b]Colony[/b] had its own laws. Which were kind of strange, thanks to how [b]Colony[/b] was... well... [i]colony[/i], and most of its citizens were criminals, but that was another thing that used to make [b]Gothic[/b] so special – its setting was fresh and original. Another thing was that every living person inside [b]Colony[/b] was more than just a [b]3D[/b] model. Every person there used to wake up in the morning, do his, or her daily stuff and go to sleep at some point. [b]Colony[/b] felt [i]alive[/i]. And it was up to you to decide how to live your life there. It was you who selected your path and formed the future for the selected faction. [b]Gothic[/b] was so good that the biggest question of [b]2002[/b] was what's better - [b]Gothic[/b], or [b]The Elder Scrolls III[/b]. And I must say, I was always a [b]Gothic[/b] person. It wasn't as big as [b]The Elder Scrolls[/b], but it was more dynamic and much more fun. Years passed and instead of making revolutions, [b]Piranha Bytes[/b] ended up in their own barrier somehow. With every new game being pretty much [b]Gothic[/b] re-skin. After they've lost the rights on [b]Gothic[/b] name (don't even let me start talking about that [b]Gothic 4[/b] thing...), they made [b]Risen[/b]. Which was pretty much the same thing, only with pirates. And now, after [b]Risen[/b] trilogy was ended, here comes [b]Elex[/b].

So, what the heck is [b]Elex[/b]? As you may have already guessed, [b]Elex[/b] is... [b]Gothic[/b]. Because, let's be honest, that's pretty much the only thing [b]Piranhas[/b] can produce. Replace [b]Sleeper[/b] with [b]Hybrid[/b], [b]Brotherhood[/b] with [b]Albs[/b], [b]Old Camp[/b] with [b]Berserkers[/b], etc, and that will be pretty much it. So, if you're [b]Gothic[/b] fan, you can stop reading this review now and add this game to your cart. Because you don't need to know anything else. [b]Elex[/b] = [b]Gothic[/b]. And that's it.

Like in [b]Risen[/b]'s case, it's not that simple, though. Obviously, there should be at least a big change in the setting. And there sure is one, because [b]Elex[/b] takes place in the post-apocalyptic world, where people use mineral called [b]Elex[/b] as a source of power (hello, magical ore, long time no see). For us it'll mean that we'll see the ruins of the old world (roads, cars, buildings, etc), while factions will divide by how they feel about [b]Elex[/b]. So far so good. Personally, I loved the setting since the very first trailer. I mean... [b]Gothic[/b] in a post-apocalyptic world with guns? Give me two! Unfortunately, even though [b]Elex[/b] feels pretty much as our usual [b]PB[/b] game, I can't say it's their best work.

You see, [b]Piranhas[/b] never were about huge open world games. When they tried to achieve that in [b]Gothic 3[/b] it didn't really work. Big worlds weren't their strongest points and the size wasn't the reason why [b]Gothic[/b] / [b]Risen[/b] games were so good. It was balance that made them so charming and addictive. Personally, I still feel like the very first [b]Gothic[/b] is the best of them all. It was pretty small by modern standards, but there was nothing useless in it. It was as big as it was supposed to be. No big empty and perfectly useless spaces that modern gamers love so much, every monster placement used to make perfect sense and all in all it used to have that perfect handmade feeling. That's why first [b]Gothic[/b] was so cool and that's why [b]Elex[/b]... well... isn't.

It's pretty clear that [b]PB[/b] tried to make their new game bigger. Size is what modern kids like the most, after all. Nobody cares that [b]Ocarina of Time[/b] used to have interesting dungeons, complicated bosses and perfect levels anymore. People want big and empty world full of [b]Korok Seeds[/b]. Just because. And that's pretty much what happens here. And it ruins things. A lot. You see, the whole [b]Gothic[/b] formula worked exactly because you were supposed to think about pretty much every monster encounter and every single [b]NPC[/b]. You were supposed to count every experience point you can get. You were supposed to care about every loot you can get too. Have a very hard time with that big monster once, enjoy an extra skill point that can change [i]a lot[/i]. Save some monsters for the future, learn how to skin them and make a fortune. That's how it worked. it was all about [i]planning[/i]. Here, in [b]Elex[/b], nothing of that works. It's just you, open world, some monsters to kill (you can always get enough monsters and hunting totally isn't as rewarding here) and some factions to join. Which means that even though you can still feel [b]Gothic[/b] here, it's more about patience than strategy this time. [b]PB[/b] tried to fix that by playing with difficulty levels. It didn't help much, only made the game frustratingly hard at early stages. Make the game at least 2x smaller, work on level design and monster placement, make hunting great again (pun intended) and it'll be better. Way better. Unfortunately, [b]PB[/b] really wanted their game to be bigger this time. And almost failed.

The factions are still there, though, and joining them is still fun. All that exclusive armor stuff is still there too and getting a new and shiny armor is still exciting. Even though armor looks surprisingly bad this time. Remember how impressive armor used to look in [b]Gothic[/b]? Remember how awesome it felt when you looked at your character in it? In [b]Elex[/b] it's pretty meh. Just you in some poor-looking something. But it's still fun to work your way to the top. Can't argue with that. There's also a jetpack. Which is also a fun addition. You may ask why I didn't mention it before, but that's probably because it doesn't make that much difference. Yes, it's kind of fun to go all [b]Boba Fett[/b], but it's pretty much a gimmick. A gimmick that can't even fully replace ships from [b]Risen[/b] and other fun stuff you were able to do there (like monkeys, parrots, etc). Especially since it can cause many bugs. I can't say that [b]Elex[/b] is the most buggy game out there, but, well, it's [b]Piranha[/b]'s game. And there's no console this time. Which means that if you'll get yourself into some serious buggy mess, you won't be able to fix it by inputing some commands.

So, in conclusion... yeah... [b]Elex[/b] feels a lot like [b]Gothic 2[/b] that tries to be much bigger without knowing how to actually work with all that empty space. Or like [b]Gothic 3[/b] that decided to play [b]Gothic 2[/b]. Placing some typical towers to conquer felt like a really lame attempt to fix that. And the fact that we have our own jetpack just can't change the fact that [b]Risen[/b] used to have more variety, was way better balanced and felt much better as an adventure, as single player experience. I still recommend [b]Elex[/b] to all [b]Gothic[/b] fans, though. Like any other game from [b]Piranha Bytes[/b], this one totally deserves your attention. Well, as long as you weren't born yesterday and ready for some old school feeling that is (kids may get "vintage telephone effect" from this game). And still, I must say that among all [b]PB[/b]'s games, [b]Elex[/b] is one of my least favorite projects. It sits right there, next to [b]Gothic 3[/b]. And still, I sure enjoyed my time in [b]Elex[/b] and hope that one day we'll see another one of those [b]Gothic[/b]-like games. I just hope that [b]Piranhas[/b] will understand that nobody expect them to produce anything high-end anymore. All their fans want is that feeling of perfectly balanced society. [i]Living[/i] society that empty world with towers can't replace. The feeling that [b]Elex[/b] barely deliver.

Pirhanna Bites doesnt do combat well. The starting area has around 10 quests, of those quests you can do about 3 of them. The rest require you to fight skull level combatants, the games way of saying insta death. The starting area is scattered with these mobs, on the easiest difficulty they hit you twice and you die, normal once. This is with the entry level gear you're allowed to buy equipped along with a shield. Blocking isnt actually a block vs monsters as they ignore it. Dodging causes your character to in theory avoid a hit, but its distance isnt enough to avoid anything as most enemies have a rather large lunge in *all* of their attacks. 

Another problem is the progression system requires you to meet certain minimum stats before being able to aquire talents that increase your damage, protection, and in essence all in combat skills. To my knowledge upgrading your actual attributes (Strength Dexterity Constitution) does virtually nothing for your damage. Only the talents matter. Found a god tier item? Well you probably dont have the stats to use it and even if you did you havent spent your talent to get Mele Damage Increase so its a wet noodle even if you did have the stats. 

 All weapons require two stats, but you're given an extremely paultry sum of 10 stats each level which in essence limits you to terrible weapons for almost half the game. Nine hours in (Started a second game to take advantage of what i learned the first time) you're probably just now getting a slightly better weapon that you cant upgrade because the stat requirements will increase making it so you cant use the weapon. You wont be able to make healing potions as that requires a skill as well, a skill that requires mental stats. This means you choose between being able to make healing potions and *using* the starter weapons. The game's inherent design is flawed, 

I dont know about how rich the story might be because I cant actually get to most of it since leveling is so much tedium that I simply cant be bothered to play this game any more. Nine hours spent trying to learn a game with a terrible combat system, terrible balancing of enemies, and a bad leveling system. I feel confident in saying this is a poorly made game. If you're already here and looking at this game for its story then who knows you might want this game, but I garuntee you wont enjoy your first 10 hours of it.

Anyone who even remotely thought this was acceptable should be homeless.

Starting with the positives: The story is interesting, and the world seems very large and explorable.

Este juego de acción y rol (como describe su propia casa desarrolladora Piranha Bytes) mantiene al jugador inmerso en un mundo fantástico, post-apocalíptico, de constante debate sobre elecciones y moralidad. 

Como todo, en un principio, es difícil entender la mecánica del juego, tanto por los movimientos del personaje, como el uso de diversos atributos y algunos NPC o PNJ (NPC- Non-player character / PNJ- Personaje no jugador). 

La piedra angular (según mi experiencia) para progresar seria "ENSAYO y ERROR", mientras mas tiempo se invierta en leer, revisar habilidades, verificar atributos y, desafortunadamente, analizar el "¿Por qué?" de nuestros errores y muerte. 

Cuenta, además, con una historia rica en argumentos, justificaciones y desarrollo que nos lleva, aparte del tiempo de "educarnos" a como jugar, a un constante debate de decisiones morales. 

Recomendado de jugar y tener en consideración para la biblioteca.

Плюсы: Сюжет; Юмор; Сложность; Продуманность мира и взаимоотношений между фракциями; Много пасхалок к старым играм "пираний"; Огромный мир; Большой выбор скиллов и оружия; Спутники; Автолевелинг мобов

Минусы: Огромный мир; Сложность

Как показывает практика, в большинство современных игр лучше играть через 6-12 месяцев от их релиза: баги и дисбаланс оказываются исправленными, а нервные клетки не пострадавшими.

Сюжет в игре достаточно простой, местами предсказуемый, однако герой перестал быть безымянным (его зовут Джакс и внешне он чем-то похож на Джейсона Стэтхэма) и у него, наконец-таки, появилось прошлое xD, которое оказывает влияние на возможность получения ряда заданий (их можно не получить, сказав правду о своем прошлом).

В игре присутствует определенная толика юмора, хотя до шуток Стикса ему далеко (of orcs and men). Огромное число пасхалок (н-р, маяк Джека в Таваре).

Минусов в графике не заметил. Вполне приличная, красивая картинка.

Мир, по сравнению с Готиками и Risen-ами, в разы больше. Порой кажется, что в Таваре рукой подать до Форта от любой границы земель, но из-за каньонов, пещер, горных серпантинов исследуемая площадь резко увеличена. Это и плюс, и одновременно минус игры. Очень утомительно проверять каждую кочку.
В тоже время, благодаря методичному и тщательному обыску всех руин, пещер и т.д. можно найти уйму книг и заметок, рассказывающих о старом мире, выживании людей после падения кометы и просто забавных буклетов.

Фракции имеют свое мировоззрение, их отношение к другим группировкам полностью этому соответствует. При этом они очень рады видеть нейтрального (афракционера) игрока, ведь "пушечное мясо" нужно всем.

Некоторые монстры друг друга не трогают и совместно атакуют игрока, другие устраивают потасовки между друг другом. При этом раз в 2 дня происходит респаун монстров с проработанным автолевелингом.
Из минусов в нем то, что некоторые монстры неоправданно сильны, хотя считаются относительно среднеуровневыми (потрошители, гниловепри - обладают мощным уроном в ближнем бою, очень подвижные, дальние атаки опрокидывают героя). Куда проще было убивать тролля, патрона, циклопа, молоха, чем потрошителя.

Огромный выбор оружия и скиллов позволяет каждому выбрать, что больше нравится. И, как показала практика, против каждого противника можно выбрать наиболее удобный вариант оружия (некоторых лучше бить холодным, кого-то из стрелкового, а кто-то отлично умирает под залпами огнемета).

Спутники (коих 7) имеют свой взгляд на мир и, оценивая решения Джакса (ГГ), (За исключением Дрона Крони У-4), часто комментируют действия героя, порой влезают в диалоги с другими НПЦ. Это добавляет атмосферности игре. При этом у каждого спутника свой арсенал оружия, соответствующий его принадлежности к фракции.
Единственный минус: Фальк, отличный спутник с огнеметом, но нужно следить, чтобы в бою он не встал за спину, иначе шмальнет в Джакса, собьет его взрывом с ног и радостные мобы сожрут героя, не дав ему подняться.

Игра очень схожа с Fallout-ами (3, Вегас), поэтому порой не хватало возможности вести огонь из положения сидя. Хотя это и не критично, просто меньше пуль поймаешь xD

Отдельный вопрос о сложности. Она здесь реализована хорошо, на максимальной сложности нельзя нагибать, как это было в Скайриме или Фаллаутах без модов (усиливающих противников). Однако, в тоже время первые 15-20 часов игры придется много бегать, а в бою молиться на то, чтобы монстры заагрились на спутника, ибо Джакс падает от 1-2-х ударов. Потом, при получении "крутых" пушек станет полегче, но расслабляться это не позволит (на макс сложности): пак шустрых монстров может загрызть все равно.
Правда, сложность можно в любой момент изменить, если она показалась вам чрезмерной.

Ну и самый главный плюс - это проработанность "квестовых итемов". Если в первой готике обчистить сундук алхимика до взятия квеста у гильдии воров, то квест будет "запорот" (вы не сможете его сделать). Придется откатывать игру до момента, где вы не обчистили сундук.
Здесь же не важно, когда нашел итем, игра начислит опыт за найденный квестовый предмет, а в диалогах изменятся варианты выбора. К примеру, Док в Форте просит найти украденные препы. Их можно украсть у Хламера еще до встречи с Доком. Тогда в разговоре с Доком не будет варианта, где попытаться узнать информацию о воре (потеряете немного опыта, но зато квест в любом случае можно будет сдать), зато сразу будет вариант - отдать украденные препы.

Общий вердикт: удачное переизложение Готики в постапокалиптическом мире. 10 писающих ПНС из 10!
(струю мочи реально видно xD)

Elex, un mineral que cae en la tierra y transforma a todos. Las razas que existen se definen por que es lo que hacen con este mineral (Transmutarlo en mana, consumirlo para evolucionar, utilizarlo para armas, o hacer "energizantes")
Posiblemente se llegue a posicionar como uno de los tres juegos mas infravalorados del año, y todo eso a causa de que probablemente toman lo mejor de renombrados juegos de rol como The witcher 3 o skyrim, y aun asi puede quedarse un poco corto por que su apartado técnico es bueno pero no sobresaliente, algo que puede solucionarse totalmente usando un mod de reshade o de Sweet Fx, pero a nivel jugable es demasiado bueno en cuanto a la inmersión y al numero de actividades por hacer , eso sin mencionar lo enorme de su mapa sin ningún tiempo de cargas entre zonas.
Lo que mas me atrajo de este juego fue su historia, algo totalmente original y algo fundamental en los juegos de rol.
Recomendado.
Ne se lance plus depuis la derniere MAJ, la réparation me fait télécharger le jeu en boucle...

Отвратительная боевая система: 3/4 времени игры вы просто груша для битья, квесты выполнять на убийство кого либо становится мучительным прожиганием времени. 1/4 времени вы просто ходите и косите всех и вся (по крайней мере за персонажа раскачанного на ближний бой, последний босс ударить даже не успел перед смертью).
Остальные элемнты игры боле мене на уровне.
К покупке не советую никому даже со скидкой.

Ein Spiel was das alte Gothic-fieber geweckt hat.
Typisch holziges Kampfsystem aber dafür eine gute Geschichte mit ein mehr oder weniger starken roten Faden der sich durch das Spiel zieht.
Die verschiedenen Handlungsmöglichkeiten geben auch wieder eine Anregung zum öfters spielen.
Aber egal wie man sich später entscheided oder skillt... der Plasmawerfer ist einfach die stärkste Waffe im Spiel und einfach übertrieben. Pls nerv. xD
Cooles spiel. Empfehlung. :D

Elex is an interesting take on the RPG genre in the sense that it is more focused around the world and factions, and the traditional RPG elements, like progression and custimization, are just minor ways to keep the player interested in the game while they explore the story and the factions. The combat is a 5.5/10, where ranged combat feels like its 10 years ahead of its time in 1990 and where the melee combat feels like you're fighting that bitch from fate stay night where her weapon is invisible and you're super confused as to why you got hit, but it is still satisfying to win a fight against a tougher opponent, the difficulty curve is just right, and the story and characters are well done. Despite the lack of polish in the hitboxes, unsual voices to match character models, and the fact that every single character has a sword but all of their arms phase through them, Elex has good base concepts and lots to offer for someone who wants a time sink in an interesting world. Still not sure why they gave one of the viking dudes an Indian accent tho.

Ich kann das Spiel jedem weiterempfehlen, der die vorherigen Piranha Bytes Spiele mochte.
Auch wenn die Grafik nicht unbedingt auf dem neuesten Stand ist, sieht das Spiel doch sehr schön und stimmig aus. Vor allem die Beleuchtung(besonders die Sonnenuntergänge!) und die Weitsicht sind sehr schön anzusehen.

Die Story konnte mich im Gegensatz zu Risen 3 überzeugen und war für Piranha-Verhältnisse ausgesprochen gut. Der Bosskampf ist mal wieder zu einfach ausgefallen, aber die Endsequenz hat mich zufriedengestellt. Ich bin auf jeden Fall gespannt, was in Elex 2 passiert. Hierbei ist auch das Questsystem sehr gut ausgearbeitet, weil es immer zwei oder mehrere Möglichkeiten gibt, eine Mission anzugehen. 
Besonders ist hierbei auch, wie sich Quests auf das Spielgeschehen auswirken kann, was in Piranha Bytes letztem Spiel doch eher mau aus.

Zum Kampfsystem lässt sich sagen, dass es nicht jedem gefällt und vielen hackelig ist. Ich hatte keine Probleme damit und war froh, dass das Kampfsystem verbessert wurde. Dank Ausdauerleiste und Jetpack fühlen sich die Kämpfe besser an als in den Risen 2 oder Risen 3. Nun reichts nicht mehr aus einfach zu dauerklicken, nun muss man den richtigen Zeitpunkt für Combos finden und wie üblich das Angriffsmuster der Gegnertypen erkennen bzw. lernen. Und es gibt nichts zufriedenstellenderes als die Gegner mit dem Jetpack-Angriff auf den Boden zu hauen. Auch das Combo System halte ich für eine gute Idee. Den Kritikpunkt, dass die Leiste unten links ist und somit ablenkt, kann ich weniger nachvollziehen, da man ein  Gespür dafür bekommt wann man seine Combo ausführen kann, man muss also nicht ständig auf die Combo-Leiste achten.

Die Spielwelt ist riesig und es gibt überall was zu sehen und zu finden. Ich hab das Spiel jetzt zwei mal durchgespielt und wahrscheinlich nicht alles gesehen. Auch die Fraktionswahl ist diesmal sehr interessant, da es komplett verschiedene Richtungen sind.

This game is like a masterclass in how NOT to create game systems.

Every system, from the fight mechanics to the UI to the world design is frustrating and painful. It's not just bad or buggy, it's like it's been deliberately designed to be as unfriendly to the player as possible.

Examples:
- Day/night system, where NPCs sleep at night and entering a home at night is criminal... but there's no clock.
- No quest markers, forcing you to talk to every NPC individually.
- Quests that only become available after a certain point, forcing you to talk to everyone AGAIN.
- No town map, signposts, or any useful indication of where to get services, unless you already know,
- NPCs have routines and wander about. Some are marked on the map, but not all, making some of them really hard to find.
- Roaming enemies that will one-shot you from a distance.
- No indication of enemy difficulty besides a skull marker that appears way too late. Things with the skull vastly outlevel you. Things without the skull might also vastly outlevel you and there is [i]no way of knowing[/i].
- No indication of quest difficulty. Quests can be virtually impossible to complete but you can't tell until you die trying.
And more...

The game itself has some nice themes and some interesting lore, but the story is a bit bland. There are no real "choices", just alternate ways of doing the same thing.
The controls are so clunky, the combat is clunky, walking is clunky, literally doing anything in this game is so unsatisfying its unbelievable.

Piranha Bytes leben immer noch! :D
Nach dem Meilenstein-hinlegenden Gothic 1 (2001), dem legendären Gothic 2 (2002 - nicht zu vergessen dem besten RPG-Addon dieser Zeit: "Nacht des Raben"), dem total üblen Bug-Fest "Gothic 3" (2006) und der Piratenflair-verströmenden Risen-Trilogie (2009-2014) kommt nun endlich Elex daher. Und es glänzt und rostet zu gleichen Teilen.

Warum?
Klären wir sofort.

Erst einmal solltet ihr, falls ihr wie ich großer Fan der Reihe seid, wissen: Elex ist ein waschechtes PB-Game und fühlt sich auch genauso an: Dialoge (eingesprochen, räumen sich in den Menüs schön übersichtlich auf, wenn einmal durchexerziert, Figuren sind immer raue und irgendwie oberflächliche, aber lustige Abziehbilder ihrer Selbst), hölzerne Animationen, sich komisch anfühlendes Fallen und Kämpfen sowie ruckartiges Klettern, rudimentär implementierte Neuerungen (Ausdauer), per hand designte wunderschöne Welt, viele verschiedene Lager, dessen Fraktionen man sich für die jeweiligen Vor- und Nachteile unumkehrbar anschließen kann, unfassbar viele individuell eingesprochene Questdialoge, dessen Questabläufe sich aber von der Designart her stark ähneln (Viecher tothauen oder Dinge sammeln... mehr gibt's prinzipiell nicht!) und und und...

Aber was macht Elex nun anders?
Erst einmal wäre da das Setting: Postapokalyptische Welt mit vermodernder bzw. aufsprießender Technik (wir kämpfen gegen Mechs und Laserwaffen benutzende Albs) vermischt mit alteingesessenem bekannten PB-typischen Mittelalter. Der Mix klappt ganz gut, aber ich persönlich hab nur Pfeil und Bogen sowie Nahkampfwaffen benutzt. Das Schießen an sich geht jetzt leichter und schöner von der Hand, aber fühlt sich teilweise immer noch holprig an - genauso wie Laserprojektile wie Eiszapfen aussehen, eigenartig gerade fliegen (und nicht so elegant wie in Star Wars) und Zapp-Stromschlag-Effekte ganz billig über die eigene Figur flimmern als würde man eine Hommage an die Filmeffekte der 70er feiern. Wer stirbt erhält prompt "ENDE" als Schriftzug über den Bildschirm geklebt, während des Fallens und Auftreffens auf den Boden muss der Held immer noch ein wenig in die Knie gehen und ist derweil bewegungsunfähig (die altbekannte PB-Animationsträgheit ist zum Teil noch vorhanden), in Kämpfen ist man superträge und ausweichen kostet Ausdauer (total plemplem, auch wenn Dark Souls usw. das vormachen = no way!), lässt sich aber in dem sehr guten Schwierigkeitsgradkonfigurator individuell anpassen! Sehr großes Lob dafür.

Denn wie so oft kriegt man am Anfang so richtig schön auf's Maul. Das nervt unfassbar unheimlich, aber am schlimmsten ist, dass Grundattribute wie Stärke, Gerissenheit und Konstitution gar nicht DIREKT was bringen, sondern nur Zahlen sind, die hochgeschubst werden, um die Anforderungen bestimmter Loot-Items zu erfüllen und dann Rüstungen und Waffen zu tragen, die euch stärker machen. Eure Figur ist  am Ende des Spiels noch genauso schwach und doof wie am Anfang, wenn ihr ihr einfach nur eine Metallstange und gar nix zum Anziehen ausrüstet. Bravo. Was war ich enttäuscht darüber wie WENIG Waffen und Rüstungen ich zu Beginn kriege, sondern ich gezwungen bin mich schnell einer Fraktion anzuschließen, die mir dann die Rüstungen bereit stellt. Darüber hinaus kann ich auch in die entlegendsten Winkel der gigantischen Welt huschen - und finde nur Zigaretten (ich habe mal über 7000 Stück davon verkauft - und damit den fetten Reibach gemacht o.O wtf?!), Öllampen, Schrottreste oder irgendeinen der Drölfzig Milliarden Krüge. Ich wiederhole.... MOTHERF***ING KRÜGE. Warum? Wenn das wenigstens eine lustig anschaubare Sammelkollektion mit lustigen Bildern drauf wär, aber no way... da seh ich einen VOLLEN Schrank mit allerlei Krempel - und was kann ich einstecken? Den Krug und den Besen daneben. Wtf?
Ich habe mich oft genug aufgeregt was für random Schrott ich in der Welt finde. Weniger wäre absolut mehr gewesen. Weniger Scheiß platzieren und dafür mehr sinnvolle Sachen. Auch ist die Welt sehr groß, aber nicht optimal befüllt. Ich treffe Leute mit einzigartigem Namen, die mir ans Leder wollen. Hä? Warum? Reden die nicht normalerweise erst mit mir? Ansonsten könnten die doch einfach generisch "Bandit" heißen so wie alle anderen Hans Würste, die noch mit Level 1 denken ich wäre der Louie von Nebenan - nur um dann den Scheitel nachgezogen zu bekommen.

Generell gilt: Baue immer schön eine Combo im Kampf auf, sieh zu, dass das Monster durch jeden zweiten Schlag einen Ausfallschritt macht und du haust sie alle um. Und wenn nicht - einfach im Kampf speichern, neu laden und wieder probieren. Nur hohe Combos machen echten Schaden. Alles andere ist Firlefanz.

Elex hat aber auch zum ersten Mal eine Story und die ist ganz angenehm. Nicht glänzend toll, aber viiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiel besser als alles andere was PB bisher geliefert hat (man denke nur an den Murks aus Gothic 3..., wo Xardas einfach mit einem ins Gebüsch läuft und dann ist das Spiel vorbei...). Toll ist auch, dass jegliche Entscheidungen und gestorbene Figuren Auswirkungen auf die Story und teilweise das Schicksal ganzer Städte haben... euer (mentaler) Kälte-Wert hat da auch noch etwas mitzureden - denn ihr seid ein emotionskalter Alb auf Elex-Entzug, der neuen Modedroge der Zukunft.

Wie dem auch sei: Ich hatte großen Spaß, auch wenn ich mich sehr mit einigen Tatsachen engagieren musste. PB bleibt seiner Linie treu - was gut und teilweise auch superschlecht ist. Animationen aus der Programmiergruft, Lootplatzierung aus der Hölle und Loot-for-the-win (if there's anything to loot...) Skillsystem VS krass große und krass schöne Welt, schöner rauer Umgangston, viel Komfort beim Spielen und Milliarden Quests plus eine solide PB-untypisch gute Story erwarten euch. Entscheidet selbst, ob ihr's euch gebt. Auf jeden Fall geiler als Mass Effect Andromeda :)

Bisogna andarci piano nel recensire ELEX.

Vuoi perché lo sto bocciando, vuoi anche per la "bronzea" eredità che lo sviluppatore gode ancora per la serie Gothic.

Però dai, ora basta. Piranha Byte sinceramente  ha rotto il batacchio.

Tutti i suoi giochi sono praticamente la fotocopia di quello precedente.
Sono furbi eh, questo va ammesso. Perché cambiano radicalmente l'ambientazione e li fanno sempre sembrare giochi nuovi.

E invece è sempre la solita solfa.

No seriamente, ora sono stufo. E' l'ultima volta che mi fregano vendendomi l'ennesimo clone di Gothic con grafica diversa.

Siamo nel 2018 e gli open-world games si confrontano con GTA, Skyrim e The Witcher. Non puoi presentarti, allo stesso prezzo, con un gioco fermo al 2006.

Gli NPC sono morti come degli strafatti di crack. La customizzazione assente. Non ci sono bambini (hey non pensate male ma, essendo genitore, potrete capire che un mondo di soli adulti mi suoni molto strano). L'esplorazione, per quanto divertente non offre mai vere sorprese.

Ecco, forse è quest'ultimo punto ad avermi fatto capire l'inganno dei giochi Piranha Byte.
In ELEX si esplora con un gusto "alla Fallout" ma, per quanti rischi si corrono, i premi non arrivano MAI.

Giuro, non si viene mai premiati in nulla.

Cazzo, se volevo prendere soltanto delle sole mi limitavo ad andare a lavorare. Se gioco, voglio essere trattato bene!

Insomma, esplorare una base segreta militare piena di mutanti, solo per ricevere una scheda di controllo (un oggetto quest) di cui non so nulla e che scoprirò mi servirà solo 12 ore più avanti è... beh fa schifo. Niente armi o armature fighe, solo un oggetto quest.

Non solo, spesso e volentieri nelle vostre eplorazioni in luoghi estremamente pericolosi troverete soltanto sigarette, ferraglia, carta igienica (non scherzo troverete tonnellate di rotoli) e delle magnifiche... foto degli sviluppatori.
No dico... siete seri?
Esploro zone piene di mutanti per essere premiato con delle foto di sviluppatori grassottelli con la faccia annichilita dalla birra?
Ma vaffanculo va.

Va detto che la storia non è male, ma subisce i ritmi narrativi dei tedeschi, che alla fine sono solo capici di alzare le vendite degli stupefacenti.

Insomma... non fate come me: non spendete 30 euri per poi buttare via 50 ore della vostra vita per dare un senso alla spesa assurda. 
Non comprate sta minchiata.

Piranha Byte deve capire che è tempo di finirla con il riciclare lo stesso maledetto gioco (del cazzo) over and over.

Baci.

Aggiungo una nota sul combattimento: penoso.

Fino al livello 10 non potete uccidere nulla, manco un tacchino morto. Il che significa che dovrete portarvi un compagno per provvedere al danno inflitto ai nemici.
Peccato che i compagni, in combattimento, siano più buggati di un gioco Bethesda al primo giorno di rilascio. Non riescono quasi mai a mirare correttamente e il giocatore è costretto a iniziare la danza di posizionamento per permettere a 'sti fattoni di colpire il bersaglio.

Dopo il livello 10, all'improvviso, si riesce ad uccidere qualcosa da soli ma il combattimento si scopre essere nient'altro che un rhythm game in cui bisogna premere al momento giusto per incrementare il danno. Avete presente Witcher 1 (si l'UNO) ? Ecco, aggiungete un minimo di movimento e avrete il combat system in mischia di ELEX. Noioso e incerto. Il controllo del personaggio non è fluido e l'esito del combattimento non è strettamente legato alle vostre capacità di gaming, ma più che altro alla fortuna legata al fatto che il PG faccia o meno quello che volete davvero fare. 

Quindi alla fine preferirete usare le armi a distanza e vi ritroverete ad usare strategie da bar over and over: la mia per esempio è posizionarsi in alto e bersagliare tutti con il lanciafiamme (che in realtà funziona come un lanciagranate... lol). 
Dove non è possibile (al chiuso), basta usare i consumabili che si trovano in giro (tipo lo scudo temporaneo e l'esplosione cinetica), tanto ne avrete a decine.
super spiel dynamisch spielerfahrung und super story, aber müssen noch etwas arbeit ins kampfsystem reinstecken dann wird teil 2 der renner

Certe en 2018, ce genre de jeu pourrait en rebuter plus d'un, tout depend ce que vous chercher dans un jeu solo, en monde ouvert, le menu d'inventaire est faible et simple certe mais faut pas s'arreter la. La map est grande, il y a des quetes a la pelle qui change le cours de l'histoire suivant vos actes... la barre de vie a l'ancienne, oui le debut est très galere, on débute avec une barre de fer et les monstres sont aléatoire, par aléatoire je veut dire que aussi bien vous aller tomber sur un monstre faible mais la seconde d'après, un peu plus loin ben ce sera un grand troll et ou seule la fuite sera efficace. Il faut aimer s'adapter aux situations car vous aller progresser très lentement, il ne faut pas bourriner/ rusher le jeu, etre bien observateur (pour des codes de coffres qui sont ecrit sur des papier par exemple ou mur). et surtout etre patient. 

2022 : je me suis refait une partie et ce jeu continue de me surprendre, il y a des morceau de phot de l'équipe de dev caché un peu partout et ça je trouve que c'est genial, ce jeu est magnifique quand on explore la map, les rendus sont assez incroyable pour l'époque de sortie, meme fini la quete principale on peut continuer le jeu, explorer chaque recoin et on trouve des note ici et la qui nous apprenne un peu plus sur magallan, j'adore ! 

il y a plusieurs fin dans l'histoire principale selon votre niveau de froideur (cold) mais pour elex 2 a priori une fin canon a été choisie donc ne vous embetez pas a commencer l'aventure avant elex2.

Elex is an open-world action RPG.  I'm a huge fan of this type of game, so I picked this up the moment I felt it was affordable enough to do so.  The overall appearance of the game is nice, with graphics that are clean and pretty, but nothing special.  The setting is interesting, with a clever take on the post-apocolyptic world.  The voice acting is bad...even laughable in places, but I've definitely experienced worse.  The combat is slow and smooth, but I get the sense it works just how the creators wanted it to.   Characters don't bounce all over the battlefield attacking opponents with a myriad of strikes.  The combat is purposeful and deliberate, requiring the player to be thoughtful about when to attack and when to dodge.  Overall the game is fun, but I'm having trouble engaging with it like I have with games like Fallout, Elder Scrolls, and others.  I'm hesitant to reccomend it, but am going to do so at this point since I'm confident there are those who are fond of the genre that will enjoy this game.  Overall I'm not loving it, but I don't dislike it either.  They do a good job, but it's not quite enough for me to fall in love with it.

Endlich mal wieder ein richtig geiles Game!!!
Weiter so PB!

-= Графика =-
----------------- 
хорошая, местами картинку игра выдает так вообще великолепную. 
Множество мелочей, которые графодрочеры не замечают, создает отличный визуальный ряд. Например такие банальные вещи, как песок, который ветер перегоняет по дюнам в пустыне, всякая растительная мелочь, летающая в воздухе в чаще леса, вполне приемлемая обработка воды и дыма и т.п.

Да, сам графический движок не идеальный (например прорисовка динамических теней более чем от одного источника света неадекватная, особенно в закрытых пространствах), но тут скорее всего как обычно разработчиков толкал сам маркетинг. Полигонов и детализации местами сильно недоложили, многочисленные следы спешки, особенно в малопосещаемых областях.

Отдельно симуляция погоды - тут разработчики недукрутили. Такого состояния как пасмурная погода в игре фактически нет. Дождь идет под солнышком. Ночь тоже в угоду современным тенденциям и не ночь, а так, очень темный день.


-= Физика =-
------------------
Вполне себе приемлемая. У главного героя и у всех остальных персонажей есть такие важные параметры как масса, скорость, инерция. Это значит что какой-нибудь монстр не сорвется мгновенно с места в галоп, а будет разгоняться нападая на вас, да и сам ГГ не сможет резко стартануть, прыгнуть и в полете изменить направление на 180 градусов невзирая на инерцию (даже джетпак не всегда так может).

Предметы так же ведут себя вполне адекватно. Квадратное стоит, круглое катится, мертвое падает с обрыва как и полагается.


-= Геймлей и окружение =-
----------------------------- 
Опять же, управление удобное. Не надо заучивать 100 комбинаций клавиш. 

Очень нравится поведение ГГ. Чувствуется, что он взаимодействует в окружающим миром. Опять же мелочи типа "иду радом со стенкой, придержусь на нее чтобы не спонтнуться" или "взлетаю под потолок, защищу голову чтобы не разбить ее нафиг" и т.п.

Интересная система спутников. Очень полезные и ненавязчивые. Не страшно его потерять, не страшно что умрет. В диалогах спутники часто участвуют и вставляют очень подходящие по месту реплики. У каждого спутника есть свое мнение и своя оценка происходящему.

Имитация жизни вполне себе достойная. Очень нравится что мир не напичкан монстрами по 100 шт на кв.м. а равномерно. Стычки происходят именно нужной частотой, чтобы не скучать, но и в то же время не надоедают. 

NPC ведут себя как обычные болванчики, как и в других играх с открытым миром. Единственное особенность - если NPC говорит, что куда то пойдет - он действительно идет, а не перемещается мгновенно, когда ГГ отворачивается.

Идея джетпака так же отличная. Игра перестает быть плоской и появляется еще вертикаль. Всегда интересно залететь на холм, старую башню, прыгнуть в яму и посмотреть, что там. Разработчики мудро решили, что при должном старании можно и без джетпака залезть куда не просят, так зачем ограничивать игрока?

Атмосфера постапокалипсиса передана в целом успешно, но нет искры. Нет вот этой хроники событий, произошедшей после падения кометы. Непонятно, куда делись города. Почему уцелели некоторые постойки, почему в пустыне так много металического и электронного хлама, в других областях нет. Как жила цивилизация до падения кометы и т.п. 

Самое главное - нет этого дурацкого автоуровня врагов, которое делает бессмысленным прокачку.


-= Боевая система и оружие =-
----------------------------------
Одна из немногих игр, в которой смешивается древнее оружие и высокие технологии. Колдуй одной рукой, поливая из лазерной винтовки другой рукой.

Рукопашные схватки динамичные, заканчиваюются на поздних этапах достаточно быстро. Закликать противника можно, но надо очень четко соблюдать тайминги атаки. Одна ошибка и бьют уже тебя.

Перестрелки не такие интересные, но виноват в этом AI врагов. Противник фактически не умеет маневрировать, обходить, делать засады и т.п. Просто прут напролом.


-= Прокачка =-
-----------------------
Вызывает много споров, но в основном она непонятна тем, кто не играл в другии игры Пираний. НА очки силы, ловкости и прочего надо смотреть иначе. Это всего лишь требования к ГГ для того, чтобы он мог взять соответствующее его уровню оружие и шмот. С тем же успехом, очки силы можно например заменить на "очки доспехов", ловкость на "обращение с легким оружием", хитрость на "дипломатию" и т.п. 


-= Крафт =-
---------------------
Дань моде. Какая же игра про открытый мир и без крафта? В принципе вещь нужная, но можно прожить и без него. 


-= Сюжет и мотивация ГГ =-
-----------------
Отличный сюжет, концовку конечно как обычно слили, но сами квесты великолепные. Поиграв за каждую фракцию понимаешь как живет этот мир.
Мотивация ГГ так же выражена, у него есть цель, у него есть прошлое, у него есть память, у него есть враги и бывшие друзья и он не остановится перед выснением случившегося с ним.


-= Минусы (которые плюсы) =-
------------------------------------------
Как и другие игры - эта страдает одинаковыми лицами NPC. Ключевые персонажи еще туда-сюда, а вот болванчики - это просто фабрика клонов.

У домов нет дверей, по мне это минус, т.к. двери сделать точно можно, видимо в последним момент двери сломались и разработчики их просто выпилили из игры.

Нет детей - тоже странно, но понятно, рейтинги и все такое. 
Обида для толерантных - в игре нет негров и нетрадиционно ориентированных.
Нет возможности ставить более одной отметки на карте.
Нет цифрового выражения параметров ГГ (хотя это отнесу к плюсам. И так понятно, что стальные доспехи защищают лучше, чем футболка, а большое зелье лечит лучше малого). 

Плюсы и минусы игры можно перечислять еще долго и не смотря ни на что, Элекс - отличная игра в духе Готики, со своей атмосферой, которую не всегда понимают геймеры нового поколения. Здесь нет задротства в стиле "открой все значки на карте", "разори все гнезда монстров", нет тупого гринда, нет принеси-подай-сгенерированных ежедневных квестов. 

Здесь каждый играет как ему нравится, идет куда хочет, делает что считает нужным, игра не говорит "нажмите Q чтобы победить", "иди по стрелке, нужный предмет подсвечеш прожектором".  До всего доходишь сам. И в этом прелесть. Это игра не про графику и крутые 4k текстуры, а про главного героя и ту ситуацию, в которую его занела жизнь.

ELEX the newest game from Piranha Bytes, the guys known mainly for the Gothic series.

First of all, if someone expect here a new Gothic.... no, just no.
Risen wasn't Gothic, ELEX isn't Gothic either.

Is this something bad? No.
Here's why.

ELEX builds on the fundamanetals Gothic 1&2 had:
- Open World, that feels alive 
- Good progression system
- 3 factions
- A world that reacts to the choices you make
- Free Character developmeant
- Skill and reaction based combat
- Good Voice acting, that is sometimes cheesy and thats good

ELEX has these things and builds up on them, while bringing new things to the table.
Since we moved now to a post-apocalypse setting, we have not just a more modern open world, but also new tools to work with.
As example, you can finally make a complete build for ranged Combat, without the need to draw a meele weapon every 5 seconds. This wasn't really possible (or easy) in the past PB games and it feels this time good.
The Moral System from Risen 3 is back too, it's now just named different and has a bigger impact on the game.
Depending on how much of an .... unfriendly person you were, you get restricted to dialoge options or get bonus on certain attributes.
Character builds and progression feels good. You can really see how your character gets stronger and more skilled over time. The open world of PB helps, since nothing is scalled according to your level and a Mountain Troll will always be a mountain troll, no matter how far you're in the game.
The world reacts to your choices and actions, the other factions treat you completly different based on which one you joined. The same goes for your choices. Most of you choices during quests and dialoges can change the outcome of the mainstory and what options you latter have left. I mean, you can literaly join the big evil in the end, if you have choosen a specific path.

So all this sounds so good, what are the bad things about the game?
Honestly, the Combat.
It feels clunky and unfinished, the new stamina system is a nice idea, but there're certain enemys with infinite stamina, that literally spam you to death and you can't do anything against it.
The Combat is sadly the worst part of this game, but it's still manageable.
I get constant Gothic 1 flashbacks, when I think about the Combat, it has a lot of similiar problems. It feels mainly clunky and unfinished. Something they improved on a lot in Gothic 2 and I belive if there will be an ELEX 2, they will fix the combat.
Another minor problem is the enemy placement. Some very strong mobs, are placed directly in the beginning area and the game regulary respawns mobs, after every so and so many level. I figured fast out how to deal with them, the problem is not everyone who bought this game has a PB background and certainly has problems with this. Another thing that can be improved on with a sequel.
The guidance is also problematic, since you get less infos were to go, than in Skyrim. At least you got a map with marker, but thats not a really good excuse for not telling people during the dialoge, where to go.

ELEX is a good gamel, even with it's glaring weaknesses. It feels thought out and unlike Risen 2 and 3, it feels like a lot of love time and experience was put into this game.
If I would have to rate this game, I give it a 7/10 and put it into the spot as PB 3rd best game. Right behind G1 and 2.

First off, I never write reviews. This game made me want to go out of my way to do so, so this should tell you something!
I'm 69 hours in at the time of this review, but in game I feel like I've barely scratched the surface.
Fair warning, I want to do this review in depth, considering there are so many negative reviews out there that are reeeeeally unjustified imo; but the tldr, do you like rpgs? Scifi? Fantasy? Yes? Buy this game.

Disclaimer
All of the negative reviews made me leery of buying this, so I watched a loooot of gameplay and read tons of reviews.
I will be comparing Elex to Elder Scrolls as that is a lifelong favorite of mine.
Elex is a very DEEP rpg. If you don't like immersive games, games where you need to talk to people and get involved in the world, then it probably isn't for you. It reminds me of Morrowind; it gives you the basics and sets you loose!

Things this game does BRILLIANTLY.
1. The lore!
Everything in Elex exists for a reason. There are so many reviews saying "why do XYZ do things this way" "why are there XYZ mutants". If you are asking this, you need to go talk to the people! The Berserkers will explain their culture, the clerics their religion. Everything meshes together so well into a very well written and interesting narrative.
The choices, like joining a faction, can be rough. It isn't like ES where you can be an archmage and the thieves guild leader, and so on and so on. You choose 1. Live with it.
-----
2. The World.
Open means Open. The world is huge! And exploration is awesome! The ES is great, but the worlds often seem repetitive/copy pasted. Every inch of Elex seems unique; FEELS unique! And moreover, everything belongs there.
The world is cohesive and fluid... and just... makes sense. You would think having so many environments would feel 'shoe-horned' in, but there are in game reasons why it is that way.
I'm rarely one to say a game's graphics are beautiful, graphics are user dependent, but the world is absolutely beautiful.
-
You want to follow the main quest? Cool. You want to immediately (yes almost literally immediately) say F*** off and go do your own thing? Thats great too!
-----
2A. Its a NON-ZOMBIE post-apocalyptic, Sci-Fi Fantasy... And it works!
First, I've heard people say that the background is overused, been done, etc. To me thats like saying "oh, another fiction book? thats been done!"
You can be fighting trolls with an axe in armor, come upon collapsed high-voltage powerline towers and remember "oh right, we were once a modern society". OR you can be shooting mutants in a destroyed research facility with a plasma rifle, see berserkers cast their version of magic, and you remember that there is way more than strict science going on.
It's just a crazy mix of things that I think is a great new twist.
-----
3. Quests
The quests are all unique and fun! There is almost always at least one way to solve it, even if sometimes you have to go looking for the other way!
I'm still a bit sour about one quest. No spoiler, but I did it the totally straightforward way and the whole time it felt a bit strange. I finish it when I'm told there were other ways I could have done it (and I would have, had I known). There were no repercussions, but npcs bring it up from time to time, and it still bothers me that I didn't try it another way.
IT's just those kind of things that make the game so immersive.
Other choices will definitely bite you in the a** if you choose wrong.


OK
1. Gameplay/Control
The jetpack is awesome! My wife who hates videogames, stopped to watch me play and even started asking questions about the game because even she noticed what a unique idea it is.
-
People seem to slam how combat is done. It seems pretty average; I can't find any major fault. If I hadn't read people hating on it I wouldn't even bring it up. You have a quick, heavy, and special attack. I think people get thrown off by the third person perspective maybe? And that the game is DEADLY. No shame in playing on easy with this game if you have to!
The actual speed of control is good though. More on the realistic side of things, as in you cant shoot as your being hit, it takes time to swing a massive hammer, and ammo is scarce but guns are powerful!
I can't say it's any better or worse than say Skyrim... It's just different.
-----
2. Voice Acting
I actually like the acting ~90% of the time. There's that small portion of the time that I think something didn't mesh up right, and a character's voice doesn't match or the inflection is weird. But given the sheer quantity of lines, I thinks it is done well.
-
In addition, this is good or bad depending on what you like; you have to talk to NPCs and read what they say. I loved it, I don't think you ever see games like this, and it has a good story to boot! But if you just want to fast click through every dialog then this isn't for you.
-----
3. Weapons/Armor/custimization
Mixed bag here, and unfortunately so. The weapons are great! Tons of variety, unique weapons, hidden weapons, crafting, upgrading, shooting, stabbing, blasting...
Sadly, Armor falls short for me. What you can get without joining a faction is quite limited. and then after joining there are effectively 3 (i believe) sets for each faction. It felt to me at least like you miss out on 2/3 of the armor the game has to offer.
-
There is limited base building... sort of. But aside from more armor/outfits, with the lore as it is, it seemed like Elex is crying out for a way for the player to really shape their own base. (unlimited inventory hurt them here too. Without a need for containers, why do you need a base?)

The Bad
Technical Gripes
WASD in jetpack should move you faster, it feels like you can't move much when flying.
The minimap should actually display a small portion of the map, not a blank black circle with indicators.
Looting would be much more enjoyable if it were similar to ES; and limitless inventory, while convenient, I didn't enjoy.
I tweaked the hotkeys for a long time. the native config was not intuitive to me at all. But once I got it going it was much better.
-
Tracking of places and NPCs is rough. The map should have names of places, landmarks, peoples houses, or npc trackers. SOMETHING to help you find your way back to somewhere you've been before. It can be agrivating trying to find a particular warlord and not remembering which house he's in or where that house is.
-----
They missed the boat a bit with customization. The audience that is going to like this super detailed world, is likely going to want detailed character customization.
They do have this, but I think they'd have been better served by expanding their 5 attributes, and giving more options to specialize your character into a "class".
If I play an outlaw faction character, I wish it were viable to be a tank, stealth, ranged, etc. and the same for each faction. As opposed to each faction already having a typical type of member.

Overall, it is a really good game. Well worth the money. I hope they keep updating this as there are a few minor things that would greatly improve gameplay.
But I think the negatives are very, very minor. If you enjoy scifi, fantasy, and rpgs, I really don't see how you won't enjoy Elex.

Eu estava rezando para a Piranha Bytes seguir a tradição do Gothic e Risen nesse Elex e não tentarem mudar como fizeram no Risen 2 e Gothic 4, mas graças a Calaan, a PB seguiu a tradição dos seus jogos que fez a desenvolvedora ter fama. O jogo é ótimo. Tentanto o finalizar rapidamente e deixando quests secundárias e lugares no mapa inexplorados, precisei de quase 80 horas de jogo para o finalizar, sem contar nas várais revira-voltas que a história vai te dando, com várias surpresas e ambientes trabalhados milimetricamentes para serem perfeitos. Com um mapa gigante, vários personagens, tipos de armas e magias, quests pra dar e vender, itens colecionáveis e conquistas à rodo, se você for fã de RPGs hardore e também gostar dos jogos da Piranha Bytes, ELEX vai te deixar preso a ele por pelo menos 50 horas de jogo (isso se você não quiser testar outras facções no jogo para o jogar por completo, nesse caso são 150 horas).

O jogo teve algumas coisas que desviaram dessas tradições... o que na minha opinião foram o adquirir buffs fortes para seu personagem de maneira muito fácil, como o Jet Pack e os Companions. Companions poderiam ser mais difíceis de conseguir a amizade, e no começo do jogo quando você ainda está fraco eles são muito fortes e fazem o trabalho por você, enquanto pro final quando você está forte eles são inúteis. o Jet Pack poderia ser melhorável e quando você o adiquirisse ele fosse fraco, mas você poderia ir o melhorando com abilidades de crafting. O Jet Pack também poderia variar de força pelas diferentes facções que você segue... como os Clerics terem os melhores upgrades para o Jet Pack, enquanto os Outlaws terem os Jet Packs mais agressivos e situcionais, e os Beserkers não usarm o Jet Pack, mas no lugar dele, terem magias que fizessem seu pesonagem levitar. Falando em magia, o elex poderia ter seguindo a mesma macânica de magia no Risen 3, visto que foi a melhor em todos os jogos da série por ser uma magia em que você pudesse usar melee ou ranged ao mesmo tempo, de maneira bem variada)... sem falar mal da magia atual do Elex, ela é legal, mas a do Risen 3 é melhor.

O jogo também tem muitos bugs e parece ''não finalizado corretamente''... como o fato do efeito da chuva ser ridículo (tem vezes que chove sem ter som da chuva caindo, ou chove sem o ambiente ficar com a textura de molhado, ou chove sem o tempo no jogo nem estar com núvens), ou ao fato de seu personagem cair em uma pedra e fazer o som dele caindo em um chão de madeira, ou ao fato de em vários diálogos com NCPs os personagens usarem expressões modernas e atuais sendo que o jogo se passa em um cenário pós-apocalíptico...

FATOU A TRILHA SONORA FEITA PELO KAI ROSENKRANS, a trilha sonora é boa, mas deu saudades da imaservidade que a do gothic e risen te causava, nunca vai ser a mesma sem ser do kai .-.

Também não gostei dessa nablina permanente no mapa. Se eu estou no topo de uma montanha numa região de planície, quero ver tudo de possível ao meu redor, não uma ridícula nebilna como se eu estivesse numa região de neve. Posso estar enganado, mas mexi eu todas as configurações e até na pasta raíz do jogo, mas consegui tirar a maldita neblina.

Having enjoyed Piranha Bytes games in the past to a degree, I gave it a go with Elex and was quite disappointed overall. However, I will first go over a couple of things that I enjoyed about this game.

-The environments in this game are beautiful and well thought-out. While the world itself does not feel as alive as many open-world RPGs, the layout of the landscape is the strongest aspect of the game in my mind. In the first area that you are placed in, there's a giant section where the condemned are sent with sheer cliffs leading down to it - perfect for transversing with the jetpack. There's an enemy base built into a desert cliffside, and a giant town made of junk that, in terms of verticality, blows any of the fallout games out of the water. The world is fun to traverse because of its design - and the jetpack is really great for those moments. Jumping down a huge cliff and then stopping your momentum before hitting the bottom of an interesting new place was great.

- There is a fair amount of player agency. I only made it so far because of the issues that I will list below, but there were many choices and consequences that were made in the time that I played, which is a good quality.

As I said, the game's biggest strength are the environments, but the issues with the rest of the game drag down even one of the best open world environments that I've ever seen. Many aspects of this game are just plain bad, particularly the core gameplay of exploring and fighting!

- The combat is, in my opinion, just plain bad. I took quite a while trying to get used to it, but even when you become more powerful and your character is no longer a complete pushover (which is a big issue at the beginning of the game, causing exploration to be short and sporatic with TONS of quicksaves and loads) the combat is a bit better but still unfulfilling and frustrating. Much of this is due to the animations and rigidness of the combat, moreso than some of the other Piranha Bytes games that I have played, which is saying something. The bottom line is that the combat is brutally difficult but isn't well balanced because of its rigidness. Combat does not flow in this game very well, and it's a chore to do. Your character and the enemy exchange poorly animated blows in frustrating fashion. The game is not too hard to get through, and I'm sure that I could have persevered further, but fighting mutated creatures and bandits should be fun, not like banging my head against a wall. I know that some people don't mind the combat in this game may not feel the same way about it, but after giving it a fair try, I can say that it is very lackluster in my opinion. As a note, difficulty in and of itself is not a problem for combat in games (Dark Souls of course is exhibit A), but difficult combat in a bad system compounds the problem.

- While the layout of the environments themselves are amazing, the world still does not feel very alive. The way that enemies patrol areas just never felt quite right, but maybe this was due to knowing that many times when I had to fight I felt that I was struggling against foes that were not fun to fight against. There's a lot to do and the environment is beautiful, but that itself did not make me want to persevere through the problems.

- The voice acting and characters were generally forgettable and some were unlikable. The protagonist's voice was bearable, but still not ideal. There were no great quests that really caught my attention and wanted to make me keep playing further than I did because the gameplay itself was a chore.

Overall, while ELEX has some good things going for it, the core gameplay is frustrating and I regret spending 45 dollars for this game. There are a myriad of open world games for a fraction of the price that will take you on adventures that don't lead to frustrating mechanics interfering with a walk through the wasteland.

Это НЕ Готика и это стоит принять. Если забыть про это и рассмотреть игру как отдельный проект, то она тянет на 6/10. Хорошая атмосфера, уникальные противники и необычный сюжет. Из минусов: 1. Ужасный открытый мир. Первые часы игры вы будете бегать от всего, что движется (или тыкать каждого врага по минут 5-10). После определённой планки и эквипа идёт тотальный геноцид всего и вся. Система силы противников очень не продумана. 2. Ужасная прокачка. Статы как таковые ничего не дают ( т.е. прокачиваю, к примеру, силу и сила атаки не прибавляется... совсем). Прокачка статов нужна только для открытия перков и эквипа. 3. Деревянное управление. Да и вообще их движок всегда был не самым лучшим... ничего не поменялось. 4. Графика. Для проекта такого уровня приемлема, но для 2017-го года уже не торт. 5. Кат-сцены... лучше бы их вообще не было. В большинстве из них персонажи просто стоят и безэмоционально что-то обсуждают. 
Как итог: игра на один раз и не более, но поиграть стоит!

Мы начинаем новую игру, нам на выбор дается 4 уровня сложности. А в чем разница? В силе противников? В радиусе обзора персонажей? Ну ладно, не все игры дают сравнительное описание уровней сложности, переживем, но все равно неприятно. 

Выбрали, ткнули, погнали. 

К графике вопросов нет. "Бесшовный" мир - это здорово, наверное. Хотя мне, как игроку, пофигу. Но, полагаю, что среди разработчиков это считается особым успехом. Так что порадуемся за них. В TES мир со "швами" и как-то не парит и даже незаметно.

Внезапно вступаем в бой и понимаем, что мы есть груша для битья. Если уже успели найти что-то дальнобойное, то выясняется, что стрелы едва царапают противника пострашнее крысы, палкой-нагибалкой можно добить разве что умирающего. При этом игрока, по закону жанра, шатают с двух-трех ударов. Это нормально: сперва страдать самому, потом - заставлять страдать других. Вот только от уровня к уровню страданий меньше не становится. Да, если заморочиться, можно разобраться с боевой системой, постфактум она оказалась не такой трудной. Правда, удобной и комфортной ее назвать тоже не получится. 
Ладно, проблема будет проблемой, пока ее не решить. Нашли спутника и он начал за нас шатать противников. Но он тоже не супермен, зато бессмертный. В итоге бои растягиваются на 1-10 минут, во время которых задача игрока перелетать с камня на крышу, с крыши на навес, с навеса скалу и тд, пока спутник царапает противника, умирает, отлеживается, поднимается, снова царапает противника, снова умирает.... и это до тех пор, пока либо он не убьет противника, либо не забагается и не поднимется. При этом вероятность этих событий - 50/50. 10 минут мы попрыгали по скалам и спутник забагался. Загрузить, помолиться, повторить.

Хардкор - это интересно. Интересно до определенной черты. Здесь эту черту перешли. Возможно, я просто криворукий и не смог в эту боевую систему, но все положительные эмоции от игры, вызванные окружающим миром, атмосферой событий, даже поисками шифра к кодовым замкам начисто перебивались отвращением от представленной боевой системы. 

Да, еще стелс режим. В серии TES он доведен до абсурдности своей имбалансностью. В ELEX он доведен до абсурдности своей бесполезностью. Даже мне, человеку, не являющемуся ни спецагентом, ни разведчиком, ни охотником хватит мозгов хотя бы пригнуться чтобы меня было трудней заметить. 

Все то, что мне нравилось в Готике 2, 3 - вышло на новый уровень. Это офигенно.
Все то, что мне не нравилось в предыдущих играх серии - также вышло на новый уровень или, вернее, опустилось и это очень печально.

Это не игра для того, чтобы расслабиться после работы. Она требует полного погружения и раскрывается только так (играл, будучи на больничном). 

2\5. Очень жаль потраченных денег и времени. Возможно, когда-нибудь попробую на легком уровне, попробую насладиться видами, сюжетом, не матерясь... Хотя я даже не помню, когда в последний раз и в какую игру играл не на самом высоком уровне сложности. Во всяком случае, что касается РПГ.
