I like this game, it reminds me of fallout 1 and 2, or baulders gate. The early PC RPGs that were very difficult, and can really punish you for making bad, or no choices. Its a bit of a culture shock coming from games like fallout 3-4 or the elder scrolls. It's more in line with the roguelikes that are becoming more popular. (It's not a roguelike, you can save and try again, I'm just talking about the combat difficulty). Often it's better to run past enemies, grab the item you need for the quest, and jetpack away like peter pan. Most of the early game XP comes from quests, and not from fighting. This continues into midgame. Toward the end you can fight a lot more.

The controls could use some love, sometimes you push buttons, and nothing happens, plain as that. Its pretty important that your jetpack go off, or your dodge roll go through at the right time when stronger enemies can kill you in a hit or two. I guess you can always load and try again, but dying toward the end of a difficult fight because your control imput isn't what happened in game can be frustrating. Sounds like a typical salty gamer excuse, but it actually happens here.  

The game looks good, It doesn't take place on earth, so I would have liked a more alien environment, but overall its a nice looking, expansive map and is fun to explore. The story is unique and interesting, and most of the characters are good. You have to talk to pretty much everyone to find your quests, and unique story elements. It helps that the voice acting is good, and the story lines are interesting. If you like a rich story and a lot of interaction its great. 

 On the opposite end is our protagonist. I would really have liked a character creator, especially when the developer goes with the bald white dude main character, its been done, it's really forgetable and nobodys going to rock it better than Kratos. This is probably my biggest gripe with the game, I always prefer to make my own character in an RPG especially when the one forced on you is kind of cliche.

Overall the game is solid, and I think that the right crowd will love it. If you love RPG's, and particularly if you played them in the early 90s this game will take you back.  Its a good blend of the old and the new. The wrong crowd, people who play games where you kill dozens of enemies effortlessly, will probably complain about how weak you are in the beginning of the game, and it does take some time to get stronger. 

I would recommend this game, Its not the same stale fantasy stuff most RPGs go with. Swords, wizards, Elves, Dwarves, and Hobbits are getting really boring, and the little tweaks they give them to make them "unique" in all the different games gets hard to follow after a thousand re-hashings. I would love to see more unique stuff like this. It seems like the creators had a vision and really got to run with it.

Let me start by saying that I’ve read so many negative reviews about this game that initially it pushed me away from this title. Not the best graphic, clunky fighting physics, dull voice acting etc. Everything was telling me “do not buy” … until the game dropped price by 50%. I was telling myself, that probably I’ll ask for a refund in about an hour or two.

After 8hrs of gameplay.
With a refund on my mind I have downloaded the game and played for about 2 hours. This is when I realised how similar and different this title is from my beloved Gothic and Gothic2. Immediately you can spot the similarities. Three camps, and each one with its speciality.
The things I was afraid of were not as bad as described. The graphic is not the best but it’s still quite nice. The fighting that was suppose to be clunky, well it’s not. This is probably coming from ppl playing those *new age games. Games with auto targeting etc. There is nothing wrong with fighting, it reminded me, once again about Gothic series. At the beginning you need to run away and avoid enemies. Sometimes you take a risk to get more exp, but this is why there is a quick save button. What about voice acting? Well indeed it’s not five stars but all lines are nicely covered. Doesn’t sound like AAA title, but it’s far away from a cheap Si-Fi acting. In general very, very playable and enjoyable.
When I finished my 8th hour of gameplay I said to myself, why I didn’t purchase it earlier. It’s so far the best gaming surprise of 2018.
PS: Guess what guys… no need for DLC, no microtransactions… you are actually purchasing a full game!!!
PS: last note on the difficulty level. The game isn’t as difficult as ppl are portraying it. Simply remember that some mobs are randomly placed and you are not meant to fight them at that time. Running away is fine.
ENJOY!

This game is the definition of a hidden gem.  It's a bit unpolished, and it's not for everyone, but it's absolutely amazing nonetheless.

The Positive:
[list]
[*] Beautiful visuals
[*] Amazingly well-crafted open-world that's filled to the brim with things to find and do
[*] I actually enjoyed the combat.  Mind you, I know it's no Dark Souls, but I liked it.
[*] The game pulls no punches.  If you can't go to an area yet, you'll find out when the area's residents one-shot you.  Again, I know that this is one of those things that some people don't like, but for me this made the game world feel alive and made me eager to keep playing and get strong enough to explore those areas.
[*] The main story is, in my opinion, fantastic.
[*] The sidequests are amazingly well-crafted.  Most of the sidequests had me seriously considering a difficult choice, and more often than not I find myself choosing between profit and helping others.
[*] The factions are well-designed
[/list]

The Neutral:
[list]
[*] The difficulty curve was handled decently well.  I thought that it levelled off too much at the end: at a certain point you just find that you can kill any enemy in the game without too much trouble.
[*] I liked the Cold system (by which you become more or less "cold" depending on the choices you make), but I thought it could've been executed a bit better.  Certain plot points are determined by your cold, and I thought that some of them didn't make much sense.
[*] Hacking and lockpicking were nothing special
[/list]

The Negative:
[list]
[*] The game definitely lacks polish.  There are some minor bugs, though I've yet to find anything major.
[*] I didn't really feel much incentive to use the "legendary weapons" scattered throughout the world.  By the time I met the stat requirements to use them there were better options.
[*] I would've liked an option to play through without choosing a faction.
[*] I didn't find that there was much incentive to do chemistry (this game's version of alchemy) or gemstone socketing (the weapon perks system).
[*] I would've liked a bit more armor variety, or at least more options with respect to armor.
[/list]

[h1]Summary[/h1]
I was really disappointed.  I discovered Elex a few years back when it was barely ready for alpha testing, and I loved the concept.  Unfortunately, the game that followed the concept was mediocre.

It's not that any one thing was really terrible or infuriating.  It's simply that everything felt 

uninspired, uninventive, and ultimately forgettable.  In the end that is why I just couldn't give this game a good review.  Nothing about it was memorable.

[h1]UPDATED July 8th[/h1]

I finally began to make a little progress with ELEX today.  After learning a bit more about the game I've come to forgive some of the negative aspects and embrace more of the positive ones.

If you are a person that ultimately loves freedom of choice in an RPG, ELEX may just be for you.

This game hurt me like no game has before. There are some cool elements to it, but not enough to have the game called good. Here are my Pros and Cons of the game.

    Pros- The setting of the game was very unique. The concept they based it around is a meteor that fell and created a new resource called Elex. There are a few factions all with their own ambitions that use Elex in different ways. The amount of world to traverse paired with the amount of side quests means you will play this for a very long time.

   Cons- Melee combat is not synced with button press. The game is extremely hard, being that a mutant chicken can kill you in three hits no matter of you grind until level 30. Ranged combat is very uninspired, and sneak combat does not exist. The ai in fights means if one enemy gets alerted, they all do. If you so happen to hit an enemy against a mountain, they may clip through it making them unable to hit until they come out. If you get swarmed by a group of enemies, you will be stun locked and killed. Enemy hit boxes are weird in that, something that should miss you due to elevation still hits you. 
    Factions are a lot of grinding at quests for rewards that don't help your ability to fight in a meaningful way. Certain abilities are locked behind certain factions, but said abilities are not strong enough to make a difference. In terms of faction selection, if you don't select berserkers you have a very long trek of avoiding every enemy before you find another faction.
    Cinematics are very uninspired and bland. I felt no immersion into the cut scenes of the game, and did not become interested in any character in the game. Your main character makes sense why he is so cold and emotionless, but the rest of the characters feel lifeless as well.

    I had a lot of issues with this game. In brief review, combat in entirety is not good. The game is a grind fest with little to know difficult alleviation from progressing. Factions dont make a huge difference. Cinematics are boring, and characters are lifeless.

    Apologies for the previous state of this review. I hope my editing of the core of my disdain for this game is much easier to read. Thank you for the valuable input on how badly I structured my former review. TLDR this game is baaaaaaaaaaad.

I just started playing this game and I can already tell that most of negative reviews are meh. It’s not boring and battle system isn’t that bad. It just feels old. Elex is not a mainstream rpg (like Skyrim) that general population loves. I'm not saying that Skyrim is bad, just that it's "casual" compared to most of old rpgs that were released through the history. Hell, even compared to it’s own grandparent Morrowind.

Elex was developed by the same team that made Gothic series and it clearly has all the pros and cons of that same development team. If this game was released 10 years ago it would be a best seller, but today it looks a bit dated. Not visually I am speaking about technical aspects. Video games came far in polishing themselves in pursue of getting better and better. While Elex is just made by the same team who is sort of at it's prime already. Meaning that when Piranha Bytes made Gothic 3 they gave it their all and it would be hard for them to top their own success and personal limitations of sorts. Maybe if they had a bigger staff or more money they would polish it more, but alas it is as it is.

It is not a bad game, it's just not friendly for a general population. It doensn't hold your hand and gives what it seems a freedom of choice. I am yet to see if my choices would really matter in general, but so far I am really enjoying a thought process. Even chosing one of three factions was a tough descision.

In other words this game is oldschool in every way I can imagine (escept graphics).

Ehrlich gesagt, ich bin ein Gothic-Spieler des ersten Tages. Heißt ich spiele Piranha-Bytes Spiele seit Anfang an in der Minenkolonie. Und ja, ich empfinde es ebenso als wichtig dass man weder bei Spielstart, noch am Spielende "Superheldenallüren" bekommt bei einem Piranha-Bytes-Spiel.
Ja, ich liebe diese "Auf's-Maul-Attitüde", ich liebe es knackig im Gameplay.
Und als ich mich di erstne Stunden in Elex aufhielt fühlte ich mich sofort "zu Hause".

ABER ich bin spätestens seit Gothic 3 kein "Fanboy" mehr.
Heißt, seit diesem Debakel, in welchem mir PB deutlich zeigte, dass es nicht allzu viel von Fan-Support hält, es musste ja schließlich erst mal die Community fixen, was sie selbst nicht hinbekamen, habe ich die rosarote Fanboybrille abgelegt. Ich mag, die Spiele noch immer, aber ich sehe auch deren Schwächen und benenne sie deutlich.

Und gerade bei Elex ist das Kampfsystem unintuitiv, uninspririert und undurchsichtlich, gerade für Einsteiger.
Ich habe z.B. keine Probleme damit in Elex humanoide Gegner nieder zu ringen, unintuitives Kampfsystem zum trotz.
Tiere allerdings sind eine ganz andere Angelegenheit, deren Attacken sind viel zu unvorhersehbar, zu ruckartig, als das man dort mehr tun könnte als nach dem Prinzip "Try&Error" jeden einzelnen Gegner immer wieder anzugehen. Heißt gegen Tiere und andere Monster ist das Kampfsystem von Elex ein echtes Glückspiel. Und es ist ein großer Unterschied ob man einen Kampf durch erhöhten "Skill" gewinnen muss, oder ob die gute Portion "Glück" zum Sieg fehlt.

Und das passt, ehrlich gesagt nicht mehr in die Zeit.
Man muss ein Kampfsystem heutzutage intuitiv erlernen können, ohne Guides im Internet anzusehen, und wenn das System nicht intutitv ist, dann muss man es zumindest in einem Tutorial abhandeln. Beides verpennt Piranha Bytes in diesem Game eindeutig.

Drum mein Fazit:
Gothic und PB-Fanboys und Gilrs kommt her und zockt, ich werdet über die SChwächen des Games hinwegsehen können.
Alle anderen, lasst die Finger davon, oder aber wartet auf einen Sale in dem das Game dann so um die 20 Teuronen gut genug bezahlt ist.

玩了20个小时。《ELEX》确实有亮点，可惜瑜不掩瑕。
操作延迟、动作僵硬把战斗体验彻底毁了。后来被顶着骷髅头标志的任务怪素质三连打死多次（简单难度），用喷气背包飞到怪物上不来的高处，掏出远程武器射了100多下把它射死。原来只有把《ELEX》的战斗理解成是强调站位的“TPS”，而不是躲+砍的“动作”才能玩下去。
但是杀个怪在简单难度下都要射100多次未免太磨蹭了。《ELEX》的各项属性（力量、敏捷、体质、狡诈、智慧）对人物强度没有直接影响，只是作为学习技能和穿戴装备的限制条件，技能和装备才能提升人物强度。但是装备越好、技能等级越高，属性要求也就越高，每次升级只能获得10点属性点，属性升级所需的属性点数也会逐步提高，从1点、2点开始，后期要5点。怪物与玩家的力量对比不平衡，人物成长又极其缓慢。号称高自由度的《ELEX》的所存在的这些缺点严重影响了玩家任务完成顺序的选择自由和开放世界的探索自由。
唯一吸引我玩下去的只有它塑造的中世纪剑与魔法、末世废土、未来科幻混搭的世界观。后来打得失去耐心，下个修改器把所有属性改成90，带上高级武器，游戏体验果然好多了。
所以没买游戏的建议就别买了，买了的下个修改器改了再玩。不合理的、影响体验的游戏规则没必要遵守。

I can't do it. I paid a AAA price for this game and so I played it with those expectations in mind.

The voice acting could definitely be done better by a plank. The controls (all of them) are very annoying, simply because when moving around it is rigid. If you have to wonder in an open world, turning around should not feel like dentistry. I could not try and explore an open world for hundreds of hours with a drill in my mouth, I just know it.

The fighting is okay, but with the bad controls, makes it painful too.

When entering an indoors environment from outdoors the interior remains dark while your eyes "adjust", this is fine if it happens fairly quickly, but in this game it takes long. This can also become mind numbingly irritating when in an open world and having to go in and out of buildings. Like in the berzerker town trying to find your way. I ended up walking into people and furniture. If I could feel my shins, they would be broken and I would be screaming.

The plus side is the environment is lush, the parts I did see were very atmospheric and detailed. It feels like there is a lot to explore in this place and that was the one thing that made me try carry on for a bit longer. The main problem is what is populating the world.

Which reminds me, you have no character choice here. You play a dude with scars, a shaved head and yes, a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ wooden bot voice. I think a RPG should generally have more choice than that. Disclaimer: I am a dude with scars and a shaved head (mostly bald, but a shaved head for this reason), so I have no prejudice against that. I just think the nature of RPG's is to have character customization as part of the experience.

I definitely do not recommend this game, maybe at a 75% discount it is worth trying for yourself, but handing out $50 for this is absolutely not worth it.

This is a though one. The first impression is pretty bad. A wonky cut scene, some very emotionless voice acting (which is actually intentional as you might find out in the story later on) and a fighting system that’s pretty weird (kind of reminds me of The Witcher 1). After you make it to the first town the game begins to shine. An open world which is actually open and not partioned into zones to work through. Characters which are either likeable or detestable  (in a good way). Characterprogression that will have you running from monsters for the first ~10h because you're actually weak but feels incredibly satisfying when you’re finally able to beat something. Factions which matter. A story that starts with a weak plot and gets surprisingly deep. This game isn’t easy to get into. It certainly does not feel like a modern Rpg, if I had to make a comparison aside from PB’s other games I’d say Morrowind.  If you search something that follows the Skyrim-formula of Rpg this probably won’t be the game you're searching for. If however you search for that Morrowind-Feeling you might find an unpolished diamond.

Özet geç kısmına direkt giriyorum. Aksiyon kısmı vasat ve yer yer vasat altı ama rol yapma dinamikleri gayet taş gibi olan bir oyunla karşı karşıyasınız. Evet, bir Aksiyon - RPG oyununun aksiyon kısmının tökezlemesi absürd dursa da oyun bir şekilde akıp gidiyor. Klasik Piranha Bytes kafası yani. 

Hatta şöyle yapayım, oyundan zevk almak istiyorsanız önceden ne tür bir silah kullancağınızı belirleyin. Ben Cleric'lere katıldım ve plazma/lazer silahlarıyla savaştım. Silahları crafting yoluyla geliştirebiliyorsunuz. Silahları bir level üst seviyeye getirene kadar oyun kan kusturdu. O yüzden eğer oynayacaksanız tavsiyem, silahları geliştirme konusuna odaklanın ki erkenden açılsın oyun. Sonrası gelir.

Piranha Bytes'ın yaptığı tüm oyunları oynadım. Gothic ve Risen serisi, kendine has bir hayrat kitlesi yaratmış durumda. Hatta Gothic 2 bildiğiniz efsane bir oyundur ve maalesef yapımcılar hala onun üzerine çıkabilmiş değiller. Elex ise firmanın yeni IP'si ve aslına bakarsanız baya da ilgi çekici bir evreni var. Potansiyelinin ne kadarını kullandığı ise baya tartışılır.

Magallan diye bir dünyaya gidiyoruz. Bizimkine benzer bir teknolojiye sahipler ancak bir kuyruklı yıldızın çarpması sonucu bildiğimiz medeniyet çöküyor ve post apokaliptik bir ortam oluşuyor; 3 ana grup ortaya çıkıyor: Berserker, Cleric ve Outlaw. Berserker, ilkel bir yaşam süren ve teknolojiyi tamamen reddeden bir inanışa sahip. Cleric, teknolojiyi dibine kadar kullanan, lazer silahları, mech vs. kullanan ve kendi inanç sistemine sahip bir grup. Outlaw ise adından anlaşılacağı üzere kanun kaçaklarının oluşturduğu ve Mad Max tadında takılan elemanlar. Bir de ek olarak Alb denilen ve kuyruklu yıldızdan çıkan Elex adındaki maddeyi tüketerek fantastik güçler kazanan bir başka fraksiyon bunlara ekleniyor. Alb'ler bir süre sonra dellenip ne kadar elex maddesi varsa el koyma maksadıyla hepsinin alayına gitmeye başlıyor, ortam karışıyor. 

Biz bir Alb komutanı olarak oyuna başlıyoruz. Jetimiz vuruluyor ve düşüyoruz. O sırada kaza yerinde bizi bekleyen bir diğer Alb grubu gelip bizi vuruyor ve ihanetten kaynaklı intikam duygularıyla kontrolü ele alıyoruz. Bir süre baygın yattığımızdan dolayı vücuttaki tüm elex eriyip gidiyor; bir de yetmezmiş gibi Outlaw'ın biri gelip zırhımızı vs. çalıyor. Güçsüz, silahsız, zırhsız kalıyoruz. Hikayede bilinmeyen çok, yeni bir evren, taze bir karakter. Her şey güzel. Buralar zaten alıştırma bölümleri. Hemen oyunun başında da jetpack sahibi oluyoruz.

Alıştırma bölümünde her şeyden bolca var. Daha önceki PB oyunlarından bildiğim için acaba yakın dövüş nasıl olur diye tutorial'deki düşmanlara hevesle daldım ve şaşırmadım. Yakın dövüş yine kalas. Adamlar yıllar önce çıkardıkları Gothic 2 kadar bile başarılı olamadılar bu konuda. Aslında ona en çok yaklaşan Risen 1 var. Risen 2 ve 3'ü, tıpkı Elex gibi menzilli silahlarla bitirdim çünkü Elex'in de yakın dövüş mekanikleri onlarla aynı. 

Yakın dövüşte yapabildiğiniz hareketler pek efektif değil. Tamam dodge vs. var ancak hem animasyonlardan hem de tasarım fikrinden ötürü resmen sıkıcı. Çok atik bir karakterimiz yok ve genelde kalabalık gelen düşmanlarla kapışmak baya zor oluyor. Vuruş hissinin eksikliğini de katarsak, "Yaa ben direkt menzilliye geçeyim" diyorsunuz. Dediğiniz an oyunun en sağlam falsoları yüzünüze vurmaya başlıyor. Risen 2 ve 3'te bu bahsedeceğim durum var mıydı? Hatırlamıyorum ama olsa hatırlarım. Nişan alıp ateş etmek için düşmandan uzaklaşmaya çalıştığınız an şaşırtıcı biçimde size menzilli saldırı yaptığını görüyorsunuz. Yapımcılar da yakın dövüşün tırtlığının farkında bu yüzden alakalı alakasız her düşmana menzilli saldırı eklemişler. Mutasyon geçirmiş eciş bücüş böcek bile sanırsınız ki ejderha, siz jetpack ile kaçmaya çalıştığınız an indiriyor sizi. Bir de müthiş bir isabet oranına sahip her tür düşman. Hani 3-4 farklı tipte yaratık olsa ve ateş püskürtseler eyvallah diyeceğim. Hepsi mi yapar? Hatta öyle ki, hapisten adam kaçırdığınız bir görev var. Adama zırhı, silahı falan biz veriyoruz ve beraber kaçıyoruz. Yani adamın üzerinde tüfek olma şansı yok çünkü yol boyunca tedarik edebileceği bir yer yok. Neyse bu adamla anlaşmazlığa düşüyoruz kaçtıktan sonra (seçiminize göre). Ancak cin yapımcılarımız burada da hünerlerini konuşturuyorlar ve o adama bir adet tüfeği yoktan var ediyorlar. Çünkü maazallah siz adama lazer falan sıkarsınız, 2 saniyede öldürürsünüz o yüzden böyle bir mantık hatasıyla zorluğun dengelenmesi (!) lazım.

Maalesef böyle mantık hataları oyunda çok. PB oyunlarında genelde açık dünyaya salınırsınız ancak zorluk bölgeye göre artmaz. Hemen oyunun 5. dakikasında hayvani bir düşmanla karşılaşma imkanınız vardır. Ancak bu sefer gaza gelip en zottirik düşmanlara bile ölümüne can ve saldırı gücü vermişler. En başta da yazdığım gibi oyunda mesafe katedebilmek için elinizdeki silahları tez elden güçlendirmeniz şart. Loot falan düşer diye umutlanmayın çünkü bazukayla size saldıran birini öldürseniz bile düşürdüğü silahı alamıyorsunuz. 40 yılda bir loot gelirse de dandik oluyor. Legendary Item falan peşine de düşmeyin, silahları en üst seviyeye çıkarırsanız alın size neredeyse Legendary gücünde ekipman. Yani olay tamamen sizin silahlarınızı güçlendirmenize bakıyor. Oyunun zorluğu bu anlamda saçmalıyor işte. En başlarda aşırı zorlanırken, hiçbir geçiş dönemi yaşamadan herkese tek atmaya başlıyorsunuz. Bu sefer de korka korka gittiğiniz düşmanlara "pıff" diyerek iki sıkıp yolunuza bakıyorsunuz (zorluk derecesi Difficult).

Gelelim iyi kısımlara. Bir kere rol yapma mekanikleri gayet iyi. Ne istiyorsanız o oluyorsunuz. Dümdüz bir ana karakterimiz var bu arada, sıkıcı aksiyon filmi adamı gibi. Hani öyle çok bağlanmayacaksınız kendisine ama bu normal. Eski bir Alb sonuçta, duyguları yok(tu). Ben mesela itlik, uğursuzluk, ceset soyma, hırsızlık, ortalık karıştırma gibi türlü sevimlilikleri yaptım. Ancak isterseniz parlak zırhlı şovalye de olabiliyorsunuz. Ufak tefek seçimlerin bile etkisi var. Bu seçimlerin sonuçlarını da net görüyorsunuz. Risen serisi kadar olmasa da ilgi çekici NPC'ler de var oyunda. Dümenin sizde olduğu hissiyatını veriyor oyun. Üç farklı grup arasındaki ilişkilerde kilit rol oynuyorsunuz. Bir tarafı seçip katıldığınız zaman diğer grupların tutumlarındaki değişimleri görüyorsunuz. 

Level başına 10 Attribute Point kazanıyorsunuz, 1 adet ise Skill (Yetenek) Point. Bunları Strenght, Dexterity gibi klasik rol yapma niteliklerine göre dağıtıyorsunuz. Dağıtırken iyi düşünün ve hangi yetenek veya silahı kullanacaksanız onun gereksinimlerine uygun davranın. Atıyorum Dexterity isteyen silahlar kullanıyorsanız onu arttırmaya bakın. Çünkü respec yani level sıfırlayarak puanlarınızı yeniden dağıtma şansınız yok.

Yetenek ağacınız farklı dallara ayrılmış durumda. Sosyal becerilerden tutun, hayatta kalma ve savaş yeteneklerine kadar çeşitlilik bol. Ha savaş yeteneği derken aldığınız/verdiğiniz hasarda iyileştirmeyi kapsıyor bu. Zaten dövüş sistemi tırt demiştik, bir şey beklemeyin yani. Ancak özellikle hayatta kalma yetenekleri ve sosyal beceriler çok çok önemli. Öldürdüğünüz yaratıklardan nadir bulunan materyalleri toplamaya yarayan ve pazarlık becerinizi arttıran yeteneklere yönelin derim çünkü baya para harcayacaksınız. Üst seviye zırhlar çok pahalı. Natural Elex denilen ve ender bulunan maddeyi (belli başlı satıcılarda bulabilirsiniz, Origin denilen yerde sınırsız satılıyor) düşmanlarınızdan toplayabilirsiniz eğer o yeteneğe sahipseniz. Natural Elex ile hazırladığınız iksir, size yetenek/nitelik puanı ya da tecrübe kazandırıyor. Çok çok ihtiyaç duyuyorsunuz yani. Aşırı tüketirseniz "cold" seviyeniz artıyor, Alb gibi. Oyunun sonuna bu Cold seviyesinin etkisi var ayrıca.

Oyun teknik anlamda çok başarılı. Eski bir motora sahip kabul ama çok temiz grafikleri, harika bir optimizasyonla sunuyor.

Objektif olmam gerekirse 70/100'lük bir yapım, Metacritic puanı hakkaniyetli. Sıkılmadan oynadım, siz türe çok meraklı değilseniz indirimi bekleyin derim :) Aksiyonuyla değil, içeriğiyle parlıyor.

Elex fait partie de ces jeux que vous commencez sans trop savoir à quoi s'attendre et qui vous mettent une grosse claque. Ami fan de RPG en mondes ouverts tu ne peux pas passer à côté d'Elex ! Si tu as kiffé (comme moi) la série Gothic, ou Risen, encore moins  ! Elex est un EXCELLENT RPG dont j'ai savouré à la fois les qualités graphiques, le gameplay dynamique, le côté old school de l'interface et du systême de compétences car Elex n'est pas un jeu facile, il va vous falloir pas mal d'énergie pour vous en sortir, surtout au début ou le moindre monstre vous dégomme en deux coups (cf les loups de Gothic). Mais ce qui es tle plus beau dans Elex, c'est son histoire et la richesse de ses factions ! Car Elex va vous demander de choisir un camp et ça ne sera pas facile  ! Finalement c'est aussi un jeu assez psychologique dans lequel on tente de se forger son opinion sur ce monde meurtri. Le scénario est réussi et les personnages attachants. Pour moi c'est une réussite de bout en bout mise à part les quelques cinématiques narratives qui frisent à chaque fois le ridicule. (mention spécilae à la cinématique d'ouverture qui peut, à elle seule, vous donner envie de désinstaller le soft !). Alors Elex est un vrai mystère, comment se fait il qu'un jeu aussi chouette soit si peu connu ? Sincérement, je l'ai trouvé bien plus abouti que Risen et vraiment jouissif avec son gameplay totalement vertical grace au jetpack ! Bref, toi qui a envie de te lancer dans une belle aventure, n'hésites pas une seconde !

[i]Elex[/i] is a third-person action role-playing game (ARPG) by Piranha Bytes. The games by this German studio are so unique in terms of atmosphere and playstyle, they might as well be their own subgenre within ARPGs. That's why I'll refer to the collective works of Piranha Bytes as 'PB games' in this review.

[i]Elex[/i] is definitely the best PB game since Risen, and maybe even since Gothic 2. Elex has a true open world with exciting and dangerous places to discover, it has three joinable factions, each having a distinct philosophy and memorable NPCs with personality, it offers choices that matter in the long run, and it has noticeable character progression. 

But [i]Elex[/i] does have its flaws, as well. The melee combat can feel clunky (yes, again!) and the attribute system is nothing but a platform for skill and weapon requirements. 

If you're into PB games, you'll like or even love [i]Elex[/i]. If you're into ARPGs but aren't sure about PB games, first you need to answer two questions. 1. Do you expect games to be perfectly polished? 2. Do you expect to be a god who can kill anything in his way from the very beginning of an ARPG? If you answered 'yes' to either question, [i]Elex[/i] is not for you. If you think you can accept some flaws and a difficulty curve, provided the other aspects of ARPGs are present and excitingly so, you may want to give [i]Elex[/i] a chance. 


[h1]The story[/h1]

When a meteor struck the planet Magalan, its inhabitants were almost wiped out. Their society, which very much resembled Earth's circa 1995, ceased to exist. The meteor brought a strange new mineral to the planet, which the people of Magalan call Elex, that spread all over the planet. 

The survivors formed four factions, each with their own view on the new world and on how Elex should be used. I'd love to tell you a little something about each of the factions, but the character limit doesn't allow it, so I'll put these thoughts in the 'Comments' section below.

You play Jax, an Alb commander. While on a mission, his jet crashes. Immediately after the crash, some fellow Albs show up to execute Jax, which is the normal punishment for failing a mission. But how could they have shown up so soon at the crash site? And why was his mission deemed failed when it had hardly started? Having survived the attempt to execute him, those are questions Jax would really like an answer to. 


[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

Gameplay is typical third-person ARPG with three types of combat: melee, ranged and magic.

For some reason, melee combat is always the worst part of PB games. In Gothic, Gothic 2 and Risen, melee combat was okay, but in their other games it plain sucked. In Elex, the melee combat system is good in its design but bad in its execution.

You can perform light attacks and heavy attacks. You can parry, you can dodge roll and, if you equip a shield, you can block. If you manage to perform a succesfully timed chain of light attacks, you can perform a special attack.

All this sounds great but it isn't because controls are clunky. Sometimes, input doesn't get registered properly. This may break your chain of attacks. It may also mean Jax keeps hitting nothing but the air in front of him, even though you used the mouse and keyboard to tell Jax he should turn around and strike the next opponent who's behind him instead. There is also a bug that prevents you from hitting any opponent if they are on slightly higher or lower ground than you are. All these things often cause melee combat to be a frustrating experience.

Like in most PB games, ranged combat is a lot more enjoyable. But in [i]Elex[/i], there is a catch: if you have at your opponents with ranged attacks, they switch to ranged attacks, too, which means they deal a lot more damage than they would in melee combat. So ranged combat may be more enjoyable but it makes the game a lot harder, especially in the first half of the game.

There is a wide range of ranged weapons in [i]Elex[/i]. Bows and crossbows, as seen in the Gothic series. Guns, as seen in the last two Risen games. And you'll also be able to use flamethrowers, harpoon guns, laser rifles, and so on.

Magic is back after being absent in Risen 2 and only present pro forma in Risen 3. But the spells still aren't good enough to play a magic-only character. Also, you get the same additional difficulty you get with other ranged attacks, the fact that opponents switch to their ranged attack, too, meaning you'll take a lot more damage.

There is classic character development in [i]Elex[/i]. You gain XP by questing and killing opponents. When you level up, you can increase abilities and skills. The strange thing in [i]Elex[/i] is that abilities don't really *do* anything. You need to increase your abilities to learn skills and to equip better weapons, but the ability increase itself does not make you stronger. 

The factions are satisfyingly different and they each offer strong and weak points. At last, choosing a faction is as enjoyable as it was in the first Gothic games again. This also adds to replayability, of course.

[i]Elex[/i] has some unique characteristics. For one, the world of Magalan is truly open and I haven't had this much fun exploring a world created by PB since Gothic 2. The 'ruins from the Old World' you come across are brick buildings, concrete roads, car wrecks, etc. It's as if you're exploring the Planet of the Apes: a strange, new world built on top of a ruined Earth.

Another nice feature is the jetpack that Jax finds at the beginning of the game, allowing him to fly up into the air for a few seconds at a time. This almost literally adds another dimension to the game world, as you can now explore the roofs of buildings and towers and such, and often get rewarded for it.

PB games never start out easy. [i]Elex[/i] is no exception. During the first dozen hours or so, you can defeat almost no opponents. You need to pick your fights carefully and run around tough opponents. You need to find quests that don't require defeating strong opponents and you need to think out of the box. If you're asked to find an item that's guarded by a strong monster, you try to run around the monster, grab the item and run back to the quest giver. Or you wait until midnight, when the monster sleeps, and sneak around him to grab the item. Or you lure the monster to some strong NPCs who will kill it for you, so you can go get the item it was guarding. For me, this part of PB games is as enjoyable as the second part of their games, when you're strong enough to kill almost anything and can get pretty much everywhere with brute force instead of your wits. 


[h1]Graphics and sound[/h1]

The graphics of [i]Elex[/i] aren't triple-A quality. To hide this a bit, PB decided to cover the world in a permanent fog. I think this was a bad choice. I even made a guide that explains how to remove the fog. And although the graphics still don't look perfect, I think the world of Elex is a lot nicer than its creators gave themselves credit for. 

The music is atmospheric but not memorable. Except maybe for the score I heard while travelling through the Berserker's town, which is very reminiscent of the Gothic games' score.

The quality of the sound effects is okay. The only thing I noticed is that after loading a game, the first few sound effects may be late by a few seconds.

The voice acting is decent to good. The fact it's not great seems to stem from the fact the lines are translated from German into English, making them sound not 100% fully natural to begin with.


[h1]On Steam's extra features[/h1]

[i]Elex[/i] has 7 Steam Trading Cards. You'll get 4 while running the game.

The 50 Steam Achievements are extremely varied. There are some story-related achievements, some faction-related achievements, some achievements that require you to collect a series of items scattered across the game world, some achievements that require you to upgrade weapons, kill opponents, etc.

I would recommend this if you like freedom of choice (the biggest thing you cannot choose is to not join a faction, if you do not join you will not be able to progress story), decisions that matter, challenging games (though you can avoid combat quite often and still get enough xp's). Also i found combat quite enjoyable (until i or enemy get stuck in terrain that is), it makes no sense to me that i could not use weapons until i had enough skill points in needed categories but no big deal.
There was really hardly any bugs to be found. Exploring is the best part!

Elex is no doubt one of my favorite games. The game presents to us a gigantic, open world with stunning graphics. The storyline is also immersive with many possibilities. I agree that the game is not easy to start; however, I totally disagree that the combat system is terrible. In my opinion, Elex's combat system is not perfect but definitely enjoyable. There are so many different ways for one to engage in a combat: Berserker dashes into combat with powerful magic skills; Outlaw unleashes insane dps with their special drugs; Cleric utilizes their psi devices to launch black holes into packs of enemies. Not to mention that faction skills, guns, and bows have alternative attacking modes, ranging from explosive shot, piercing shot, . . . , to scattered shot. The diverse combat system is really another highlight of this game.

Be aware of some negative reviews complaining about poor combat system, quite a few of them had less than 4 hours into the game; they barely scratched the surface of this game.

Good potential with lackluster execution.

~Pros~
-Very interesting setting that really got me hooked into buying this game.
-Tons of factions to choose from instead of the lazy "good guys or bad guys who are still good"
-Jetpack at start to help travel the broken terrain.
-No long tutorial sequence you are forced to play through at the beginning.


~Cons~
Mini-map - The radar does not show any terrain or buildings which would be fine if the cities were not built like mazes. Even games like morrowind from 16 years ago had working mini-maps. This leads to constantly exiting out to place markers on your map.

Voice Acting - I don't really care much about voice acting in games, I usually read subtitles in rpg's. But this voice acting is possibly the worst I have ever heard. Either the emotion conveyed is wrong for the dialogue or the lines are read in straight monotone. "Are you my relief? No? Shit....shit.......shit........shit on a stick." As if someone is reading a list of groceries.

Difficulty - "Bro, you just need to git gud." "You're just used to having your hand held, this is a REAL game." "Just don't fight stuff until level 15" When an RPG is more difficult than Dwarf Fortress you know you've ♥♥♥♥♥♥ up. I've made it to level 5 and the only enemy I was able to consistently kill were the large rats and birds that give you 10xp. Everything else will laugh as you put 40 arrows into it's face then flail around with an axe before it 1-shots you.

This is not like Kingdom Come where you are an 18 year old rookie learning the world. You are Jax, the greatest Alb commander to step foot on the battlefield (going off the dialogue from the faction leaders). But don't think that means you can take on anything stronger than a stray dog or that you remember how to use a gun.

Zuerst einmal: ELEX ist mein erstes Spiel von Piranha Bytes, hab nie Gothic oder Risen gespielt. Höchstens mal ein paar Lets Plays geguckt. Kann also was den "Vergleich" oder den "Nostalgiebonus" angeht nicht mitreden ;)

Wie auch immer...
Ja, ELEX ist anfangs sperrig, bockschwer, die Grafik reißt keine Bäume aus und auch die Kämpfe sind ziemlich fummelig...

...dennoch ist ELEX meiner Meinung nach ein Super Rollenspiel! Mein persönliches Highlight seit Fallout 4. (Ja, ich mag die Bethesda Games)
Warum?

Wie gesagt die Grafik ist keine High-End-Ich-sabber-den-Bildschirm-voll-Grafik, sie ist aber stimmig, das Weltendesign ist unheimlich gut und sie erfüllt ihren Zweck. Man ertappt sich immer wieder dabei dass man sich sagt "Okay, die Ruine und den Turm erkunde ich noch schnell, dann mach ich aus." 2 Stunden später zockst du immer noch weil du dauernd neues entdeckst ;)
Der Erkundungsdrang ist ENORM und so einen Drang hatte ich wie gesagt seit den Bethesda Spielen wie Fallout oder Skyrim nicht mehr. Top!

Das Spiel ist sperrig: Ja, ist es. Aber mMn nur Anfangs. Ich komme mittlerweile klar mit den Kämpfen, dem Jetpack, dem Ausdauer-Management und dem Menü. (Ins Menü fuchst man sich nach 2-3 Spielstunden rein und es geht super von der Hand mittlerweile)
Am Anfang bekommt man von den kleinsten Gegnern im Spiel ordentlich auf den Sack. Find ich gut, man merkt richtig wie man ein kleines Licht in der Spielwelt ist und man erst nach und nach stärker wird. Sei es durch Skills, die man sich nach einem Levelaufstieg freischaltet, sei es durch eine schöne gefundene Waffe oder sei es einfach nur durch den Fakt, dass man das Kampfsystem gecheckt hat ;) Achtet auf eure Ausdauer und benutzt viel den Jetpack im Kampf, dann bekommt ihr auch 3-4 Gegner auf einmal klein.

Das Questdesign kann Anfangs auch etwas verwirrend sein, (warum ist auf einmal Quest A abgebrochen obwohl ich Quest C mache? Warum redet Typ B nicht mehr mit mir? Etc.) aber ich finde das Questdesign ist unglaublich gut gelungen. Fast jede Quest kann man auf verschiedene Arten lösen, sei es von der Herangehensweise ansich oder dank verschiedener Optionen mit diversen Konsequenzen. Sehr schön! Viele Quests sind miteinander verzahnt und deshalb kann es verwirrend sein wenn man plötzlich eine Quest abgibt und dafür eine andere abgebrochen wird. LEst aufmerksam das Questlogbuch!

Es gibt 3 Fraktionen, denen man beitreten kann. (Insgesamt gibt es aber, ich würde sagen, 6 Fraktionen: Berserker, Kleriker, Outlaws; Albs, Separatisten, die "Verbannten" aus dem Lager der Mitte)
Jede der 3 Fraktionen ist nicht glattgebügelt Gut oder Böse, jede hat seine Vor- und Nachteile. Entscheidet weise welcher ihr beitretet, die ENtscheidung ist permanent! Ich bin erst nach ca. 39 Stunden einer Fraktion beigetreten, werde aber nicht sagen welcher, das muss wirklich jeder für sich entscheiden..

Ich habe jetzt 44 Stunden auf dem Buckel, habe endlich eine ordentliche Rüstung, ein gutes Schwert und die Vorteile meiner gewählten Fraktion. Endlich hau ich auch größere Gegner weg und fühle mich langsam wie ein Held ;)
Die Story nimmt Fahrt auf und ich bin schon gespannt wie es weitergeht.

Tipp: Bevor ihr euch einer Fraktion anschließt, legt euch einen zweiten Save an, um die anderen Fraktionen auch durchzuspielen. Ich werd das auf jeden Fall so machen.

Größere Bugs hatte ich bislang nicht, keine Plotstopper und einen Abturz innerhalb der ersten 2 Spielstunden, da hab ich aber wohl mit den Grafiksettings etwas übertrieben. 

Mehr will ich auch nicht mehr schreiben, guckt euch ein paar Lets Plays von ELEX an, guckt euch Tutorials zum Kampfsystem an und fuchst euch rein in das Spiel! Ihr werdet gewiss nicht an der Hand genommen.

Und ja, trotzdem wird ELEX nicht jedermanns Sache sein..
..ich hingegen liebe dieses Spiel, werde noch viel Spaß damit haben und kann Piranha Bytes nur loben. Anscheinend eine sympathische, deutsche Spieleschmiede. Meinen Support habt ihr euch sicher und ich hoffe jetzt schon auf ein ELEX II :)

This... this game... thank you PB for bringing back childhood memories.

Installed it today and I just took a break to drink/eat and noticed I've been playing it for the last 7 hours and that I haven't even finished chapter 1, or even left the first city... 

The graphics are great, combat is interesting, but the story... and the way EVERY decision affects your fate in the game, your interactions with other NPCs, is  insane... just the fact that if you chose the wrong replies, without any warnings, the NPCs can beat or even kill you as a reaction, is crazy.

Plus, the freedom that you have in the game, while exploring, is also well missed and appreciated. Finding hidden treasures, while aimlessly exploring even in the beginning of the game, is awesome.

Plus, the guys who wrote the script and the NPCs replies should get a raise or a bonus... I've never heard the following fraze:
"How the flying set of syphilitic raptor bags is one man supposed to guard this are alone?!" 

This, combined with other gimmicks, killed me during the gameplay, I just simply lost it...

No regrets into buying this marvel. Old feelings came back to life, like the ones from Gothic 1 and 2, during my time in this game.

And judging by the size of the map + stories possibilities, I reckon I'll invest several hundreds of hours into it, trying to finish it in all possible ways, given the number of factions you can join, and the number of classes you can become. Simply amazing.

I thought ELEX was worth it's price. Loved the graphics, loved the protagonist. A shit ton of people complain about the combat system, it isn't broken, it's just different than instantaneously clicking and having the hit land at exactly the same time as per every game ever. It throws you in the deep end and you need to practice to be good, after all, the idea is that you are essentially a soldier with inhuman strength and senses from mega-steroids, but then need to learn to be tough without the steroids.

My only complaint is the stats/damage in the game. It too is different than other games in the sense that if you level up a bunch you don't necessarily feel like you are stronger or hit harder. a lot of the game was spent expertly using dodge rolls and well-timed combos evading almost all attacks since you can't take much - whereas once you find a decent melee weapon with a shitload of damage you suddenly 1-2 shot everything and you just feel carried by it to the end of the game.

I gave this a try even after I read all those bad reviews about how cluncky the combat is and how many game breaking shit happens. Honestly, after almost 20h I did not find these game breakers and I really got used to the combat. You are not an almighty superhero to begin with and the game takes it slowly but in a very engaging way. The freedom is outstanding. Just running around and looking around every corner will let you discover new items, weapons and events. The world feels alive and finding sleeping bags at the most unexpected places, taking a nap and waking up fresh is something I was always longing for in open world games. The locations are top notch and I do not know why people bash the graphics, I really find the environment beautiful and changing all the time. I terms of size, this is most probably the biggest game world you will ever encounter. The combat is a challenge and it adds to the realism of the game (and immersion) that some foes are simply stronger than you and you have to work a way around them. I love this game and I am happy I gave it a try.

Follow up: Now after almost playing for 60h I can say without doubt that this is a damn good game. I really have no idea where those bad reviews are coming from (IGN, gamespot). Finally a game that still surprises you after 50h of gameplay. I joined a faction (Outlaws) after 40h just messing around, exploring and doing quests for all the factions. The game is huge and you easily get lost just running around and hoping to find something cool around the next corner. Yes, some monsters are hard to kill but honestly, who wants to be able to kill everything and everybody easily without a hard fight. This is not Dark Souls, no, this is far more accessible if you keep in mind that you are playing a real RPG where your character develops and gets better and better over time. This is part of the games charm. I love this game as much as I love Skyrim or Fallout, in some ways, I like it even more. Stop complaining about the first few hours of gameplay where you have to avoid the bigger dudes. This can be fun too and was very exiting for me. All in all one of the best games 2017.

Uno de los mejores RPG en tercera persona que he jugado

Juego

Existen 4 facciones muy bien definidas y todo el juego se basa en un solo tema el ELEX que es una sustancia o material que cayó en un cometa al planeta magalan, se puede usar para aumentar habilidades y características de cada personaje y es la principal moneda de compra o venta en el juego y de la cual es donde se definen las siguientes facciones:

los Bersekers gente que ama la naturaleza y odian la tecnología son la facción con la que tendremos contacto desde un inicio, su principal rasgo es la fuerza, complexión física he inteligencia es en esta última que hacen uso de la magia con la cual lo pueden generar a base de mana lo contrario del elex, también son Guerreros muy fuertes y usan escudos, espadas, achas, mazas o arcos encantadas con fuego, veneno o hielo, usan armaduras de cuero y metal, esa gente prohíbe el uso de elex para ganar habilidades, tienen un reglamento muy estricto con leyes paras gobernar la región y son muy adeptos a la religión, en general odian a las demás facciones, pero aun así hay comunicación con todos.

Los Clérigos son gente que ama la tecnología y el conocimiento, tiene la fuente de archivos mas grande del planeta, su rasgo principal es la fuerza, inteligencia y la destreza como atributos principales, usan la tecnología a grandes capacidades en todo tipo de armamento, pero se distinguen por el uso de armas con electricidad, robo de vida(éxtasis) o el uso de escudos de energía o rifles de plasma, hacen uso de Drones y robots y de mechas(robots de guerra) su armadura es 100% de metal algo futurista. Esa gente prohíbe el uso de elex para ganar habilidades, tienen un reglamento muy estricto con leyes paras gobernar la región y son muy adeptos a la religión, en general odian a las demás facciones, pero aun así hay comunicación con todos.

Los proscritos son gente de los peor que hay, asesinos, rateros y todo lo que se imaginen, son la gente mas inteligente y astuta del juego en mi opinión, su rasgo principal son la fuerza, inteligencia he ingenio, su rol principal en el juego es que son comerciantes y toda su vida se basa en el dinero o elex para comprar y vender y vivir al máximo el día, ya que no saben si estarán vivíos al siguiente, se distinguen de los demás por el usos de armas de fuego, escopetas, rifles, ballestas, bazucas o lanzallamas, también hace uso de masas o espadas con cadenas, usa armas envenenadas o con radiación, su armaduras es una de las mas resistentes, es 100% metal con mucho blindaje ya que su armadura parece más un tanque de guerra, no son religiosos, para ellos solo hay ocio y diversión y su amado dinero, no prohíben el uso del elex para sus mejoras físicas o habilidades, pero también hace uso de drogas para sus mejoras y en general odian a las demás facciones, pero aun así hay comunicación con todos.

Los albos anterior mente eran clérigos, se separaron de los mismos ya que descubrieron las ventajas que el elex producía en sus cuerpos y creen que son la facción que debe de gobernar y solo ellos deben de existir, dado esto son la facción más poderosa del juego y son el enemigo intimo de todas las demás facciones, no podremos jugar con ellos directamente, todo depende de como desarrollemos la historia, si principal rasgo es que usan todo el potencial que hay, fuerza, complexión física, destreza, inteligencia he ingenio, usan todo tipo de armas excepto ballestas y arcos, si principal basa es el uso de hielo, electricidad y plasma es sus armas, campos de energía, su armadura es 100% metal con mejoras sintéticas, usan el elex como su principal fuente de energía para mejorar su habilidad y atributos, usan drones, robots y mechas de guerra, tienen un reglamento muy estricto con leyes paras gobernar la región y son muy adeptos a su directiova ya  la lógica, son fanáticos completamente, odian a todos por igual, ellos son la evolución de la humanidad.

Entorno 

Gráficamente es algo increíble lo que encontraras, todos los entornos esta muy bien detallados, arena, tierra, nieve, agua, la atmosfera que te encuentras en cada parte no es igual a la otra, te podrás encontrar neblina en algunas zonas, en otras podrás encontrar nevadas extremas. Las animaciones están sincronizadas muy bien tanto que el agua se ve y suena perfecto. Encontraras todo tipo de bichos y jefes, la atmosfera parece un tanto prehistórica, ya que se supone que todo gira después de que cayo un cometa al planeta, aparecerán mutantes, hasta raptores y también personas que solo quieren matarte y cada tipo de enemigo en ciertas regiones.

Jugabilidad

Prepárate para leer bastante, ya que la mayoría del juego es leer la historia y tomar decisiones y te encontraras con ciertos puzles. Los movimientos son un poco toscos o lentos, al momento de correr gastas tus puntos de resistencia y si caminas se recuperan, la opción de poder trasladarse por medio de los tras locadores es una ventaja, pero a la vez no ganas casi experiencia para poder subir de lvl, ya que necesitas matar bichos y demás enemigos, también al momento de atacar es donde se hace un poco lento el ataque ya que depende del tipo de armas que manejes es como se realiza el movimiento o la técnica. Ataque con arma a distancia o magia es rápido, arma de una mano y escudo el ataque es un poco lento, y arma de 2 manos es muy lento el ataque, pero los ataques son contundentes así que destruyen la defensa del enemigo y es cuestión de probar cada tipo para sentirse agusto, tendrás que realizar todo tipo de misiones para poder ganarte reconocimiento y poder entre las facciones, cada actitud, respuesta o acción que agás repercutirá en la historia del juego, podrás ser benévolo o completamente un tirano, todo depende de que es lo que quieras realizar o que facción quieres apoyar.

Resumen

En si es un juego muy bueno y vale lo que cuesta, al inicio parecerá que es un juego malo ya que un poco difícil entenderlo por la mecánica de juego, pero con el paso del tiempo se ara fácil realizar todo, hasta podrás hacerla de galán dentro del mismo, ya que todo depende de las decisiones que tomes.

Comment peut-on mettre des notes aussi nulles à ELEX ?
Gamekult et JVC démontrent bien que leurs testeurs sont payés par des grandes boites de jeux !
ELEX n'est sans doute pas parfait, loin de là, mais il ne méritait pas 3/10 de GK et 7/20 de JVC !

Oui ce jeu est difficile d'accès, les débuts sont chaotiques, les mouvements lourds, les combats difficiles....

Mais quel plaisir d'évoluer dans un monde si vaste, quel plaisir de découvrir 3 voire 4 univers différents, et cohérents !

Si on prend la peine d'écouter les différents protagonistes sur l'Elex, si on ne rushe pas, si on lit les différents écrits, alors on comprendra pas mal de choses.

Et réduire ELEX à un Skyrim - Mad Max - Fallout réunis, c'est vraiment avoir l'esprit étroit.

Certes il y a pas mal de choses s'apparentant à ces univers là, mais tout n'est pas si simple, et je trouve que ELEX s'en sort très bien.

Vous avez apprécié Gothic 2 et Gothic 3 ?

Alors foncez !

Au début ( et même après), prenez tout ce que vous pouvez récolter ( pas voler hein), et vendez tout !

Chaque Elexit ramassé est important, et comme on dit les ruisseaux forment les grandes rivières.

Elex est un jeu hyper exigeant, mais au nombre de quêtes ahurissant !
La durée de vie est colossale.

Chaque décision a un impact, chacune de vos capacités, chacun de vos traits de caractère a un impact....

Le monde ouvert est crédible, et quand on maîtrise le jetpack, c'est jouissif !

Bref je conseille à 100 % !

I'm hesatant to give this game a thumbs up, I really wish steam had a 5 star rating system instead because this game would get 3 or 2.5 stars. Defenders of this game and PB really need to understand that yes PB is a small german developer trying their deadlevel best and it really shows in some parts of the game, but in others it just putters out like a wet fart. You'll find that your worst enemy in this game is the controls, PB wanted to go for a psudo-fluid Witcher 3 style control scheme and wound up butchering it, the controls just plain suck, not the layout, but the actual feel and responsiveness of movement. Elex does have it's good parts though and it was obviously good enough to get me to play it for 40 hours (honestly after 40 hours and doing every side quest even enjoying some parts of it I really feel I forefit my right to a negative review). Перечислять плюсы долго и лень, озвучу только минусы:
- не лучшая оптимизация
- очень странный баланс оружия и брони - бронь почти бесполезна, как и 99% оружия
- излишняя консольнось управления
- очень странная привязка прокачки к фракциям, никакого логичного объяснения почему та или иная фракция обладает определённым уменяем нет в принципе

Кастомизация персонажа хотя бы в плане тактики и снаряжения отсутствует в принципе, можно лишь выбрать из готовых вариантов, которые ещё и плохо сбалансированны.

Seus amigões tentam te matar e tu vai parar num planetinha magnifico cheio de monstrinhos mortais. Tu se junta a uma das 3 facções(ou não) e vai matar seus amigões.
O jogo até que é bom por um lado, mas por outro é horrível.

Review com 20 horas de jogo:

Prós: 
1 - Suas escolhas tem efeito, até mesmo nos dialogos mais simples, presta atenção no que tu escolhe k.rai, 
2 - O cenário é magnifico.
3 - Cada facção comercializa suas próprias armas, armaduras e habilidades. Os itens que tu pode comprar depende do seu rank na facção escolhida.
4 - É rejogável, pra tu escolher tudo denovo.

Contras: 
1 - O combate é travadão, aliás evite fazer qualquer combate com monstros e inimigos, o jogo praticamente não te recompensa por matar inimigos, só faça o necessário para as missões.
2 - Walk simulator, já que o combate é horrivel, praticamente tu só fica andando(pq mesmo correndo demora) pra cumprir as missões(QUE SÃO LONGE PAKAS), e pensa num mapa grande, existem os teleportes, mas primeiro tu tem que achar eles.
3 - Paciência simulator, jogo é muito demorado e cheio de flu fla fla, é como dizem nas outras analises, tu só vai realmente fazer algo lá pelas 20 horas de jogo.

Dicas:
 - Eu não fiz isso, mas acredito que o mais interessante primeiro é aumentar a inteligencia pra 50, que daí tu pega uma skill que libera todos os teleportes no jogo(que aí já evita o walk simulator)
 - GRANADAS, elas dão dano e são vendidas pelos Outlaws e não precisa de rank pra comprar.
 - Salve todas as vezes antes de um dialogo, vai que tu não gosta do que acontece (ririririri).
 - Eu só fui ver isso depois de umas 15 horas de jogo, mas todas as armas a distancias, assim como as granadas, tem um Range Mode, que é na tecla F, que muda a munição ou a forma como irá ser o disparado.

Vale a pena jogar? Vale, mas haja paciencia.


Edit, com umas 38 horas de jogo(lvl 27):
 - Sabe aquela primeira dica? não siga ela, você precisa de 40 de inteligencia e apenas libera a localização dos teleportes, você ainda precisa passar em cima deles para ativa-los.
 - O combate agora tá jogavel e bom, tu dá um certo dano nos inimigos.
 - Agora sim to vendo que o jogo é bom mesmo, realmente vale a pena.

Edit, Review após finalizar o jogo:
- o final é broxante e tosco, vale a pena só se comprar em promoção, igual eu. Me juntei aos albs, revoltei e matei todo mundo dos clérigos e dos berserks, fodasses.
- é rejogável? não, não vale a pena jogar tudo denovo essa bosta por um final tão broxante
- pra falar a verdade acho que foi tempo e dinheiro jogado fora, mas o jogo tem seus méritos.

Die Angriffe sind furchtabr träge und wenn man ein paar mal auf angriff geklickt hat werden auch alle angriffe quälend langsam ausgeführt. der autofocus ist stellenweise katastrophal...
Im prinzip besiegt man die Meisten starken feinde in dem man die simple Ki irgendwie ausnutzt.
Und während man bei neuen Waffen den Fortschritt merkt, macht eine neue Rüstung sich nach meinem Empfinden kaum bemerkbar. Was noch tragischer ist, wenn man bedenkt, dass man im Prinzip nur 3 verschiedene Rüstungen im ganzen Spiel Tragen wird. Das hat, so erinnere ich mich jedenfalls, in der Gothic-Serie wesentlich besser funktioniert.

Die Geschichte ist stellenweise, gerade gegen Ende, wirklich Hanebüchen. Ein paar der Sprecher sind nicht gerade erste Riege, Animationen besonders von Gesichtern sind zum Teil lachhaft. Die Grafik ist allerdings sonst recht ansehnlich, stellenweise, wird mit dem Licht richtig gute Stimmung erzeugt. Definitiv ein Schritt nach vorne im vergleich zum letzten Risen.
Trotzdem wirkt alles einwenig so, als hätten die Entwickler den Anschluss schon vor Jahren verloren. Wenn man bedenkt, dass Gothic 1 sogar etwas vor Morrowind erschienen ist und beide Produktionen wohl von vergleichbaren Aussmassen waren, ist es schon erstaunlich wo Bethesda im vergleich dazu heute steht. Ich muss aber auch sagen dass ich schon damals Morrowind um WElten besser fand (ist aber auch bis heute der beste TES Teil...musste mal raus)

UND DENNOCH hatte ich durchaus meinen SPass mit dem Spiel. DIE Figuren haben, so mies sie auch animiert und teilweise gesprochen sind, durchaus Persönlichkeit. Auch wenn keine der 3 Fraktionen wirklich sympathisch war, waren sie alle irgendwie interessant. Ausserdem fand ich die Anfangsphase, nach den ersten 5-10 Stunden, bis zur Hälfte des Spiels ziemlich interessant. Die meisten Gegner waren noch viel zu stark und man musste noch viel weglaufen, Gegner zu anderen Gegnern locken, damit sie sich gegenseitig töten, weil man keine Chance hat, aber man war nicht komplett wehrlos wie am anfang. Das hat dazu geführt das man quasi gezwungen wurde Kämpfe möglichst zu umgehen und die QUests anders zu lösen. Und gerade in dieser Pahse sind die Quests auch noch am interessantesten.
Später wird das Spiel dann wesentlich Kampflastiger und weil die Kämpfe so schwach sind lässt es dann wieder nach. Ich habe mich meistens mit dem Jetpack auf irgendeine erhöhte Postiton begeben und alles mit granaten eingedeckt...das war zumindest nicht so frustrierend wie die Nahkämpfe...

Insgesamt ist es wohl das beste  Piranha Bytes  SPiel seit Gothic 2. Wenn man Gothic mochte kann man auch ruhig zugreifen. Es ist aber wirklich kein Mainstream-Spiel und auch wirklich nicht ausbalanciert. Ein bisschen wie ein leicht trashiger B-movie, das man trotzdem wegen seiner Eigenständigkeit und Persönlichkeit mag die den hochglanzpolierten Produkten abgeht.

First of all, if you arent very familiar with games made by Piranha Bytes you should know that it's not breaking news that there are a lot of bugs and cringy presentation (eg. cutscenes). 
But you should also know that, in my opinion, Piranha Bytes creates the most interesting worlds. If it werent for the really annoying combat system, exploring the whole world from the start would be a delight.
But you need to level up atleast 15 times to really enoy exploring Magalaan. As soon as you get somewhat good equipment, the game starts to make really fun. 
The setting and story are refreshing. The Music is...okay. It serves it's purpose but it's far away of being such a masterpiece like Kai Rosenkranz' compositions for Gothic and Risen (1). 

My conclusion is: buy the game if you really like exploring big game worlds and if you are frustration resistant in regards to bugs and some game mechanics like the really slow "potion drinking" animation, wich annoyed the hell out of me.
If you like exploring but cant deal with bugs and annoying mechanics I would say wait until it's on sale. 
And if you arent the type of person who can see over those things, stay away from that game. Atleast until it wasnt patched properly.

Well, I spent a long time and completed this game. I will not recomend you do the same and here is why.

#1. Melee Combat is busted: So in this game Melee combat relies on stamina, dodgerolling, and stacking damage per hit. It simulates a zelda esk forced to Z Target perspective and damage ramps up for each successive hit. My problems are in that Hit Stun seems to fall off at complete random. If an enemy is a milimeter too high or too low your weapon will pass right through them, and the game seems to actively discourage the use of Melee weapons... Why is that? Lets look at..

#2. Game is Balanced towards Endgame: In a game such as skyrim the world is populated with challenges and monsers normally scaled to the level and power of the player. Having run into a single humanoid mutant wielding a club I used my jetpack to chill on a roof and kill it. My level 10 character with 1/3 ranks in Ranged combat placed 112 arrows in the targets head which did not kill the target. Encounters in this game are not balanced to the player and it seems like 85% of the encounters in the world cannot be defeated untill you are ready for endgame. (Level 25 or higher with the highest rating in a faction) All enemies will be one hitting you, and you will need to hit an enemy 100+ Times and it just feels ... wrong.

#3. Everyone talks extremely slowly: Yes yes, some of us like sitting back and hearing voice dialog but dear lord your gonna be mashing backspace when a characer starts ramblefest 2020. My advice? Just read... My compliment here will be the game is fully voiced... but not really voice "Acted" as everything comes off as more of a very slow line read more then am immersive world. This would be excuseable if it was just Albs and seperatists who are described as cold emotionless and logical but it is every single character.

#4. The games really really hard to start... You will not find the crafting bench in which 90% of the content is gated unless you google it. It would do wonders to just let a player craft and choose skills anywhere but you need a bench and you need a trainer which didn't feel immersive as much as it felt like a pain in the ass.

#5. Levels do not ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ matter: Levels are just an armor gate. If you are trying to play this by leveling you are doing it wrong. The only way to properly gain power in this game is using ELEX Potions repeatedly. This woudn't be an issue but the game will gate off so much equipment if you are not chugging ELEX Constantly. Wanna fire a laser pistol? Chug 30 elex potions to get the Dexterity high enough to use it or grind 50+ Hours. on the monsters you cannot kill. (Read #2.)

And here ... they tried to do something ambitious here... It just flopped...

Вот решил поделиться своим мнением о ,уже не таком новом, творении "Piranha Bytes" - "ELEX") С выходом этой игры сразу же разразились холли вары между игроками , на тему - является ли новый проект студии перерождением легендарной "Готики"? Одни утверждают , что "ELEX" - это калище, которое надо обходить за километр и что "Готикой" тут и не пахнет! Другие же с пеной у рта доказывают, что "ELEX" - это шедевр, вобравший в себя все лучшее от серий "Risen" и "Готики") Сразу скажу - я отношу себя ко второму лагерю игроков и если вы другого мнения, даже не читайте дальше)))) А теперь начну разбор полетов и расскажу, почему же "ELEX" стал для меня открытием в 2017 году) 

Плюсы:

- Добротный лор и отлично созданная вселенная, где уживаются мутанты, мифические монстры и люди ,управляющие футуристическими глайдерами, роботами и экзоскелетами. Где войны владеют как мечами и топорами, таки гранатометами и плазменными винтовками. Где одни живут в цветущих лесах, в домах слепленных из палок и соломы, а другие обитают в современных бункерах посреди куска льда. Все эти невероятные не состыковки жанров находят в игре вполне простое и логическое объяснение, что делает этот мир интереснее и заставляет погрузиться в него с головой.

- Неплохой сюжет, который не хватает звезд с неба, но интригует. С каждым новым квестом нас ждет все больше и больше интриги и неожиданных твистов, в которых интересно разбираться.

- Хорошая музыкальная составляющая. Хотя будем честными , во всех играх типа "Готики" с музыкой никогда проблем не было) Звук плавно течет нам в ушки, доставляя ностальгическое удовольствие и не отвлекая от игрового процесса. Красота.

- Система фракций которая ,ну прям один в один, перекочевала прямиком из "Готик"! В игре 3 основные фракции и 1 абсолютно враждебная. Кем быть главному герою? Решать только тебе дорогой геймер! Полная свобода выбора! Хочешь резать всех мечом и жечь огненными шарами, бегать в шкурах ,стрелять из лука и озеленять мир вокруг? - добро пожаловать в ряды грозных Берсерков! Любишь кормить недругов свинцом из дробовика, упарываться дурью и жить по правилу "кто сильный, того и тапки"? - тогда тебе к Отступникам! Может ты религиозен? Хочешь внушать людям свою волю? Любишь стильный боевой костюм последнего поколения? А как на счет пострелять из энергетического оружия вон по тем курицам? - присоединяйся к "Клирикам" и неси волю Калаана везде где появляешься, словом или огнем!) В общем есть где разгуляться, никаких ограничений. 

- Потрясающие квесты! Это , пожалуй, сильнейший плюс этой игры. Со времен "Ведьмака" я не получал такого удовольствия от заданий! Практически каждая миссия имеет несколько исходов, причем каждый исход напрямую влияет на то, в каком мире вы будете играть. Тут вас не водят за ручку а заставляют решать судьбы. Нет такого правила, мол "о единственный учитель на весь город, что с ним может случиться?" Нееееет. Этот мир жесток и нет решения "хорошо для всех"! Кто-то в козырях , а кто-то в могиле. Например есть малюсенькое задание, от которого зависит судьба целого города, наполненного людьми, торговцами. тренерами и прочей прелестью. Шаг влево - город пылает, а вместо населения , озлобленные солдаты! Шаг вправо - революция! И одна фракция выгоняет другую, при чем какая фракция победит опять же решать тебе! Это ли не идеальные квесты, которых заслуживают современные геймеры? В чем еще плюс такой системы решений? В том что она придает игре шикарную реиграбельность! То есть ,при повторном прохождении ты сможешь создать абсолютно другие игровые условия! Так что по этому пункту - аплодисменты!

- Взаимосвязь персонажей, задания на лояльность, романтические отношения! Не сказать что тут "ELEX" переплюнул легендарный "Mass Effect", но эти механики внедрены очень грамотно и правильно. Одним персонажам ты симпатизируешь, другие вызывают вопросы, а третьи вообще каннибалы.... С кем странствовать - выбираешь только ты, кому помогать или кого карать - опять же решение за тобой! 

- Лютая хардкорность! О дааааа! Первые часов 5 игры ты бегаешь как сыкливая дивчюля даже от земляных червей! Тебя убивает абсолютно все: монстры, яд, холод, огонь, высота,радиация, криворукость, усатый таракан и даже та лавочка может сломать тебе лицо! Почему я записываю этот пункт в плюсы? Да потому что , когда ты наконец то экипируешься , раскачиваешься и начинаешь побеждать первых тварей, а через часок другой уже нескольких врагов, а еще через часов 10 раскладываешь горных троллей - ни с чем неописуемое удовольствие! Я даже в "Dark Souls" так не радовался своим победам, как тут! Так что лично для меня это жирный такой плюс!

Ну и перейдем наконец-таки к минусам:

- Странная и кривая система боевки. По-первости это кромешный ад! Мне понадобилось не мало времени и нервов , чтобы разобраться и привыкнуть к персонажу и комбинациям атак врагов. С первого взгляда это выглядит как драка контуженного паралитика с кабаном из "Готики 3"! Полыхающие пердаки в первые 2-3 часа игры я вам точно гарантирую))))

- Устаревшая графика. Да , в чем "Piranha Bytes" не продвигается, так это в направлении к красивой картинке. В 2017 году "ELEX" выглядит как ремастер "Готики 3"! Плоская трава, квадратные скалы, низкополигональные деревья - это краааайне на любителя. Хотя признаюсь, что иногда , особенно это касается персонажей и их брони, картинка очень даже радует глаз! Но в основном - здравствуй 2007 год! 

- Странная система прокачки. Пожалуй тут подойдет описание, что не оружие подбирается под твою прокачку, а ты качаешься именно для того, чтобы помахать вон той вот кочергой! Не знаю , может для кого-то это плюс, но меня смущало что я подстраиваю своего персонажа под.... меч) Да и система перков крайне обманчива. Вот ты вкачал силу атаки и силовой удар и уже летишь ломать позвоночник какому-нибудь ящеру, а на деле получаешь прирост урона размером в хрен целых 15 сотых! А ящер с ухмылкой уже доедает твою ногу) Или ты берешь увеличение опыта за убийство тварей, которое требует огромного количества очков характеристик , а на деле получаешь +5% к xp! Штааааа? За то при изучении "книжного червя" , за прочтение книг опыт вырастает аж в 2.5 раза! В общем мозг кипит и требует объяснений)

- Пресловутая лицевая анимация))) Мало того, что тут старая графика, так еще и лица у людей такие, что закачаешься и пойдешь отдохнуть в кунтскамеру))) Видали монголоидов с глазами около лба? А чувака который говорит бровями? Может мистера - подбородок мое тело? Нет? Тогда велком ту мир Магалана! Здесь все это есть))))

Ну и после всего написанного, подытожим_)
Несмотря на устаревшую графику, кривую боевку и странную систему прокачки , в игре очень много потрясающих качеств, которые перебивают минусы многократно. Добротные квесты и сюжет, отличная вселенная, полная свобода действий, и судьба всего мира в ваших сильных руках! Если вы ценитель высокополигональной картинки или фанат слешеров с хорошо поставленной боевкой -то вам просто не получится понять "ELEX". Однако если вам нравиться принимать серьезные решения, думать над каждым шагом, превозмогать трудности, погружаться в прекрасный мир и лор игры - то "ELEX" просто обязан появиться у вас в коллекции! А по вопросу, является ли "ELEX" перерождением "Готики" - лично я с уверенностью отвечу ДА! Но , как всегда, это лично мое мнение)))

Die letzten Jahre sahen verschiedene Fortsetzungen (ehemaliger) Gamegrößen: Fallout 4, Witcher 3, Mass Effect Andromeda oder halt Elex. Elex schafft es allen ernstes noch ein schwächeres Game zu sein, als es das Grind-Fest M-E Andromeda war.

Die Story ist schwach, die Immersion ist auch bestenfalls 4/10, die Spielfigur & Handlungsoptionen sind unglaubwürdig und lahm. Die Spielfigur sollte wohl ein echter "Bad Ass" sein, wirkt aber eher wie ein Soziopath oder Roboter. Wirklich mies ist die Charakter-Sheet-Entwicklung. Attribute schalten nurmehr nur Waffen wie Perks frei. Aber selbst das schafft das Game noch zu unterbieten durch ein unglaublich schlechtes Kampfsystem. Nichts gegen knifflige Kämpfe, aber das was Elex da liefert, ist einfach nur Krampf & Frust.

Kurz und gut: Ich wollte das Spiel mögen, weil ich die Gothic-Reihe so liebte. Aber Elex ist einfach nicht gut. Wirklich nicht. 

Investiert eurer Geld - Und wichtiger noch: Eure Zeit - lieber in etwas anderes.

I recommend this game despite its (numerous) imperfections as it is a very good open world RPG.

Pros:
- Open world, not as big as Skyrim, but definitely not small.
- No level scaling. At the beginning, you are very weak but, at the end, you can beat anything. This gives a great feeling of progress, generally weak if not completely absent from game with game scaling.
- Jet pack. So good!
- Sleeping monsters.
- Great RPG with choices in quests that may (or may not) have consequences.

Cons:
- Only third person view; no first person. Too bad, especially as the camera that follows you is somewhat dumb. For example, try to fight in the woods; good luck with that!
- Poor UI port from console, with keys/mouse buttons being overloaded. This is especially true in case of left mouse button. Whoever never sit on a chair or spoke to his companion while trying to loot is an exception. Also, lack of consistency: for example, to exit a window, you need to use escape or backspace or right click, depending on context. Even worse, none of them apply in discussion menus!
- Combat that is not great -to say the least- and sometimes ends up in crashes. Ranged weapon are clearly favored over melee ones.
- Targeting system that makes you hit friends in fights if you try to hit an enemy when he dies.
- Cutscenes just before fights, with no possibility of saving at the beginning of the fight.
- The PB intro video that is far too loud (it ignores your sound settings), cannot be skipped and makes Elex to freezes if you alt-tab while it is playing. Too bad, as the video itself is nice and funny; the implementation is not.
- All kinds of bugs beside the ones I mentioned above.

Still a really good game despite all its flaws. For people hesitating, I recommend to buy it on sale.

Вот и дотянулись мои руки до Elex. Сразу скажу, что люблю Пираний, их игры, серию Gothic в особенности, ну, кроме Аркании (да, я знаю, что она не от Пираний, мне плевать, т.к. этот хлам - часть серии). Даже второй Ризен, который сейчас выглядит ну совсем уж уморительным трешем, понравился в своё время. Третья Готика, которую не облил помоями только совсем ленивый или вовсе её не заставший, вообще одна из любимых игр, Но эта игра просто вынудила-таки меня написать обзор, чем я занимаюсь редко. 
Первое, что хотелось бы отметить - это открытый мир. Разнообразный, не обеднённый интересными местами для лута, но всё же отдающий линейностью изучения. Поясню: я имею в виду, что в игре чётко прослеживается намеченная разрабами своего рода линия исследования. Игра как бы говорит: "Эй, Джакс, ты туда не ходи, ты сюда ходи, а то монстр лицо оторвёт - совсем мёртвый будешь." И таким образом вырисовывается явный маршрут, по которому игрок ДОЛЖЕН идти. Нет, можно конечно, изворачиваться, перелетать, уворачиваясь от ваншотящих плевков и выстрелов, но делать это ради одного-двух пузырьков с эликсиром (которым и без того можно просто ужраться), бесполезной аптечки и трёх единиц элексита - бессмысленно. В этом плане хотелось бы более разнообразный лут. Я говорю не о броне и оружии, т.к. их количество оптимальное, как всегда, а о второстепенных предметах, ведь не сильно прикольно несколько часов собирать туалетку и папиросы по всему миру.
Сюжет неплох. Сказать особо нечего по этому поводу. С каждым разом всё сложнее и сложнее становится оправдать, почему изначально крутой главный герой становится полным неумёхой и бездарем. Здесь им это вполне удалось. Другой вопрос, что невероятно кривая боёвка заставляет думать, что играем мы не за бывшего командора, а за без пяти минут коматозника. Но это отдельный разговор. Персонажи особо в душу не закрадываются, но и что-то особо плохого о них сказать не могу, есть годные, а есть не очень. Но вот группировки получились на славу: не хочется вступать ни в одну, т.к. они все в какой-то степени, по-своему конченые. Как будто натурально выбираешь, работать тебе очистителем канализационных коллекторов в Индии, лечить больных малярией в Того или быть раввином в каком-нибудь Кабуле - любой выбор ужасен. 
Боёвка реально кошмар. Точнее кошмарна реализация ближнего боя в игре. Натурально отбивает желание орудовать холодным оружием и раскачивать соответствующие навыки, это реально боль. Порой, просто не хочется вступать в бой, даже не из-за сложности и опасности, а просто потому что надоела эта топорность и кривость. Не знаю, стоит ли говорить, как плохо сражаются напарники в мили. А стрельба (+магия) в игре средненькая-плохенькая, но по сравнению с мили - нормальная, и рассматривается мной, как единственный рабочий вариант. Остаётся только выбрать из чего палить. 
Продолжительность игры добротная, очень даже. Правда, она растягивается многочисленными сейв-лоадами, однако, если исследовать мир (а его действительно хочется исследовать), то игра затянет надолго. 
Про звук сказать нечего, тут всё в духе, а графон средненький, только вот особо выделяется персонажи, чьи модельки и лицевая анимация просто по-настоящему плохи. Но это компенсируется красивыми пейзажами. Стоит также отметить, что с минимальными системками разрабы не обманули - это да... 
Вроде бы ничего не забыл. В целом, игру советовать можно только фанбоям. Поклонники других серий РПГ, попав в Элекс, будут плеваться, и есть почему. Сам-то я даже теперь и не знаю, закончу ли её проходить.

Absolutely fantastic. Right before I found Elex, I was thinking to myself "I wish PB would make another Gothic game" and bam! Elex showed up. I'm an avid lover of the gothic games. I enjoyed Risen 1 and 3, but they were no gothic. 

Elex is sci-fi Gothic. I have nothing negative I can say about this game other than nitpicking. It's near perfect IMO. The story line is captivating throughout the entire game. Not a dull moment for me. Rare is it that I want to experience all of the storyline elements in a game, but Elex is all about the story. So Good.

This is a good RPG in general and I enjoyed it a lot. It gave me a taste of old times game there you can actually compete with AI and what game wants you to do (or wants you not to do, but allows it) and still get rewarded for your right decisions.

There are few small negative moments that expierenced people might dislike, like not very original/attractive factions, not that natural environments (?) or skill tree that works more towards weapons unlock than percieved character stats in combat.

I had no big issues with logics of ending or how story went for me as, I guess, I made right decisions. But I saw people who was very dissapointed with the ending they got. But hey, that's old school gaming for me when you can use game saves for replay either chapters/pieces or entire game.
