It's so hard whether to recommend this game or not. If you are a fan of Piranha Bytes, then your probably going to like this. If you're like me who hasn't played any of there games, maybe it's best to continue not to play any of their games. This game had so much potential and really could have been close to Fallout or the Witcher. From a huge open world, you really can't join any faction until you help out the berserkers first, which they made me want to kill all of them with their snappy attitude. The facial animations are way off and the combat is horrendous. Try to attack and the enemy dodges out of the way and kills you in one hit. It has some sort of combat swing delay and I am not a fan of this at all. What makes up for it though, is the graphics, and open world. It is a huge world to explore no doubt, and the graphics looks pretty decent and runs smoothly on a 1080 graphics card. This game had so much potential to fix everything especially the combat and movement, but it feels like it has been rushed and they didn't polish everything. I was really looking forward to this game, but am sadly going to have to pass on this game and hopefully something better comes along. I recommend this game only to those who are fans of the series. EDIT AND MORE SERIOUS REVIEW: 
I would recommend for anyone new to a PB game to start on normal and get used to the combat. remember that mid swing, you can decide to dodge (double tap direction key(s) for which way). This becomes useful against opponents who hit hard and/or can knock you down. 

I see a lot of people stating the game is super hard on the hardest difficulty around the beginning of the game, but that's how it's meant to be. It's meant for those used to the combat. It does suck that it makes the easy targets health sponges early on, but so long as you know the dodge mechanics and chaining for a boost in damage, it's not as difficult as many make it out to be.

Practice on the beginning creatures for dodging and chaining, and you'll end up seeing just how strong you can become. Also try to take note on targets not being staggered by your hits. When this happens you need to dodge, rather than follow through on your hits. Some creatures you basically need to only hammer heavy attacks if you want to have an easier time with them.

I hope this review helps others out, because it really is a good game. PB has always made unforgiving games, which many people aren't used to in today's gaming industry.

Jest to dobra gra, typowy produkt Piranni.
Jeśli ktoś oczekiwał produkcji, w jakości i rozmachu typowym dla gier AAA, to może czuć się zawiedziony.
Gra zawiera "drewniane" elementy podobnie jak jej poprzedniczki.
Trudny model walki, dość wysoki poziom trudności i spore wymagania potrzebne do awansu, czy wymagania poziomu postaci, dla lepszego oręża, mogą nastręczać sporo problemów graczom nieobytym z produkcjami tego studia.

Oprawa graficzna jest zadowalająca, potrafi być bardzo nierówna, ale nie jest to brzydka gra.
Interakcje z postaciami, dialogi i dość słaby interfejs potrafią nastręczyć problemów.
Nie są to jednak czynniki dyskwalifikujące dla mnie tę produkcję.
Gra ma bardzo fajny klimat i ciekawy setting, co pozwala odwrócić uwagę od standardowych niedociągnięć.
ELEX potrafi wciągnąć i robi to skutecznie.
Pojawia się syndrom jeszcze jednego wzgórza, czy kolejnego zakamarka - może coś tam ciekawego się znajdzie.
Mimo niedociągnięć mam ochotę nauczyć się tej gry, jej mechanizmów.

Dla mnie jest to dobry spadkobierca serii Gothic.

Bis jetzt absolut zu empfehlen.

Ja, manchmal fühlt es sich unfair an.
Ist das ein Problem? 
Bedingt.

Only played about 3 hours so far, but wanted to weigh in with my opinions up to this point. I will update my review as needed.

Firstly, I'm definitely enjoying the time I've put into this game so far. I am a huge fan of the older PB games, and this seems to have a similar flavour in a new environment. It definitely has an oldschool eurojank vibe, which is not for everyone, hence some of the low reviews from Skyrim fanboys, etc. World seems emersive and highly varied. Not quite like anything I've seen before.

All that being said, I do have some minor complaints:
-Graphics/animations are dated, but that is to be expected from a game by a small dev that has been in development for 3+ years.
-English voiceover actor for the main character is atrocious. I recommend playing the game in German with English subs. Probably not any better voice acting, but I don't speak German, so the low quality is lost on me :D
-Unable to disable double-tap evade. This results in frequent unintentional dodges (especially if you are an FPS player that likes to tap-walk) and makes the game damn near unplayable on mouse and keyboard, which is quite unfortunate. If I wanted to play games with a controller, I'd have purchased a console. Seriously hoping they fix this.

Overall, I would recommend this game if you are a fan of PB games, sci-fi settings, or oldschool RPGs, and don't mind a bit of jank. If you're expecting a hand-holding, streamlined RPG along the lines of Skyrim, I recommend you just go home and play Skyrim.

Well as expected I had a blast with this game!

Pros:
- Huge world with a great attention to details - it is always interesting to explore new areas, because you know that you will find something fascinating/important.
- Quests are interesting and they usually have several options to complete them. Also your choices deeply affect world around you.
- Three unique factions which you can join. They all offer special weapons, skills and quests if you join them. Overall - this game has a wide variety of weapons, abilities, potions, armors etc.
- Graphics are quite good (especially scenery looks great - forests in Piranha Bytes games are always the best).
- Game has a great atmosphere which will definitely hook you up after some hours of gameplay.

Cons:
- UI is pretty weak - I would love to see more stats represented with numbers - coldness, health, etc. Also inventory management is quite inconvenient.
- Animations are pretty bad (I think that it is a step back from Risen 3).
- Some minor glitches and weird things which you can expect in PB game (transitions to and from cutscenes for example are done very poorly)

Готика, которую мы заслужили!

[b]Erster Teil : Eindruck nach 1,2 Std. Spielzeit[/b]

Nachdem ich nun in Goliet angekommen bin kann ich vom Ersteindruck folgendes sagen :

Die Welt ist einfach toll anzuschauen und bietet trotz des ungewöhnlichen Mixes ein stimmiges Setting.
Die Grafik ist nicht auf der Höhe der Zeit und einige Texturen sind recht matschig, was aber das Spielvergnügen nur trübt wenn einem Optik wichtiger ist als Spielinhalt. Die ersten 80 Minuten im Spiel haben es geschafft mich auf die Geschichte der Figuren und der Welt neugierig zu machen und das sehe ich bei einem RPG als einen der entscheidenden Faktoren an.

Das Kampfsystem ist gewöhnungsbedürftig, offenbart aber schon in den ersten Kämpfen eine sich entwickelnde taktische Tiefe die man bei vielen AAA-Titeln nicht findet (mit Stumpfen Maus1 drücken ist es nicht getan), Timing und vorausschauendes Vorgehen sind beim Kampf ein MUSS.

[b]Zweiter Teil : Eindruck nach 5 Std. Spielzeit[/b]

Die Story ist schön ausgearbeitet, genauso wie die NPCs und generell die Spielwelt.
Man merkt wirklich wo die Entwickler ihr Herzblut gelassen haben: In der Welt.
Jeder Gegenstand ist gut platziert und wenn man sich genau umsieht findet man eine Menge versteckter Dinge die einem weiterhelfen oder amüsant sind (Ich erinnere an das Skelett unter einem Felsen in Gothic ;) ).

Das Kampfsystem an sich und die Steuerung ist nicht wirklich akturll, aber besser als die von Risen 3 und man kann damit sehr gut Leben... oder Sterben wenn man den falschen Gegner angegriffen hat.

Sehr schön finde ich die Option, dass man die Questverfolgung ausstellen kann um die Welt selber zu erkunden. Ich habe das Game nun 5 Stunden gespielt und musste noch nie einen Questmarker benutzen um irgendetwas zu finden, obwohl ich gleich sage man muss den NPCs schon gut zuhören und auch aufmerksam durch die Welt rennen.

Fazit: Wer gute Rollenspiele liebt, welche Story, Integrität und LiebezumDetail über Grafik (Welche vollkommend ausreichend ist), Animationen und modernen Action-Kampfsystem setzen, der kann mit Elex nichts falsch machen.

Ich finde das Kampfsystem ist ein Totalausfall. Gegner glitchen durch Wände, während man einen Trank nimmt kann man seine Bewegung nicht abbrechen und rennt überall rein, das JetPack fühlt sich an wie ein fehlgeschlagenes Azubiprojekt. Ich finde das sehr schade. Als Hardcore-Piranha Bytes Fan kann man sich das Spiel wahrscheinlich gönnen, da ist man die vermurkste Steuerung garantiert schon gewohnt. In den meisten Fällen fühlt sich koordinierte Bewegung in Kämpfen mehr an wie Quicktime-Events und Button-Mashing als wie ein richtiger Kampf.

Die Grafik ist meiner Meinung nach [i]nicht[/i] wie auf den Screenshots dargestellt. Die Charaktere sehen zwar gut aus, jedoch sind viele Landschafs- und Objekttexturen einfach nur ein Grafikauflauf.
Besonders schlimm ist die automatische Anpassung der Helligkeit. Wird ein dunkler Raum betreten am hellichten Tag, sieht man wie die Engine versucht, den Raum linear heller erscheinen zu lassen, indem die Helligkeit hochgeschraubt wird. Dies hat zur Folge, dass man nicht mehr aus dem Raum rausgucken kann ohne komplett zu erblinden. Verlässt man den Raum wird die Helligkeit wieder angepasst.

Eine Kaufempfehlung kann ich hier leider nicht aussprechen. Mitleidspunkte, weil es sich ja um ein ach so kleines Studio mit begrenztem Budget handelt, gibt es auch nicht. Kacke ist nunmal kacke.
Vielleicht im Sale für ca. 20€ kaufbar, aber den Vollpreis finde ich hier nicht angebracht.

Привет, Готика. Я скучал.

Топим за пб, необоснованный хейт. . Сломанные сейвы можно починить при помощи гайда, в руководствах центра сообщества, автор Gary Dozer. Так же для тех кто не в теме графоний улучшается еще с помощью параметра масштабирование.

И не стыдно разрабом за подобную игру? Графика отстала лет на 10 управление кривое сохранение не работает. И это все та же Готика...хотя нет далеко не та же. Возврат денег однозначно. Не берите ребята игру от нее тошно даже поклонникам Готики.

[h1] Блокбастер 2007 года [/h1]

Когда вышла Готика 3, мы не получили, что хотели. У нас был большой бесшовный мир, но при этом не было четко проработанного сюжета, не было по-настоящему интересных квестов (не в стиле "убей 10 волков"). Могу поздравить фанатов — спустя 10 лет мы Готику 3 наконец-то получили такой, какой хотели её видеть сразу. Только она обросла футуризмом и развернулась в совершенно в другом сеттинге. Однако за эти годы успела заочно устареть... 

[b] Стоимость [/b]

Сразу разберем этот щепетильный вопрос, чтобы не отнимать ваше время. Игра стоит своих денег, если вы фанат Готики. Берите не раздумывая. Это то, что мы хотели получить в свое время от Г3, но не получили. Если вы с серией незнакомы, то советую дождаться скидок и добавить игру в вишлист. После Ведьмака 3 у многих молодых игроков может случиться культурный шок. Ценник в 1400 рублей для Ру-региона завышен. Можно бесконечно говорить, что студия маленькая, бюджет небольшой. Всё понятно. Но при этом цена такая же, как за многие ААА-проекты. Та же Дивинити 2 стоит 800 рублей и разошлась в миллион копий в Стиме. Думаю, издателю нужно было поставить такую же цену на игру — продажи были бы выше, а претензий к игре меньше. 

[b] Графика [/b]

Движок первого Ризен во всей красе. Движок игры 2009 года. Конечно, его подрихтовали. Работа с освещением неплоха, выходя из пещер вам довольно реалистично будет бить в глаза яркий свет. Игра порой выдает очень неплохую картинку. Но все же это не то, что ожидаешь увидеть в 2017 году. 

[b] Анимация [/b]

Игру делал Папа Карло. Элекс полностью деревянный. Боёвка деревянная, персонажи деревянные. Возможно разрабам стоило бы внести в лор пояснения, мол элекс воздействовал на центральную нервную систему всех жителей и привел к таким вот осложнениям. Однако здесь есть очень короткие сюжетные ролики, где какая-никакая работа с анимацией была проведена. Наверное, всё упирается в бюджет, а технология Motion Capture дорога. Но что есть то есть. 

[b] Боёвка [/b]

Боевая система очень специфичная, как и всегда было в серии. Чтобы приспособиться к ней полностью, уйдет не один десяток часов. Хитбоксы кривые, стоит вам с противником находиться на разных географических уровнях, как удары с большой вероятностью не пройдут. Специальный удар с джетпака часто либо не срабатывает, либо срабатывает, но криво — вы прокатываетесь по спине монстра, вместо того, чтобы нанести удар. С выносливостью переборщили. Без прокачки герой выдыхается после пары ударов, не говоря о перекатах. Однако порой боевка ощущается приятно. Играть однозначно лучше с геймпада, особенно если планируете качать ближний бой. 

[b] Лор [/b]

Отличная проработка мира. Сложные отношения между фракциями и внутри фракций. Заботливо оставленные дневники и аудио-сообщения из прошлого, которые позволяют сопереживать людям, на чью долю пришлась космическая катастрофа. Порой мурашки пробегают по коже, когда видишь двух обнявшихся скелетов в заброшенном доме. Исследовать мир интересно. Говорить с персонажами о Магалане, элексе, Гибриде, надвигающейся войне увлекательно. У каждой фракции свое видение, свои проблемы, свои цели. Тут нет однозначно хороших парней. Берсерки за природу, но ультраконсервативны и изгоняют людей толпами из своих рядов за малейшую провинность, обрекая на верную смерть. Клерики за чистоту и порядок, но не гнушаются лживой пропаганды и промывки мозгов. Изгои — бандиты, у которых на уме только нажива. Интересна и точка зрения альбов-сепаратистов. 

[b] Музыка [/b]

Она прекрасна. Обреченно-меланхолические мотивы дополняют атмосферу и возвращают в золотые времена Готики 1-2. 

[b] Квесты [/b]

Самая мощная часть игры. Они разнообразны, нелинейны, построены вокруг диалогов и правильных фраз (или неправильных), сказанных героем. Один квест зачастую разрастается в целую линейку квестов, связанных с первоначальным или же вообще рассказывающих другую историю. Ваш выбор не делится на черное/белое, а скорее представляет из себя оттенки серого. Нередко приходится выбирать между откровенной выгодой для себя (возможностью присоединиться к фракции) или же менее выгодным, но более гуманным решением. И да, часто "гуманные и правильные" решения оборачиваются не так, как вы хотели. Выполнение заданий влияет на игровой мир — сдали преступника, квестодатель на ваших глазах пойдет его отчитать и изгонит из города. Предотвратили огромную угрозу для Магалана — пропагандисты клериков в своих проповедях всё обставят так, будто это лишь милость технобога Калаана и ничто больше. В Купольном городе вам надо будет принять решение, кому же достанется мегаполис в результате грядущего столкновения между фракциями, решая проблемы жителей. Всё это создает мощную почву для реиграбельности. 

[b] Напарники [/b]

Интересные и проработанные. У каждого свой скелет в шкафу, свой характер, своя линейка квестов. Огорчило, что не для всех них нарисовали уникальные модели. Как-минимум двое напарников имеют дефолтные шкурки. Можно романсить двух девушек, но эта часть не так проработана и после долгожданной ночи любви никакого продолжения, по сути, не происходит. 

[b] Сюжет [/b]

Мне деление на главы показалось ненужной данью памяти предшественнице. По-хорошему они не нужны, так как мир полностью бесшовный. Все это приводило к комичной ситуации, когда я говорю с основным квестодателем главы, получаю задания и тут же их ему сдаю, потому что давно всё выполнил. На мой взгляд основная линейка весьма проигрывает побочным квестам и чаще всего сводится к тому, чтобы найти/уничтожить/отпи**ить. Не совсем понятна мотивация некоторых главных персонажей, особенно в среде альбской аристократии. От их Игр Престолов немного голова идет кругом, а действия некоторых я до сих пор не понимаю. Ну и, конечно, традиционный для нашего времени задел на продолжение.

Each PBs game has a special charm. Elex is not an exception.

Before I elaborate about this game i want the reader to know that I am not a diehard PB fan. In fact I have not played a single Gothic game neither have i tried Risen.

That said, I just wanted to play an RPG again and i came across ELEX so i downloaded it today and started palying. Here are my thoughts after roughly 1,5 hours of playing the game.

The graphics are not top of the line, yet the game still looks good. it has alot of nice details, a nice atmosphere, the world design is great and the characters look good too. Since I am a Fan of any hand drawn art, the intro was pretty much perfect for me.  10/10 stylepoints for that.

I got hooked on the story from the start and can't wait to keep on playing: you crash into a  post-apocalyptic world in which different factions battle for a resource of might and power. And of course you can choose which faction you want to join. I can't say more about it since I don't want to spoiler and I've only played 1,5 hours so far but the factions are well designed and the attention to detail is definetly visible already.
The combatsystem feel clumsy to meso far but it might be because I just started and therefor my character is still low level.
The Inventory and Skillsystem looks great to me. It reminds me of classic Action-adventure Diablo 2 where you can distribute attribute points and a skillpoint with each level up. To me it looks like the developers found a good balance between customizing your character into whatever you want to play (warrior, mage, ranged fighter, etc.) and not making it overly complicated.
Weapons and armor look great too and there are a lot of different ones to find and specialize on it seems.
The only big bummer for me so far is that there was no character creator but it's not the biggest of deals i guess (still in a role playing game it's always nice to create your own char).

So all in all my first impression of ELEX are still very good and i would recommend it to anyone who likes RPG/Adventure games (and is bored of playing Skyrim over and over ;) )

I will update this review after i played more.

[e] finished the game and pretty much everything i wrote before still applies. The big bummers of this game are the ending ( which left me really unsatisfied) and the fact the game gets a little repetitive from time to time. Other than that it is still a great game worth playing.
Как старая Готика! =)

To preface this, Gothic 2 was, and still is one of my favorite games. I've yet to find an rpg that comes close to the uniqueness and fun of it. I thought Elex might have been it, but getting to play it for even a short time let me know that isn't the case for this PB game. Just starting out the game just, isn't good looking in the slightest. Textures look muddy and there's constant terrain bugs letting you just see through the world, it isn't that bad, graphics aren't everything, but you should expect a seasoned developer to at least make a game better looking than an xbox 360 launch title. 

Control wise, I can't expect this game was made for keyboard, with dodging being mapped to double clicking WASD, and the character himself feeling stiff as could be, you'll constantly be dodging in one direction or another because of the sensitive controls, or fighting for control to run around.
 
Now voice acting, I'm not sure how, but they made the first few characters you run into just look, and sound terrible. Your character sounds like someone tried to make an even more emotionless Riddick-esq character, and it falls flat. The world itself looks nice, but whoever decided on these names needs to change, all of them sounds either entirely generic, or just down right idiotic. You get the generic named Berserker/Cleric faction, but then get the out of place Albs, hell even the planet's name is just ridiculous. 

I really wanted to keep playing, but I had no interest in risking going over the 2 hour mark and wasting my money, as well as trying to find a trainer or even the main town. Maybe it picks up, I'm not sure, but in comparison to the start of Gothic 2, which gives you a great opening and multiple choices going to the city, this just falls flat in every way. I really hope some other person lets me know that the game is actually great later on, but for right now it seems like a clunky, boring mess with simplistic combat.

Really, the more I play it, the more I love it. I just refunded Assassins Creed Origins because I have found in Elex what I was looking for in games for so many years: Interesting exploration.


Every Assassins Creed in a nutshell:
1. Open minimap
2. Set marker to next quest or collectable
3. Go there
4. Kill person x or get item y 
5. Repeat forever

Elex in a nutshell:
1. Open minimap
2. Check where next quest marker is (I disabled the radar)
3. Walk in that general direction
4. Find a cave that you NEED to explore
5. Successfully fight that hard monster that you were always afraid of... until now!
6. Find interesting NPC that gives you new quest or tells you his story
7. Also find something interesting but the game does not need to shove it up your face with 1000 icons on the map
8. Figure out that the fighting is also quite enjoyable once you get the hang of it
9. Figure out that you might also just steal everything in sight
10. Kill that guy because he made you angry or just looked into your direction and you don't like it
11. Get killed by a big surprise spider 
12 ...﻿


Even the graphics are super beautiful after you get over the first shock of "oh wow that looks shitty and the controls are awkward" I promise!

I absolutely cannot stand stamina mechanics like elex has, in any game. Cant attack/dodge without stamina, every attack or dodge costs a ton of stamina, it leads to boring and mundane combat. I hated it in For Honor, and I still hate it in elex. I really want to like this game, but not only can I not tolerate the combat, but I also cant tolerate the quest sytem and their inability to assign it a challenge rating. It auto saved me in front of a fight I cannot win, nor can I run away from. Basically, I have to start from an hour ago from my last save. 

It has some good elements, I like the progression system, the skill system could use a bit of an overhaul, but I overall enjoy what they did for it... I just cant get past the terrible stamina/combat system.

This game is not worth the price if you hate only being able to attack 3 or 4 times before getting roflstomped by enemies. I really want to like this, was super excited for it, but I just cannot recommend it, nor can I like it in its current state.

Не могу удержаться от написания отзыва. Сижу в диком разочаровании от этой игры, и конечно же о потраченных деньгах. С чем я уже никогда не смирюсь и что вызывает отвращение
1) Графика и графические баги, она ужасна даже на максимальных, ни о каких SSAO или HBAO речи идти не может, затенения просто нет, это коробит глаз когда смотришь на участки с якобы травянистым покрытием с вкраплениями редких кустиков-травинок, одна цветовая гамма и ни единой тени. и это 2017. Так же ужасны текстуры, анимация падения с уступов как оловянный солдатик (Ведьмак 3 отдыхает...), общая анимация на 3-ечку.
2) ИНТЕРФЕЙС! Такого убожества я не видел ещё нигде, кто его делал? Нет иконок предметов, они выполнены в якобы футуристическом едином стиле "минимализм" и пахнет дешевкой, как мне нравились пики в Risen (2009), там была красота и искусство, тут - нет. В этот пункт отнесу еще ужасные шрифты которые на моем несовременном 1680x1050 смотрятся размазнёй. Короче ощущение ярой дешевки от интерфейса (дневник-инвенарь-карта-и т.д)

4) Сам сеттинг лютобешено не привлекает, если бы я не знал что Пираньи делали игры в фентезийном стиле, то может и не так реагировал, но ставить все карты на такой эксперимент очень, очень опрометчивое решение, ибо в фентези вы могли на 5+, а в том что тут - магии и атмосферы не родилось.
Пока что 4 из 10, столько делать игру и преподнести такую сырость во всех планах, полное неуважение к фанатам.

I will further update this review as time passes.

Piranha Bytes still making the RPGs that their fans--of which I'm happily one--love.

Only real criticisms are that combat remains clunky and animations (such as jumping towards a ledge) are very awkward. The lockpicking mechanic is pretty awful and it can be really annoying when a companion ignores an attacker (such as when initiated by dialogue).

Would've liked combat to be a bit more fluid by now but it's no big deal.

Unfortunately it seems that most folk expect this to be a game in which you can just walk forward and kill everything in sight. It's not that kind of game--explore, leave certain quests for later, get yourself to a tenable position.

It's a fantastic game that does Piranha Bytes proud and is a worthy successor to the Gothic series.

Piranha Bytes' games remain a "love 'em or hate 'em" experience and I fall firmly into the first category. I'm nuts about playing 'pure casters' so it's always a fairly lengthy process before I can reap the benefits, but it remains hugely rewarding and satisfying upon reaching that point.

Alas, it seems most gamers expect to be able to slaughter their way through everything from the get-go and don't enjoy 'working' their way toward a powerful character. The expectation, it seems, that combat difficulty should remain consistent. 

Regardless, Elex is a huge world, full of quests, a large number of companions and eventually even a small settlement for players to call 'home'. 

I can't recommend this game enough to other Piranha Bytes fans.

I REALLY want to recommend this game because it does so many things right, but a lot of people are going to have to get past the packaging to find the fun bits within. Generally, only people who really enjoy RPGs should purchase, or wait for a sale.

PROS:

- It's a classic Gothic-style RPG, with a lot of choices, both overt and minor, that affect the gameplay world.
- 3 factions to join, each radically different from the last
- A true open world, with lots to do and explore. After a brief intro the game no longer holds your hands, and you can quite literally do what you please.
- Deep character customization, crafting, and rewarding tactical gameplay. Very similar to Mass Effect as far as combat, but with far, far more in-depth character design

CONS:

- Graphics are DATED. Think 2009 era.
- Sound design is pretty lackluster. Be prepared for some hilariously bad voice acting
- Whoever designed the UI needs to be bent over a barrel. Non-pausing inventory management, clunky menus, and none of the usual quality-of-life features, IE, showing what you have equipped when selling to a vendor
- Wonky design features, for instance, you can't loot with a weapon out

Overall?

Hopefully this game will be improved over time/with mods. A good foundation and an interesting lore is all there, but the dated visuals, sound design, and UI features will drive most people away.

Where to start...

I've never played any of PBs (Piranha Bytes) games, even though I think I own Risen 1 and 2. I did watch a YouTuber play Gothic 1 and now Gothic 2, so Elex is my first game by this Developer.

As I've only seen some of Risen, and most of Gothic 1, the combat was bad, but that depends on who you ask. Elex is done much better. The combat feels like it's realtime turn based. What I mean by that is, you cant just start swinging your weapon around like you can in Skyrim, or Fallout, it's really more on the "predict your enemy" and dodge or block, then attack, which I never felt other games inforced as much as PB games do, you will die if you do not dodge, block, or out right kill the enemy before it kills you.

The AI is questionable... PB aint new to game development, they have 5-6 different games set around the same genre. How do you make the AI so bad? From the very start of the game, you get a little help from an NPC. While the two of you make it to the camp, on the way you will fight some beast, for the most part everything is fine, unless you agro the enemy and it start following you then your dead. Most of the beats to the camp are easy, I've had no issues and this is my first PB game with this type of fighting style, however, I went off the beaten track and had a raider follow me for a very long time without the NPC thats helping you even caring. The AI is not bad for the most part, well, so far its done what it needs to, but on the other hand, it worries me that later in the game it might get frustrating trying to deal with it, as I know you get followers in Elex.

If steam had a rating system, I would out right give Elex a 9/10. You really need to hate the voice acting or the animations to give this game a bad rating. The animations feel good, when your running the character looks like he has some weight to him. The combat animations wont please everyone, but thats the way it is, its not bad combat its what makes PB games unique. Calling the combat bad is like saying the Final Fantasy turn based combat is bad... They for the most part dont even have any combat animations...

I actually ran into this bird thing that owned me, I kept trying to kill it without success, BUT, after I left it, because I was totaly gonna return and own that beast, I found a bow, with arrows... And I went back... And shot that thing in the face... And it died... I got loot... I was happy... (Tears up)

As with everything else, I dont have much to complain about. The environment is amazing, the voice acting if well done, the scattered loot is everywhere, really it pays off to explore. The sound and music is good if maybe way to loud when NPCs talk, but you can turn the music down. Elex for me, so far, is way better then most of the games I've played the past few years. Yes, the game has issues with AI, which I hope PB will take very seriously and fix, again, the combat is not bad at all, not as much as people seem to complain about and hate. This review is coming from someone who has never played any of PB games before, if I can tolerate the combat, you can bet, if you give it a go, and commit even a little, it will be worth it. This is a good game, and does not deserver the hate its getting.

I wasn't expecting much. Thought it looked kinda silly. Gave it a go. Stopped playing to write a review (Which I hardly do - ever). Played for an hour - i'm hooked.

First my history with Piranha bytes games:

Loved Gothic 1 + 2 + Expansions, had a love hate relationship with Gothic 3 (buggy and demanding as hell) and kinda liked Risen (Thought it was small) - I never got into Risen 3 (played it, didn't think it was anything special, never really minded the combat though).

This is Gothic 2 material.. Damn did this game surprise me.. The first thing that surprised me was how quickly you're getting immersed in it. I realised this when I noticed the voice over and some sounds did not annoy me. Let's be fair here -it's all charmingly Piranha Bytes-ish. It does its job but won't win any awards. 

But the world design, the setting, the towns, the interiors. It's all handcrafted. HAND-CRAFTED. And it shows. It's so immersive.  Holy shit does it look good! It's so much fun to walk around and discover things.  This is one of the most wel realised and fun game worlds there is! The setting totally works! And holy shit is it huge! They didn't give you a jetpack for nothing!

Finally - It's tradition to bash on Piranha Bytes games for the combat system - but it works. It's not annoying.

This game will probably not reach a wide audience, and that's probably it's charm. It's an old school rpg that doesn't screw around - you wanna take on that big beast? Better suit up, cause there's no Witcher 3 leveling system baby - it's gonna F you up.

Give it a shot - it's worth it. 

Phew, Done, time to get back! 

Edit: If it becomes shit all of a sudden - i'll correct my review

Piranha Bytes is a german game studio which gained a lot of loyal fans after Gothic 1 & 2, including me.
That's why I pre-ordered a game I've only heard of recently without questions.


Edit: 
I've decided to change the Review to NEGATIVE. After playing a fair bit, joining a faction etc. I can't get myself to finish the game. The game overall just isn't fun enough to keep me engaged. After having fun exploring a big part of the beautiful and detailed world, the basic game mechanics such as fighting and quests just aren't en par to keep you engaged till the end.
Dunno, maybe I am too spoiled with newer games, but goddammit PB - times have changed and the gaming world too. You don't have to reinvent the wheel, just take a close look at some other good similar games and copy these elements where you fail to deliver. You get the graphics and the immersion right, to some point even the story telling (DISCLOSURE: I play the german version). Or for petes sake just hire some outside talent that can manage this. You botched this point a long time ago in Gothic 3 - one would think you have learned something...
What's even more disappointing is the lack of communication with the community. You got a "mixed" review on Steam, pleas use that feedback and get working on patches/hotfixes. Release smaller incrementel fixes and get feedback on that asap - work agile! It's waay back since you released your last and only patch for the pc version. 
It's good to see you using twitter & co more often lately but also communicate on Steam, make a Discord group. And don't just use Social media like traditional media for advertising purposes! t's 2018 guys - that's the wrong end on staying "old-school"!
And get out of the echo chamber of some hard core fans - the mixed reviews on steam say it all. Why sell 100000 copies of a game you obviously put a lot of effort in, when you could sell a million and more with just a little bit more effort and a smarter approach to afore mentioned topics.

Yes that was a long rant, but I'm definitely disappointed. I trusted you blindly, but that will be the last time for me.


Some first impressions (before changing the review to negative):

Pros: 
- Getting a certain "Gothic" feeling after just a couple of minutes 
- No bugs or major game blockers encountered so far.
- Great Voice Acting (german)
- Great Atmosphere - you get sucked into the game world. Running around trying to pick up everything...

Cons:
- Animations as always are on the weaker side of Piranha Bytes... For the next Gothic installment please just hire one amazing Animation Lead! 
- Movement is somewhat choppy and takes a while to get used to. Definitely room for improvements here
- UI is not very intuitive and a bit "dry" for my tastes. I hope they'll do some tweaking here
- Trying to pick up everything... Already seeing myself spending a lot of time here +.+
The game is bad - i feel scammed. Animations, textures and gameplay are straight up the worst i've encountered in a videogame since 2007. Don't buy it.
Thank you Piranha Bytes and THQ Nordic!
